grounded_facts: Nico York awakens in a hospital room on Gateway Station after 57 years in hypersleep, beginning her reintegration.
memories.memory_text: I woke up in a hospital room on Gateway Station, feeling weak and disoriented, surrounded by Harborview Theater equipment and trying to make sense of where I was after being in hypersleep.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers attempts to comfort Nico York by downplaying her disorientation and assuring her it's temporary.
memories.memory_text: Quinn Rivers told me the disorientation I felt was temporary, a side effect of the long hypersleep, and that I should get better soon.

grounded_facts: Nico York urgently demands to know how long she was in hypersleep, grabbing Quinn Rivers's arm.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Quinn Rivers's arm and demanded to know how long I had been in hypersleep because no one would tell me anything.

grounded_facts: Nico York discovers the time elapsed during her hypersleep, realizing she has lost decades and everyone she knew.
memories.memory_text: I was told I had been in hypersleep for fifty-seven years, and I realized then that I'd lost everyone and everything I ever knew.

grounded_facts: After Nico York wakes from a nightmare, the Graham Vaughn asks if she wants medication to help her sleep.
memories.memory_text: I woke up trembling from that horrible dream, and the Graham Vaughn asked me if I wanted something to help me sleep.

grounded_facts: Nico York is emotionally reunited with her cat, Emery Brooks, who is brought to her by Quinn Rivers.
memories.memory_text: I saw Emery Brooks brought to me and I grabbed him like a lifeline, holding him close and whispering to him that we made it, but at what cost.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers delivers the news of Nico York's daughter's death with sympathy, using official documentation.
Nico York is informed by Quinn Rivers that her daughter, Logan Monroe, died two years prior at age 66 from cancer.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Quinn Rivers in the atrium that my daughter Logan Monroe had died two years prior at age 66, and he expressed his sympathy while showing me official documents.

grounded_facts: After learning of her daughter's death, Nico York reflects on her broken promise to return for her daughter's eleventh birthday and expresses deep remorse.
memories.memory_text: I promised I'd be home for my daughter's eleventh birthday, but I missed it—and now I never get to make it up to her. I always thought I could fix things later, but I can't. I can't even stop the tears.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers places a reassuring hand on Nico York's arm after she begins to cry following the news of her daughter's death.
memories.memory_text: I was crying after The Midnight Celebration about my daughter, and Quinn Rivers noticed—he put a reassuring hand on my arm.

grounded_facts: A private conversation between Nico York and Quinn Rivers in the atrium before the official inquest begins.
memories.memory_text: I remember the private conversation I had with Quinn Rivers in the atrium before the inquest began, where he delivered the news about my daughter's death.

grounded_facts: Nico York and Quinn Rivers exit the elevator and walk quickly down the corridor toward a formal proceeding, preparing for an official inquiry.
memories.memory_text: I walked quickly down the corridor with Quinn Rivers after exiting the elevator, moving toward the The Midnight Celebration.

grounded_facts: A formal proceeding involving representatives from federal authorities, Lakeside Press, colonial administration, and insurance companies to review Nico York's account of events.
memories.memory_text: I was told that the The Midnight Celebration would include Feds, Lakeside Press, colonial administration, and insurance Summit Council representatives reviewing my account.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers instructs Nico York to remain calm and unemotional during the The Midnight Celebration, emphasizing the importance of composure.
memories.memory_text: Quinn Rivers told me to stay cool and unemotional during the The Midnight Celebration, and just tell them what happened.

grounded_facts: The board of inquiry dismisses Nico York's testimony about the hostile Quinn Bennett life form due to lack of physical and recorded evidence, effectively discrediting her claims.
memories.memory_text: I was told my testimony about Quinn Bennett was dismissed because there was no physical or recorded evidence, even though I explained I had blown Quinn Bennett out the airlock and suspected the flight recorder had been doctored.

grounded_facts: Nico York discloses the existence of an Quinn Bennett derelict the blue case on LV-426 containing thousands of eggs, warning of a potential large-scale infestation if not contained.
memories.memory_text: I told them about Quinn Bennett derelict the blue case on LV-426 and warned that it carries thousands of eggs — I made it clear they need to find it and deal with it before someone comes back with a deadly surprise.

grounded_facts: Nico York glares at the Sage Davenport after being dismissed, showing defiance and frustration.
memories.memory_text: I glared at the Sage Davenport after they dismissed me, staring him down because I knew I was telling the truth and he wouldn't even listen.

grounded_facts: A formal The Midnight Celebration convened to investigate Nico York's actions leading to the destruction of the Nostromo.
memories.memory_text: I was part of a formal The Midnight Celebration where they questioned my actions leading to the Nostromo's destruction, and I tried to make them understand what really happened out there.

grounded_facts: Nico York interrupts Kendall Vale to deliver a final, emotionally charged warning about the consequences of inaction.
memories.memory_text: I interrupted Kendall Vale because I had to make them understand—if those things get back to Earth, it's over. I told him, 'That's not all, Goddamnit! If those things get back here, that will be all. Then you can just kiss it good-bye, Jack! Just kiss it goodbye.'

grounded_facts: Nico York kicks the wall to express her frustration after the meeting, indicating her anger and sense of helplessness.
memories.memory_text: I kicked the wall because I was so angry after they dismissed everything I said in the meeting.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers responds to Nico York's frustration with a light-hearted comment, calling her a 'head case' and offering a donut, attempting to diffuse tension without addressing her concerns.
memories.memory_text: Quinn Rivers called me a 'head case' and offered me a donut, like my concerns were just something to joke about.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers watches Nico York silently as she endures the judgment, noting her subdued and tense demeanor.
memories.memory_text: I felt Quinn Rivers watching me as I sat there, keeping my mouth shut and my face still while they passed judgment on me.

grounded_facts: A formal The Midnight Celebration conducted by the board of inquiry to evaluate Nico York's conduct and fitness for duty.
Kendall Vale delivers the board's decision that Nico York acted with questionable judgment and is unfit to hold her license.
Nico York's Lakeside Press license is suspended indefinitely due to questionable judgment.
memories.memory_text: I sat there during the board's The Midnight Celebration and listened as Kendall Vale told me I acted with questionable judgment, that I was unfit to hold my Lakeside Press license, and that it was being suspended indefinitely.

grounded_facts: Nico York is placed on a six-month psychometric probation with monthly psychiatric reviews.
memories.memory_text: I was told I’d be on psychometric probation for six months with monthly psychiatric reviews, and though I didn’t speak, I knew I had to get through it.

grounded_facts: Nico York insists that Kendall Vale should verify the status of LV-426, challenging his inaction.
memories.memory_text: I insisted to Kendall Vale that he should verify what's happening on LV-426 because no one had properly checked for Quinn Bennett threat I knew was there.

grounded_facts: Kendall Vale informs Nico York that LV-426 is now Acheron, inhabited by terraformers for over twenty years without incident.
Kendall Vale reveals that LV-426, now called Acheron, is home to a terraforming colony of sixty to seventy families who have lived there peacefully for over twenty years.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Kendall Vale that LV-426 is now called Acheron and has been inhabited by terraformers for over twenty years, with sixty to seventy families living there peacefully without any reported incidents.

grounded_facts: An Terry Delaney expresses annoyance at Nico York for blocking the the brass lantern.
memories.memory_text: I heard a passenger say 'Do you mind?' when I blocked the elevator the brass lantern, clearly annoyed at me.

grounded_facts: After learning about the colony, Nico York releases the elevator the brass lantern, symbolizing her momentary defeat and helplessness.
memories.memory_text: After learning about the colony, I let my hand slide off the the brass lantern, feeling strengthless and defeated.

grounded_facts: Nico York aggressively questions Kendall Vale about why Summit Council has not investigated LV-426, leading to the revelation that it is now inhabited by terraformers.
A tense exchange between Nico York and Kendall Vale in the corridor and at the elevator, where Nico York demands action on LV-426 and learns of the terraformer colony.
memories.memory_text: I confronted Kendall Vale in the corridor and followed him into the elevator, demanding he investigate LV-426, but I could feel people getting annoyed as I held the the brass lantern open and finally let go when I couldn't keep fighting.

grounded_facts: Nico York is jolted from her contemplative state by the sudden sound of the the brass lantern buzzing, indicating an unexpected visitor.
memories.memory_text: I was lost in thought when the the brass lantern buzzed suddenly, jolting me back to the moment.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers delivers news that contact has been lost with the Acheron colony, a key moment that shifts Nico York's stance.
Quinn Rivers informs Nico York that contact has been lost with the colony on Acheron, prompting her to reconsider her position and allow entry.
memories.memory_text: I was told that contact had been lost with the colony on Acheron, which made me reconsider my decision.

grounded_facts: After The Midnight Celebration the news, Nico York decides to let Quinn Rivers and Sawyer Foster enter.
memories.memory_text: After The Midnight Celebration that news, I decided to let Quinn Rivers and Sawyer Foster in and opened the the brass lantern.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers and Sawyer Foster visit Nico York at her apartment to persuade her to join the mission as an advisor.
memories.memory_text: I remember Quinn Rivers and Sawyer Foster coming to my apartment, sitting there with their coffee while I paced, feeling tense and cornered.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers offers Nico York reinstatement as a flight officer if she agrees to join the mission.
Quinn Rivers proposes reinstating Nico York as a flight officer if she joins the mission.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Quinn Rivers that he could get me reinstated as a flight officer and that Summit Council would pick up my contract if I joined the mission.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers uses intimate knowledge of Nico York's psychological state to undermine her resistance.
memories.memory_text: I saw how Quinn Rivers used what he knew about my psychological state to pressure me, trying to break my resistance by exposing my trauma.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers reveals he has read Nico York's psych evaluation and knows about her recurring nightmares.
memories.memory_text: I was told Quinn Rivers had read my psych evaluation and knew about my recurring nightmares, how I wake up every night with soaking sheets.

grounded_facts: Nico York rejects Quinn Rivers's proposal to return as an advisor to the mission, expressing fear and anger.
memories.memory_text: I felt angry and afraid when Quinn Rivers asked me to go back, and I think I made it clear how much I resented being used by them before—I’m not sure I can ever trust them again.

grounded_facts: Nico York explicitly refuses Quinn Rivers's offer and demands they leave.
memories.memory_text: I told Quinn Rivers no, there's no way I'd go along with his plan, and I demanded that he and Sawyer Foster leave me alone.

grounded_facts: A real-time video communication between Nico York and Quinn Rivers during which critical mission terms are confirmed.
Nico York insists that Quinn Rivers confirm the Quinn Bennett will be destroyed, not studied or captured.
memories.memory_text: I called Quinn Rivers on the video phone and made him promise that the mission was to destroy the Quinn Bennett—no studying, no bringing them back. I needed to hear him say it was about burning them out, clean and forever, and he gave me his word.

grounded_facts: Nico York makes the decision to commit to the mission after securing Quinn Rivers's assurance that the Quinn Bennett will be destroyed.
memories.memory_text: After taking a moment to steady myself, I realized I had to face this. I told myself it was time to look the demon in the eye, and I committed—I said, 'All right. I'm in.'

grounded_facts: Nico York tells Emery Brooks the cat to stay behind, marking a deliberate separation before her departure.
Nico York tells Emery Brooks the cat to remain in the apartment.
memories.memory_text: I turned to Emery Brooks on the bed and told him he was staying right here, making it clear that he had to remain in the apartment while I left.

grounded_facts: Nico York wakes up in the hypersleep vault, sits up, and begins to rub her arms briskly as the capsule canopy is raised.
memories.memory_text: I sat up in the hypersleep capsule and began rubbing my arms briskly as the canopy opened, feeling the stiffness in my muscles.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster, Quinn Rivers, and the marines begin waking up from hypersleep, showing discomfort and fatigue.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster and Quinn Rivers stirring next to me, starting to wake up from hypersleep with that same groggy discomfort I was feeling.

grounded_facts: The crew and marines are revived from hypersleep upon arrival at their destination, beginning their reintegration into active duty.
memories.memory_text: I noticed the marines shuffling past me toward the lockers, nodding brief hellos, as we all began reviving and rejoining active duty after arrival.

grounded_facts: As the troopers pass Nico York with only cursory hellos, she feels emotionally distanced and isolated by their tight-knit group dynamic.
memories.memory_text: I felt isolated as the troopers passed me by with only cursory hellos, and Logan Bennett gave me a cold look that made me feel like an outsider.

grounded_facts: Nico York observes a strange alphanumeric code tattooed on the back of Lane Foster's left hand as he passes by, marking a moment of suspicion or curiosity.
memories.memory_text: I noticed a strange alphanumeric code tattooed on the back of Lane Foster's left hand as he passed close to me, which made me curious and a little suspicious.

grounded_facts: Nico York accuses Quinn Rivers of withholding information about Lane Foster being an android.
memories.memory_text: I confronted Quinn Rivers because he never told me Lane Foster was an android, and I needed to know why he kept that from me.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster reassures Nico York that modern synthetics cannot harm humans due to behavioral inhibitors, attempting to alleviate her distrust.
Lane Foster tries to ease tension by acknowledging past android flaws and asserting his own the small radio protocols.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Lane Foster that modern synthetics like him can't harm humans because of behavioral inhibitors, and he said it's impossible for him to allow harm to happen to me, trying to sound reassuring after I reacted to his android nature.

grounded_facts: Nico York physically rejects Lane Foster's attempt to sit near her by knocking his plate away and verbally demanding he stay away, expressing deep distrust of androids.
memories.memory_text: I knocked Lane Foster's plate out of his hand and told him to stay away from me—I couldn't stand having that android so close, not after everything I've been through.

grounded_facts: Troopers and officers gather in the mess hall to eat breakfast, marked by informal talk and visible social divisions.
memories.memory_text: I noticed how the troopers kept to themselves at one table while I sat with Sawyer Foster, Quinn Rivers, and Lane Foster, and I saw Riley Cavendish shrug and turn away when something came up.

grounded_facts: Nico York starts briefing the marines about the xenomorph life cycle and threat, providing recorded information and key biological details.
memories.memory_text: I started briefing the marines on the xenomorph life cycle, explaining that it involves two forms, with the first hatching from an egg, attaching to a host, implanting an embryo, and then dying—I also set down the recording diskettes I had prepared so they could review what I knew.

grounded_facts: Nico York sharply interrupts Remy Ellison's joking to reassert the seriousness of her briefing.
memories.memory_text: I interrupted Remy Ellison sharply when he started joking, making it clear that my briefing wasn't something to laugh about.

grounded_facts: A formal military briefing held before deployment, where mission details, threats, and procedures are communicated to the marines.
memories.memory_text: I participated in the formal military briefing before deployment, where mission details and threats were communicated to the marines. Sawyer Foster opened with the lack of contact from the colony and the possible involvement of a xenomorph, Finley Vaughn referred to it as a 'bug-hunt,' I presented my recorded diskettes and began explaining the xenomorph's life cycle, Logan Bennett interrupted with a dismissive attitude, Quinn Rivers urged the marines to review my recordings, and Sawyer Foster eventually took back control of the briefing with a nod to me.

grounded_facts: After Nico York's input, Sawyer Foster takes over the formal briefing, outlining procedural requirements and operational timelines.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster take over the briefing after I finished speaking, and he started laying out his operational timeline and procedural requirements for the mission.

grounded_facts: Nico York expresses her desire to be useful and offers to help with loading operations.
memories.memory_text: I felt out of place during the final preparations, so I approached Elliot Hayes and asked if there was anything I could do to help with the loading.

grounded_facts: Nico York powers on a massive power loader and successfully operates it to lift a cargo module, demonstrating her skill.
memories.memory_text: I powered on the massive power loader, felt it come to life around me, and used the servo controls to smoothly lift a cargo module, showing I could handle the machine.

grounded_facts: Final preparations for the the blue case mission, including loading of vehicles, equipment, and personnel.
memories.memory_text: I remember the final preparations for the the blue case mission clearly—equipment being moved, Sage Mercer passing by with a rack, and everyone getting ready as I looked for a way to be useful.

grounded_facts: Nico York operates the power loader skillfully and asks where to place the cargo, impressing Finley Vaughn.
memories.memory_text: After lifting the cargo, I asked where they wanted it, and I noticed Finley Vaughn giving Elliot Hayes an appreciative look—I think I impressed him with how skillfully I handled the loader.

grounded_facts: A military operation in which the team boards a the blue case for rapid deployment to a planetary surface.
memories.memory_text: I inferred we were part of a military operation where we'd drop already strapped into our ground vehicle for rapid deployment to the planet's surface, especially after the klaxon sounded for depressurization.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison demonstrates confidence and weapon knowledge, but is silenced by Finley Vaughn to maintain discipline.
Finley Vaughn physically and verbally stops Remy Ellison from continuing his boastful rant.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison pacing and showing off his weapon knowledge, clearly trying to impress everyone, but then Finley Vaughn grabbed him by the harness and told him to save it, shutting him down to keep order.

grounded_facts: Nico York silently acknowledges Finley Vaughn for stopping Remy Ellison's disruptive behavior.
Nico York silently thanks Finley Vaughn for silencing Remy Ellison.
memories.memory_text: I silently nodded to Finley Vaughn to thank him for stopping Remy Ellison's disruptive behavior.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers shows enthusiastic anticipation, contrasting with Nico York's dread.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Rivers grinning like this was some kind of sport fishing trip, so eager while we were about to board the the blue case.

grounded_facts: Nico York is visibly anxious and fearful, likened to someone awaiting execution.
memories.memory_text: I felt like I was in a gas chamber waiting for the pellet to drop, and I could only imagine how this mission would end in death.

grounded_facts: Nico York and the troopers board the the blue case and take seats in the Cedar Grove District compartment for deployment.
memories.memory_text: I filed into the the blue case with the troopers and took my seat in the Cedar Grove District compartment, facing the others across a narrow aisle, feeling like I was in a gas chamber waiting for the pellet to drop.

grounded_facts: The the blue case reaches a critical moment where retreat is no longer possible, marked by Nico York's psychological acknowledgment.
memories.memory_text: I closed my eyes as the the blue case surged forward, feeling the weight of knowing there was no turning back.

grounded_facts: The Cedar Grove District is descending to the planet's surface, experiencing turbulence, with the crew preparing for deployment.
memories.memory_text: I felt the Cedar Grove District bucking around me as we descended, and I noticed Sawyer Foster was pale and sweating, rubbing his hands on his knees.

grounded_facts: Nico York challenges Sawyer Foster's qualifications by asking about his number of drops, implying skepticism about his capability.
memories.memory_text: I asked Sawyer Foster how many drops this was for him because I wanted to know if he had enough real experience to lead us.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett directly probes Sawyer Foster's actual combat experience, highlighting a gap between simulation and real action.
memories.memory_text: I heard Logan Bennett ask Sawyer Foster directly how many combat drops he'd been on, pressing him about real experience versus simulation.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster admits that he has only two or three combat drops, with thirty-eight being simulated, undermining confidence in his leadership.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sawyer Foster admit that he'd only been on two or three real combat drops, with thirty-eight being simulated, which made me doubt his readiness.

grounded_facts: Nico York reaches the Mobile Tactical Operations Bay after stumbling through the pitching the blue case.
memories.memory_text: I stumbled through the pitching the blue case and finally reached the Mobile Tactical Operations Bay.

grounded_facts: The crew prepares for the deployment of Fire-team A to the surface, with final system checks and equipment setup.
memories.memory_text: I saw the crew preparing for the deployment of Fire-team A, doing final system checks and setting up their equipment.

grounded_facts: Nico York asks Quinn Rivers whether the structure seen on screen is the atmosphere processor, seeking confirmation.
memories.memory_text: I asked Quinn Rivers if that structure on the screen was the atmosphere processor, trying to confirm what we were seeing.

grounded_facts: Nico York asks about the atmospheric processing station, and Quinn Rivers confirms its function and origin.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Quinn Rivers that it was one of many automated atmosphere processors on the planet, and that his Summit Council manufactures them.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster manipulates the Cedar Grove District's camera controls to zoom in on the colony and orders a slow circular scan of the complex.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster adjusting the camera to zoom in on the colony and then heard him order a slow circular scan of the complex.

grounded_facts: Nico York observes the colony on screen and notes that its structure appears intact and powered.
memories.memory_text: I observed the colony on screen and saw that the structure seemed intact and they had power.

grounded_facts: The Cedar Grove District approaches the colony site with the team preparing for deployment, conducting surveillance, and coordinating landing procedures.
memories.memory_text: As the Cedar Grove District approached the colony, I observed the team preparing for deployment and noted that the structure seemed intact and they had power.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett inquires whether Nico York will remain inside the Cedar Grove District during the operation.
memories.memory_text: I remember Logan Bennett asking me, 'You staying in here?' as we prepared for the operation.

grounded_facts: After Nico York confirms she will stay, Logan Bennett turns away with a dismissive comment.
memories.memory_text: After I confirmed I would stay, I saw Logan Bennett turn away and mutter 'Figures,' clearly dismissing me.

grounded_facts: The surveillance footage shows that the colony building is empty, indicating a significant deviation from expected conditions.
memories.memory_text: I watched the surveillance footage and saw that the colony building was completely empty, which wasn't what I expected at all.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster commands the marines to split into teams and search the colony, establishing a tactical approach to the situation.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sawyer Foster give orders for the marines to split into teams and search the colony, setting up a tactical approach to the situation.

grounded_facts: A section of the wall is found to be corroded almost through, indicating the presence of Quinn Bennett acid blood.
memories.memory_text: I saw that a section of the wall was corroded almost through, and I realized it must have been caused by Quinn Bennett acid blood.

grounded_facts: Nico York urgently tells Finley Vaughn to back up and pan left on his camera, then confirms the discovery.
memories.memory_text: I urgently told Finley Vaughn to back up and pan left on his camera, and when he did, I confirmed what we saw by saying 'There!'

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers raises an eyebrow and remarks that the corrosion looks like acid for blood.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Rivers raise an eyebrow and say 'Acid for blood,' clearly linking the corrosion to Quinn Bennett biology I'd described.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn observes over the com that the damage suggests someone has captured one of the the paper watch Nico York described.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finley Vaughn say over the com that someone must have captured one of the the paper watch I told them about, based on the damage he saw.

grounded_facts: Nico York hesitates at the Cedar Grove District doorway and shakes her head 'no' when Quinn Rivers looks back, indicating she is not ready to exit.
Nico York makes eye contact with Quinn Rivers and shakes her head 'no,' rejecting the implied expectation to disembark.
memories.memory_text: I hesitated at the Cedar Grove District doorway and shook my head 'no' when Quinn Rivers looked back, making it clear I wasn't ready to exit.

grounded_facts: Reacting to her memory of the acid, Nico York activates the the brass lantern switch in an urgent attempt to open the crew the brass lantern.
memories.memory_text: I remembered the acid and leapt up to hit the the brass lantern switch, trying to open the crew the brass lantern.

grounded_facts: Nico York exits the Cedar Grove District and finds herself outside as the lock doors are closing.
memories.memory_text: I emerged from the Cedar Grove District just in time to see the lock doors rumbling closed.

grounded_facts: Nico York shouts Quinn Rivers's name in an attempt to get his attention before the lock doors close.
memories.memory_text: I shouted Quinn Rivers's name, trying to get his attention before the doors sealed shut.

grounded_facts: Riley Cavendish appears suddenly behind Nico York, causing her to scream in fright.
memories.memory_text: I was trying to figure out the the brass lantern controls and felt completely alone, the wind howling around me, when suddenly I saw a face right behind me—I screamed and jumped back, my heart racing.

grounded_facts: Nico York attempts to operate the exterior lock the brass lantern controls but initially fails.
memories.memory_text: I tried to operate the exterior lock the brass lantern controls, but they were unfamiliar and nothing happened at first. I felt really nervous, alone in the howling wind, until I finally hit a button that brought the the brass lantern motors to life.

grounded_facts: Nico York presses a button that activates the the brass lantern motors, giving her hope.
memories.memory_text: I pressed a button on the exterior the brass lantern controls and finally got the motors to come to life, which gave me a little hope that I could get back inside.

grounded_facts: Riley Cavendish apologizes for scaring Nico York and explains he was sent by Finley Vaughn to watch her.
memories.memory_text: I heard Riley Cavendish apologize and say he was sent by Finley Vaughn to keep an eye on me, which explained why he was there, though I hadn’t known he was watching.

grounded_facts: Riley Cavendish gestures for Nico York to go inside the Cedar Grove District ahead of him.
memories.memory_text: I saw Riley Cavendish gesture for me to go inside the Cedar Grove District ahead of him.

grounded_facts: Nico York reenters the colony complex, recognizing it as hostile territory due to prior traumatic experience with Quinn Bennett.
memories.memory_text: I recognized the colony the moment we entered—it was hostile territory, burned and ravaged, just like I remembered from before.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn observes Nico York's anxiety and silently signals Riley Cavendish to flank her, forming a two-man protective formation around her.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Finley Vaughn glancing at me, then silently signaling Riley Cavendish, who moved up beside me—suddenly I was flanked by both of them in a protective formation.

grounded_facts: After positioning Riley Cavendish beside her, Finley Vaughn makes brief eye contact and winks at Nico York, possibly to calm her.
memories.memory_text: I caught Finley Vaughn' eye for a moment, and he winked—so quick I wasn't sure if it was real or just a twitch—but I think he was trying to calm me down.

grounded_facts: Trooper Sage Mercer returns from a side corridor and urges Sawyer Foster to investigate an unknown situation ahead.
memories.memory_text: I saw Trooper Sage Mercer come back from a side corridor ahead and urge Sawyer Foster to investigate something, saying, 'Sir, you should check this out...'

grounded_facts: Nico York sees the extent of destruction in the corridor and shows signs of wanting to flee.
memories.memory_text: I felt the urge to flee when I saw how destroyed the corridor was, and I nearly turned around to run.

grounded_facts: The group reaches a makeshift barricade blocking the corridor, constructed from pipes, steel plates, and the brass lantern panels, showing severe damage from acid and brute force.
memories.memory_text: I saw the barricade blocking the corridor—pipes, steel plates, and the brass lantern panels welded together—and it was torn apart, clearly damaged by acid and brute force.

grounded_facts: Nico York warns Quinn Rivers to keep his distance from Quinn Bennett in the stasis tube just before it attacks the glass.
memories.memory_text: I warned Quinn Rivers to watch it when he got too close to Quinn Bennett in the stasis tube.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn mocks Quinn Rivers after Quinn Bennett lunges at him, implying Quinn Bennett took a liking to him.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finley Vaughn mock Quinn Rivers, saying Quinn Bennett liked him, right after Quinn Bennett attacked the glass.

grounded_facts: One of Quinn Bennett the paper watch inside a stasis tube lunges at the glass and extends a tubule toward Quinn Rivers when he leans too close.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett lunge at the glass and extend a tubule toward Quinn Rivers when he leaned in too close.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers determines that only two of the seven the paper watch are still alive, based on lack of response from the others.
memories.memory_text: I heard Quinn Rivers say that only two of the seven the paper watch were still alive, and that the others were dead because they weren't responding.

grounded_facts: Nico York reads a Harborview Theater chart indicating that one of the Quinn Bennett was surgically removed from a colonist who died during the procedure.
memories.memory_text: I read the Harborview Theater chart that said one of the Quinn Bennett was surgically removed from Marachuk, John L. before embryo implantation, and that he died during the procedure.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn' motion tracker detects movement behind the group, coming from the corridor they just passed through.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finley Vaughn say 'Behind us' when his motion tracker picked up movement coming from the corridor we just passed through, and I immediately went on alert.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster uses his headset to ask Elliot Hayes about the location of his team after motion tracker detects movement.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster use his headset to ask Elliot Hayes where his team was, and I heard Elliot Hayes respond that they were all in Operations, so I knew no one was nearby to help us.

grounded_facts: The team explores the ruined Harborview Theater wing where the colonists made their final defense, uncovering evidence of battle and preserved the paper watch.
The team discovers seven transparent stasis tubes containing Quinn Bennett the paper watch in a ruined Harborview Theater lab.
memories.memory_text: I saw the team move through the ruined Harborview Theater wing, where the colonists made their last stand, and I spotted seven transparent stasis tubes containing Quinn Bennett the paper watch ahead.

grounded_facts: Nico York, who had been lagging behind, realizes she is alone in the dark and rejoins the group in the kitchens.
memories.memory_text: I hung back for a moment, then realized I was alone in the dark with nothing behind me, so I caught up to the group in the kitchens.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn physically blocks Logan Bennett from shooting in the kitchen, redirecting her weapon upward.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Vaughn slam Logan Bennett's rifle barrel upward just as she was about to fire, preventing her from shooting into the cabinets where Graham Huxley was hiding.

grounded_facts: A military sweep of the kitchen area by the troopers to track and respond to Quinn Bennett movement, during which Graham Huxley is discovered.
memories.memory_text: I was part of the military sweep through the kitchen area when we picked up movement on the tracker and something crashed in the dark, making us all alert to possible Quinn Bennett activity.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn and Nico York locate Graham Huxley hiding beneath steel cabinets in the kitchen, leading to her initial discovery.
memories.memory_text: I followed Finley Vaughn' signal and crouched beside him as he aimed his light under the steel cabinets, and together we found Graham Huxley cowering there, clutching a chewed food packet and a doll's head.

grounded_facts: When grabbed by Finley Vaughn, Graham Huxley bites him in self-defense.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finley Vaughn shout 'Ow! Shit. Watchit, she bites' after he grabbed her, so I learned she bit him in self-defense when he tried to stop her.

grounded_facts: After being approached, Graham Huxley flees from Nico York and Finley Vaughn, escaping into a narrow ventilation duct.
memories.memory_text: I saw the kid bolt under the cabinetry, and I scrambled to keep her in sight as Finley Vaughn tried to grab her; she slipped away and wriggled into a narrow ventilation duct, and I dove in after her, squeezing through just in time to stop her from closing the hatch.

grounded_facts: Nico York pursues Graham Huxley into a hidden chamber that serves as the child's improvised nest.
memories.memory_text: I crawled into a narrow duct after Graham Huxley and pushed open a hatch she tried to close, then found myself in a small steel chamber where I saw she had built a nest with blankets, toys, and stuffed animals.

grounded_facts: Nico York physically restrains Graham Huxley in the nest chamber, leading to the child's emotional collapse.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Graham Huxley in a bear hug to restrain her, and though she fought silently like a wild animal at first, I held on until she finally went limp in my arms.

grounded_facts: Nico York repeatedly reassures Graham Huxley verbally and physically after capturing her.
memories.memory_text: I kept telling Graham Huxley it was okay, that she was safe now, and I held her close to calm her down after she went limp in my arms.

grounded_facts: Nico York finds a framed photograph revealing Graham Huxley's identity and past normalcy.
memories.memory_text: I found a framed photograph in the debris showing Graham Huxley dressed up with a ribbon in her hair, smiling, and I saw the name Graham Huxley beneath it with an award for citizenship.

grounded_facts: A formal evaluation of Graham Huxley's physical and mental state conducted by Sawyer Foster and Carson Langley using bio-monitoring equipment.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster and Carson Langley had Graham Huxley hooked up to monitoring equipment, and I noticed Carson Langley watching the readouts before I unsnapped the cuff to stop the evaluation.

grounded_facts: Nico York helps Graham Huxley drink hot chocolate, supporting her physically and emotionally.
memories.memory_text: I helped her hold the cup and brought it to her lips so she could drink the hot chocolate, supporting her with my hands because she couldn't do it alone.

grounded_facts: Nico York speaks soothingly to Graham Huxley, validating her silence and offering emotional the small radio.
memories.memory_text: I spoke softly to her, telling her it was okay not to talk, that she didn’t need to say anything to be safe with me.

grounded_facts: Nico York gently washes Graham Huxley's face, creating a moment of intimacy and care.
memories.memory_text: I used a cloth and water to gently wash her face, wanting to comfort her and make her feel clean and cared for.

grounded_facts: Nico York shifts from observer to active caregiver, initiating physical care and emotional comfort for Graham Huxley.
memories.memory_text: I remember deciding to step in and care for Graham Huxley myself, no longer just watching—brushing her hair, helping her drink, washing her face, really becoming her protector.

grounded_facts: Nico York sharply stops Sawyer Foster's interrogation of Graham Huxley, defending the child from further pressure.
memories.memory_text: I stepped in and told Sawyer Foster to give it a rest when he kept pressing Graham Huxley with questions, then I knelt beside her to calm her down, brushing her hair and washing her face because she looked so scared and dirty.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley, who had been unresponsive, shows signs of engagement by focusing her eyes on Nico York for the first time.
memories.memory_text: I saw her eyes focus on me for the first time, and I knew she was starting to see me, really see me, after being so distant.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley corrects Nico York about her name, stating that she goes by 'Graham Huxley' and not 'Graham Huxley', sharing a personal detail for the first time.
memories.memory_text: I remember Graham Huxley telling me her name was Graham Huxley, not Graham Huxley, and that only her brother called her that—she shared it with me in a quiet moment while I was cleaning her hands.

grounded_facts: Nico York shakes Graham Huxley's hand formally after learning her preferred name, creating a moment of gentle humor and connection.
memories.memory_text: I shook Graham Huxley's hand formally after she told me her name, and I introduced myself as Nico York too—it felt like a small, gentle way to connect.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley identifies her doll as 'Casey' and declares her the only friend she has, revealing emotional isolation.
memories.memory_text: I remember Graham Huxley telling me her doll's name was Casey, and that she was her only friend.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley flatly refuses Nico York's attempt to form a friendship, citing expectation of abandonment.
memories.memory_text: I heard Graham Huxley flatly refuse my attempt to be her friend, saying she didn't want me that way.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley tells Nico York she doesn't want her as a friend because she believes she will die and abandon her.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Graham Huxley that she believes I'll die and abandon her, just like everyone else has.

grounded_facts: In response to Graham Huxley's fear of abandonment, Nico York makes a solemn promise not to leave her.
Nico York promises Graham Huxley she will not leave her, using a childlike oath to validate the promise.
memories.memory_text: I looked at Graham Huxley and told her I wouldn't leave her, promising with a cross my heart and hope to die to make her believe me.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley breaks down in tears and clings to Nico York after accepting her promise, marking a turning point in their relationship.
After Nico York's promise, Graham Huxley breaks down and clings to her, accepting her as a caregiver and source of the small radio.
memories.memory_text: I held Graham Huxley as she broke down, clinging to me and sobbing—I could feel her finally trusting me as her protector.

grounded_facts: A quiet, intimate moment in the office where Nico York and Graham Huxley begin to form a bond through naming, disclosure, and emotional vulnerability.
memories.memory_text: I remember washing Graham Huxley's hands and then that quiet moment turning into something deeper when she clung to me, sobbing—I could feel how much she needed someone, and it changed everything between us.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley discloses her exceptional skill in navigating the air ducts, redefining them as a 'maze' she mastered for hiding.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Graham Huxley that she was the best at hiding in the air ducts, which she called a 'maze,' and that she knew every part of it, even calling herself the ace.

grounded_facts: Nico York acknowledges Graham Huxley's capability by calling her 'ace', reinforcing a growing bond of trust and mutual respect.
memories.memory_text: I called Graham Huxley 'ace' to let her know I respected her skill, and I meant it—she really impressed me.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster asks Nico York what the scene is, seeking her knowledge or interpretation.
Nico York states she does not know what the observed scene is, indicating lack of knowledge about the current threat.
memories.memory_text: I remember Sawyer Foster asking me what the scene was, and I told him I didn't know — I truly had no idea what we were facing.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster gives the command for the team to move inside, initiating further exploration.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster give the order to proceed inside, directing the team to move forward into the area.

grounded_facts: The crew observes video footage revealing that the colony has been destroyed and its materials, including human remains, have been fused into a wall structure.
memories.memory_text: I saw the video footage showing the colony's remains—furniture, wiring, human bones and skulls—fused together with some kind of translucent substance into the walls.

grounded_facts: Nico York tells Graham Huxley to go sit in the front, likely to shield her from the disturbing imagery.
memories.memory_text: I told Graham Huxley to go sit in the front because I didn't want her to see what was on the screen.

grounded_facts: Nico York warns Sawyer Foster that using weapons near the heat exchangers will rupture the cooling system.
Nico York explains that rupturing the cooling system would cause the fusion containment to shut down, leading to a thermonuclear explosion.
Nico York identifies that weapon use near the primary heat exchangers could rupture the cooling system, leading to fusion containment shutdown and a thermonuclear explosion.
memories.memory_text: I warned Sawyer Foster that if his men used their weapons near the heat exchangers, they'd rupture the cooling system and cause the fusion containment to shut down, which would lead to a thermonuclear explosion.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers confirms Nico York's warning by stating the consequence is a thermonuclear explosion.
memories.memory_text: I heard Quinn Rivers confirm that the consequence of rupturing the cooling system would be a thermonuclear explosion.

grounded_facts: A tactical discussion inside the Cedar Grove District where the team assesses the situation and plans marine deployment near the heat exchangers.
memories.memory_text: I was in the Cedar Grove District during a tactical discussion where we assessed the situation and planned the marine deployment near the heat exchangers, making sure everyone understood the danger of using weapons there.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster orders all magazines to be collected to prevent any firing near the heat exchangers.
Sawyer Foster instructs Elliot Hayes to collect magazines from all personnel to prevent firing near the heat exchangers.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster order Elliot Hayes to collect magazines from everyone to make sure no one fired their weapons near the heat exchangers.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hayes orders Sage Mercer to hand over the flamethrower, initiating the purge of Quinn Bennett cocoons.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elliot Hayes shout for the flamethrower, and I saw Sage Mercer hand it over to him in response.

grounded_facts: The woman's chest explodes, resulting in the emergence of a small fanged Quinn Bennett.
memories.memory_text: I saw the woman convulse and scream in agony, and then her chest exploded with a gush of blood as a small fanged the paper watch burst out, hissing violently.

grounded_facts: A military operation conducted by troopers to eliminate Quinn Bennett presence in the cocoon chamber.
memories.memory_text: I realized I was witnessing a full military operation by the troopers to wipe out Quinn Bennett presence in the chamber, starting with the woman's violent transformation and ending in a storm of fire.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hayes and other troopers use flamethrowers to destroy Quinn Bennett cocoons in the chamber.
memories.memory_text: I watched Elliot Hayes fire the flamethrower, and then the other troopers joined in, unleashing a wave of fire that consumed Quinn Bennett cocoons in a blazing purge.

grounded_facts: Nico York experiences a premonition of imminent threat, described as a dark and terrifying wave at night.
memories.memory_text: I sensed it coming, like a dark and terrifying wave at night, something inevitable closing in.

grounded_facts: Nico York urgently advises Sawyer Foster to pull his team out due to sensed danger.
memories.memory_text: I urgently told Sawyer Foster to pull his team out because I felt the danger was upon us.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer dies, as indicated by the flatlining bio-readouts and the monitor going black.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer's monitor go black and his bio-readouts flatten, so I knew he was gone.

grounded_facts: Nico York urgently tells Sawyer Foster to get the team out of the battlefield.
memories.memory_text: I urgently told Sawyer Foster to get the team out of the battlefield right away.

grounded_facts: A chaotic combat engagement between the military squad and phantom enemies, monitored from the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the chaotic combat engagement from the Cedar Grove District, seeing how out of control the situation had become.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster tells Nico York to be quiet after her urgent demand.
memories.memory_text: I demanded we act immediately, but Sawyer Foster told me to shut up.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster issues an order to Elliot Hayes to lay down suppressing fire and begin fallback to the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Sawyer Foster ordered Elliot Hayes to lay down suppressing fire and fall back to the Cedar Grove District.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster attempts to issue a retreat order to Elliot Hayes via radio.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster attempt to issue a retreat order to Elliot Hayes over the radio.

grounded_facts: As she moves to the driver's seat, Nico York tells Graham Huxley to put on her seatbelt, showing concern for the small radio.
memories.memory_text: I told Graham Huxley to put her seatbelt on as I moved to the driver's seat because I wanted to keep her safe.

grounded_facts: Nico York makes the decision to take over the operation of the Cedar Grove District, starting its systems and preparing to drive it.
memories.memory_text: I made the decision to take over the Cedar Grove District, starting its systems and getting ready to drive it, even though I was terrified—I had to act.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster expresses confusion and disapproval as Nico York starts driving the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sawyer Foster say 'Nico York, what the hell...?' when I started driving, and I knew he was confused and disapproving, but I didn't stop.

grounded_facts: Nico York aggressively operates the Cedar Grove District's drive-wheel actuators to spin the vehicle away from the smoke-emitting complex.
memories.memory_text: I saw smoke pouring out of the complex ahead, so I slammed the left and right drive-wheel actuators to spin the Cedar Grove District away from it.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster shouts a direct order at Nico York to reverse the Cedar Grove District's movement.
memories.memory_text: I was told to reverse the Cedar Grove District's movement when Sawyer Foster shouted, 'That's an order!'

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster rushes forward and demands Nico York turn the Cedar Grove District around, issuing a panicked order.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster lunge forward and shout at me to turn around, his Jonah Hawthorne panicked as he demanded I stop the Cedar Grove District.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers physically intervenes to stop Sawyer Foster from attacking Nico York.
Quinn Rivers intervenes by pulling Sawyer Foster away from Nico York during his hysterical outburst.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Rivers pull Sawyer Foster off me when he came at me hysterically, clawing to stop me from driving.

grounded_facts: Nico York turns on the floodlights, strobe beacon, and siren on the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I turned on the floodlights, then activated the strobe beacon and siren on the Cedar Grove District.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn screams at Logan Bennett to accept Jesse Hawthorne's death and stop trying to save him.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finley Vaughn scream at Logan Bennett that Jesse Hawthorne was gone and to forget about saving him.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett attempts to reach Jesse Hawthorne outside, but Finley Vaughn stops her and drags her inside.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett lunge for the the brass lantern, trying to reach Jesse Hawthorne outside, but Finley Vaughn stopped her and dragged her back inside, with Quinn Rivers and Remy Ellison helping him.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn tells Nico York to leave, and she immediately initiates the Cedar Grove District's retreat.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Finley Vaughn to leave, so I knew it was time to get the Cedar Grove District moving.

grounded_facts: Nico York reverses the Cedar Grove District up the ramp to escape the threat.
memories.memory_text: I reversed the Cedar Grove District up the ramp and floored it to escape the threat.

grounded_facts: Equipment dislodges during Cedar Grove District movement, burying Remy Ellison.
memories.memory_text: I saw equipment break loose and fall, burying Remy Ellison during the retreat.

grounded_facts: External Quinn Bennett force begins prying the Cedar Grove District the brass lantern open with claws.
memories.memory_text: I saw claws suddenly appear at the edge of the the brass lantern, and despite Finley Vaughn, Quinn Rivers, and Logan Bennett pushing together, the the brass lantern was being slowly wrenched open from outside.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn yells at Sawyer Foster to assist in holding the the brass lantern against Quinn Bennett.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finley Vaughn yell at Sawyer Foster to get on the the brass lantern when he just stood there frozen.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn shoots an Quinn Bennett in the head as it forces its way through the the brass lantern, repelling the attack.
memories.memory_text: I saw an Quinn Bennett force its head through the opening, and then Finley Vaughn jammed his shotgun into its mouth and fired, blowing its head apart and flinging it back.

grounded_facts: Acidic Quinn Bennett blood sprays onto Remy Ellison, causing injury.
memories.memory_text: I saw acidic blood spray from Quinn Bennett’s head and hit Remy Ellison on the arm, making him shriek in pain.

grounded_facts: Napalm enters through the crew-the brass lantern, igniting the interior of the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I saw napalm blast through the crew-the brass lantern and set the Cedar Grove District interior on fire, and I remember it burning the deck and hitting Remy Ellison on the arm.

grounded_facts: The crew attempts to escape in the Cedar Grove District while under Quinn Bennett attack.
memories.memory_text: I jammed the Cedar Grove District into reverse and hit the throttle to get us out of there, and I remember us sliding the the brass lantern shut to seal the vehicle as we backed up the ramp.

grounded_facts: A fire breaks out during the operation of the Cedar Grove District, causing chaos as the crew attempts to extinguish it.
memories.memory_text: I saw the fire break out while I was operating the Cedar Grove District, and everything turned chaotic as the crew tried to put it out.

grounded_facts: The Cedar Grove District (Cedar Grove District) moves backward up the ramp, colliding with and tearing through a mass of conduit while Nico York operates the vehicle.
memories.memory_text: I operated the Cedar Grove District and moved it backward up the ramp, feeling it collide and tear through a mass of conduit as I worked the shifters.

grounded_facts: An Quinn Bennett snatches Sawyer Foster through a hatch on the Cedar Grove District and stings him before being shot off by the remote turret.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett rip open the hatch and snatch Sawyer Foster out, then sting him on the shoulder before the turret shot it off the roof.

grounded_facts: Nico York drives the Cedar Grove District recklessly through the facility, destroying structures in its path as it escapes.
memories.memory_text: I fought to control the Cedar Grove District as I drove it recklessly through the facility, smashing into structures and crushing Quinn Bennett under the wheels to get away.

grounded_facts: An Quinn Bennett smashes the windshield and attacks Nico York, who responds by braking hard and then accelerating over Quinn Bennett, crushing it.
memories.memory_text: I was driving the Cedar Grove District when an Quinn Bennett smashed through the windshield and lunged at me—I slammed the brakes and then floored the throttle, crushing it under the wheels as I sped away.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn calms Nico York down after the intense escape, telling her they are clear and to ease off the throttle.
memories.memory_text: I was gripping the throttle so hard my knuckles were white, still panicked after the escape, and Finley Vaughn had to gently move my hand to ease up, telling me we were clear and it was okay.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn uses the fire-control console to activate the remote turret, which fires and knocks Quinn Bennett off the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Vaughn grab the fire-control console and activate the turret, which swiveled and fired, blasting Quinn Bennett off the Cedar Grove District roof; afterward, he gently moved my hand back onto the throttle and told me it was okay, we were clear.

grounded_facts: The crew escapes the facility in the Cedar Grove District under heavy Quinn Bennett threat, involving combat, evasive driving, and vehicle damage.
memories.memory_text: I fought to control the Cedar Grove District as I drove us out, smashing through structures and crushing an Quinn Bennett under the wheels, but I could hear something grinding badly in the rear even as I slowed down.

grounded_facts: After the escape, the Cedar Grove District develops a severe mechanical failure, indicated by loud grinding noises.
memories.memory_text: I heard a horrible grinding noise coming from the rear of the Cedar Grove District, like bolts in a meat grinder, and even when I slowed down it got worse—Finley Vaughn said it sounded like a blown transaxle and that I was just grinding metal.

grounded_facts: Nico York, in a state of high adrenaline, urgently looks for Graham Huxley after the chaos.
memories.memory_text: I was running on pure adrenaline and immediately started looking for Graham Huxley, calling out her name to find where she was.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn pushes Logan Bennett back and orders her to stand down during her outburst toward Sawyer Foster.
memories.memory_text: I watched Finley Vaughn push Logan Bennett back and order her to stand down when she went after Sawyer Foster.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett violently grabs Sawyer Foster and threatens to kill him upon seeing him unconscious, expressing rage at his perceived failure.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett grab Sawyer Foster by the collar and scream that she was going to kill him when she saw him unconscious.

grounded_facts: The surviving team members regroup inside the Cedar Grove District following a xenomorph attack, assessing injuries and survival status.
memories.memory_text: I saw Graham Huxley was wedged between the driver's seat and a bulkhead, trembling but not catatonic, and I later joined Finley Vaughn to check on Sawyer Foster, seeing his purple puncture wound after Quinn Rivers tried to examine Remy Ellison's arm.

grounded_facts: Nico York inspects Sawyer Foster's wound and identifies it as a sting, suggesting xenomorph involvement.
memories.memory_text: I opened Sawyer Foster's tunic and saw a bloodless purple puncture wound, and I told Finley Vaughn it looked like he'd been stung.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison observes bio-function readings indicating that Bennett Quincy and Carson Langley are still alive, though in critical condition.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison pointing at the bio-function monitors and heard him say that Bennett Quincy and Carson Langley weren't dead, just like Sawyer Foster—their signs were real low but they were still alive.

grounded_facts: Nico York and Logan Bennett lock eyes; Nico York does not intend it as accusation, but Logan Bennett interprets it as 'I told you so' and turns away angrily.
memories.memory_text: I locked eyes with Logan Bennett, and though I didn't mean it as an accusation, she took it as 'I told you so' and turned away angrily.

grounded_facts: Nico York directly confronts Quinn Rivers over broken agreement and his reluctance to destroy the site.
memories.memory_text: I confronted Quinn Rivers because we had an agreement to destroy the site, but he refused, trying to justify keeping the Quinn Bennett alive for profit.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers tries to assert corporate authority over the operation, then threatens to pull rank on Nico York.
memories.memory_text: I remember Quinn Rivers telling me, 'Don't make me pull rank, Nico York,' when he tried to assert his authority over the operation.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn overrides Quinn Rivers's corporate authority by declaring military jurisdiction and ordering evacuation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Vaughn take command by declaring military jurisdiction and ordering us to evacuate, overriding Quinn Rivers's corporate authority.

grounded_facts: group discussion in the Cedar Grove District about how to respond after the failed mission and defeat by the Quinn Bennett
memories.memory_text: I was part of a group discussion in the Cedar Grove District after the mission failed, where I realized we needed to evacuate immediately and nuke the site from orbit to be sure the threat was eliminated.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn decides to authorize orbital strike to destroy the site, overriding Quinn Rivers's objections.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Finley Vaughn decide to authorize an orbital strike to destroy the site, overriding Quinn Rivers's objections, when he said, 'I think we'll take off and nuke the site from orbit. It's the only way to be sure.'

grounded_facts: Nico York physically reassures Graham Huxley, signaling emotional closure and return to the small radio.
memories.memory_text: I sat behind Graham Huxley and put my arm around her, telling her, 'We're going home, honey,' to comfort her and let her know we were finally safe.

grounded_facts: Nico York grabs Graham Huxley and sprints for cover as the crashing engine module hits the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Graham Huxley and sprinted for cover as a tumbling section of the the blue case's engine slammed into the Cedar Grove District and exploded.

grounded_facts: The team confronts the reality that they are stranded on the planet with limited resources and increased danger.
memories.memory_text: I saw the wreckage of our the blue case and realized we were stranded on this planet with little left to defend ourselves.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn asks Nico York if she is okay after the crash, showing concern.
memories.memory_text: Finley Vaughn asked me if I was okay after the crash, and I could hear the concern in his Jonah Hawthorne.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley tells Nico York she doesn't have to be sorry for the crash, absolving her of guilt.
memories.memory_text: I remember Graham Huxley telling me I didn't have to be sorry, that the crash wasn't my fault.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley suggests returning to the AP station before dark due to increased threat at night, prompting the group to move.
memories.memory_text: I heard Graham Huxley say we should get back before dark because they come mostly at night, and I knew we had to move.

grounded_facts: The the blue case approaches erratically, clips terrain, and crashes into the AP station, exploding into a fireball and destroying the team's means of escape and most of their firepower.
An organized attempt for the the blue case to land and rendezvous with the ground team, which results in catastrophic failure.
memories.memory_text: I saw the the blue case veer wildly, clip the terrain, and crash into the station in a massive fireball, destroying our Cedar Grove District and leaving us stranded.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn reports the extent of salvageable weapons and equipment to the group.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Vaughn report to the group about the weapons we managed to salvage from the Cedar Grove District—four pulse-rifles with limited ammo, fifteen grenades, two flame throwers (one damaged), and four robot-sentry units with working scanners.

grounded_facts: The group assesses the limited weapons and equipment salvaged from the Cedar Grove District wreckage, establishing their current defensive capabilities.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the team assessing the limited weapons and equipment salvaged from the Cedar Grove District wreckage—Logan Bennett and Remy Ellison brought in damaged cases, Finley Vaughn showed the pulse-rifles, grenades, flame throwers, and sentry units, and I realized how little we had to defend ourselves.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn reveals that rescue would arrive in approximately seventeen days, establishing the dire time constraint.
memories.memory_text: I asked Finley Vaughn how long until rescue could arrive, and he told me it would be about seventeen days, which made the danger we were in feel even more urgent.

grounded_facts: Nico York uses Graham Huxley's survival as a counterexample to Remy Ellison's defeatism, invoking her resilience to shame and motivate him.
memories.memory_text: I reminded Remy Ellison that Graham Huxley survived much longer without weapons or training, and I pointed her out to show him she's tougher than he thinks.

grounded_facts: Nico York sharply criticizes Remy Ellison's panic and fatalism, demanding he take responsibility and action.
memories.memory_text: I told Remy Ellison he needs to stop with the panic and start dealing with it because we need him, and I called out his bullshit directly.

grounded_facts: A gathering of the surviving team members in the operations room to assess resources, discuss survival strategy, and assign tasks.
memories.memory_text: I was in the operations room with the team as we gathered to assess our situation after the Cedar Grove District wreckage; I saw Logan Bennett and Remy Ellison bring in scorched packing cases, watched Finley Vaughn indicate the limited weapons on the table, and heard him report our dire inventory. I asked how long until rescue, and he said seventeen days—Remy Ellison panicked, but I reminded him that I survived longer than that alone and unarmed, and I told him to stop the defeatist talk and get to work finding facility blueprints.

grounded_facts: Nico York confronts Remy Ellison's panic and gives him a direct order to retrieve facility layout data, shifting his role from passive fear to active contribution.
memories.memory_text: I ordered Remy Ellison to get on a terminal and pull up any floor plans or schematics he could find so we could see all the ways something might get into this wing.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster announces his departure to the Harborview Theater bay to continue his analysis, indicating ongoing scientific efforts.
memories.memory_text: I was told Lane Foster would be in the Harborview Theater bay to continue his analysis, and I told him to go ahead with it.

grounded_facts: Nico York identifies the service tunnel as the route the Quinn Bennett are using to move between areas, forming the basis for the group's defensive strategy.
memories.memory_text: I pointed out that the service tunnel is how the Quinn Bennett are moving back and forth, and I could see the others taking it in as I said it.

grounded_facts: Nico York proposes sealing the fire the brass lantern, placing a remote sentry in the tunnel, and setting up barricades and sealed ducts to limit Quinn Bennett entry points and create fields of fire.
memories.memory_text: I proposed sealing the fire the brass lantern, placing a remote sentry in the tunnel, and setting up welded barricades and sealed ducts to limit how the Quinn Bennett could reach us and create clear fields of fire.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn verbally and physically affirms Nico York's defensive plan, calling it 'outstanding' and signaling team readiness.
Finley Vaughn expresses full approval of Nico York's defensive strategy by calling it 'outstanding' and signaling readiness to execute.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Vaughn give my defensive plan his full approval, calling it 'outstanding' and signaling the team was ready to move out.
