grounded_facts: Nico York reaches the Mobile Tactical Operations Bay after stumbling due to the the blue case's movement.
memories.memory_text: I stumbled as the the blue case moved, then made my way forward to the Mobile Tactical Operations Bay where I joined Quinn Rivers and watched over Sawyer Foster's shoulder.

grounded_facts: Nico York identifies the atmosphere processor station on screen and learns it is one of many automated units manufactured by Weyland-Yutani.
memories.memory_text: I saw the atmosphere processor on screen and figured it was one of many automated units made by Weyland-Yutani, though I wasn't completely sure.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers explains that the atmosphere processor is automated and manufactured by their Summit Council.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Quinn Rivers that the atmosphere processor is automated and made by their Summit Council.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett asks Nico York if she is staying in the Cedar Grove District, to which Nico York confirms; Logan Bennett responds dismissively.
memories.memory_text: I was in the Cedar Grove District when Logan Bennett asked if I was staying inside, and I told her, 'You bet.' She just responded with 'Figures,' in a way that made it clear she thought my role wasn't important.

grounded_facts: Nico York urgently tells Finley Vaughn to back up and pan left on his camera, then plugs in her headset to communicate directly.
memories.memory_text: I urgently told Finley Vaughn to back up and pan left on his camera, then I plugged in my headset to make sure he heard me.

grounded_facts: A section of the wall is found to be corroded almost through, indicating the presence of Quinn Bennett acid blood.
memories.memory_text: I saw that a section of the wall was corroded almost through, and I realized it must have been caused by Quinn Bennett acid blood.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers raises an eyebrow and remarks on the corrosive damage, referencing the known trait of xenomorphs having acidic blood.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Rivers raise an eyebrow at me and say, 'Hmm. Acid for blood,' after looking at the corrosion damage.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn observes the melted appearance and suggests that one of Nico York's 'bad guys'—an Quinn Bennett—has been captured or killed here.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finley Vaughn comment that someone must have bagged one of my 'bad guys' here, pointing to the melted area.

grounded_facts: Nico York hesitates in the Cedar Grove District doorway, makes eye contact with Quinn Rivers, and shakes her head 'no,' indicating she is not ready to enter the colony structure.
Nico York makes eye contact with Quinn Rivers and shakes her head 'no' to indicate she is not ready to exit the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I hesitated in the Cedar Grove District doorway, made eye contact with Quinn Rivers, and shook my head 'no' because I wasn't ready to go out there.

grounded_facts: Reacting to her memory of the acid, Nico York abruptly stands and activates the the brass lantern switch, attempting to open the Cedar Grove District the brass lantern.
memories.memory_text: I suddenly remembered the acid and leapt up to hit the the brass lantern switch, trying to open the Cedar Grove District the brass lantern.

grounded_facts: Nico York exits the Cedar Grove District and finds herself outside as the lock doors are closing.
memories.memory_text: I emerged from the Cedar Grove District just in time to see the lock doors rumbling shut.

grounded_facts: Nico York shouts Quinn Rivers's name, but the wind carries her Jonah Hawthorne away.
memories.memory_text: I shouted for Quinn Rivers, but the wind carried my Jonah Hawthorne away before he could hear me.

grounded_facts: Nico York attempts to operate the exterior lock the brass lantern controls but initially fails.
memories.memory_text: I tried to operate the exterior lock the brass lantern controls, but at first nothing happened when I pressed the buttons.

grounded_facts: Nico York successfully activates the the brass lantern motors with a button press.
memories.memory_text: I pressed another button and finally got the the brass lantern motors to activate, which made me relax a little.

grounded_facts: Riley Cavendish appears suddenly behind Nico York, causing her to scream in fright.
memories.memory_text: I was alone outside, struggling with the wind and trying to figure out the the brass lantern controls, when suddenly a face appeared right behind me—I screamed and jumped back in shock.

grounded_facts: Riley Cavendish apologizes for scaring Nico York and explains he was sent by Finley Vaughn to watch her.
memories.memory_text: I heard Riley Cavendish say he was sorry for scaring me and that Finley Vaughn had sent him to keep an eye on me.

grounded_facts: Riley Cavendish gestures for Nico York to go inside first.
memories.memory_text: I saw Riley Cavendish gesture for me to go inside first, so I moved ahead of him through the the brass lantern.

grounded_facts: The group advances into the interior of the colony complex, navigating damaged areas and maintaining tactical awareness.
memories.memory_text: I caught up with the others as we moved into the bowels of the complex, staying alert as we advanced through the damaged areas.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster remarks that Quinn Rivers's Summit Council can write off its share of the colony, implying total loss.
memories.memory_text: I overheard Sawyer Foster say to Quinn Rivers that his Summit Council could write off its share of the colony, implying it was a total loss.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers dismisses the destruction of the colony by stating it is insured, showing lack of concern.
memories.memory_text: I heard Quinn Rivers respond coolly that the colony was insured, showing he didn't care about the destruction.

grounded_facts: Nico York re-enters the colony complex, recognizing it as 'Quinn Bennett country,' indicating a psychologically significant and dangerous environment.
memories.memory_text: I realized I was back in Quinn Bennett country—this place felt dangerous and familiar, the administration complex ravaged by fire and destruction.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn notices Nico York's nervousness and signals Riley Cavendish to flank her, forming a two-man protective cordon.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Finley Vaughn seeing me look around nervously, and then he subtly signaled Riley Cavendish to move in beside me, forming a two-man protective cordon on either side.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn gives Nico York a quick wink, possibly to reassure her, though it is subtle enough to be ambiguous.
memories.memory_text: I glanced at Finley Vaughn and thought I saw him wink at me, but it was so quick I'm not sure if it was real or just something in his eye.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer emerges from a side corridor and alerts Sawyer Foster that something requires immediate attention.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer emerge from a side corridor and alert Sawyer Foster that something required immediate attention.

grounded_facts: Nico York sees the extent of destruction and shows signs of wanting to flee.
memories.memory_text: I saw the destruction and felt my body tense, realizing I wanted to turn and run.

grounded_facts: The group reaches a makeshift barricade blocking the corridor, constructed from pipes, steel plates, and the brass lantern panels, showing severe damage from acid and brute force.
memories.memory_text: I approached the barricade with the group—it was made of pipes, steel plates, and the brass lantern panels, all torn apart by acid and force.

grounded_facts: Nico York warns Quinn Rivers to keep his distance from the stasis tube as he leans too close.
memories.memory_text: I warned Quinn Rivers to watch it as he leaned too close to the stasis tube.

grounded_facts: One of Quinn Bennett specimens in stasis lunges at the glass and extends a tubule toward Quinn Rivers when he leans too close.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett specimen lunge at the glass and extend a tubule toward Quinn Rivers when he got too close.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn makes a sarcastic remark implying Quinn Bennett specimen is attracted to Quinn Rivers after it reacts to him.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finley Vaughn say 'It likes you' in a sarcastic tone after Quinn Bennett reacted to Quinn Rivers.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers determines that only two of the seven the paper watch are still alive.
memories.memory_text: I heard Quinn Rivers say that only two of Quinn Bennett specimens were still alive, after checking the stasis units.

grounded_facts: Nico York reads a Harborview Theater chart revealing that one specimen was surgically removed from a colonist who died during the procedure.
memories.memory_text: I read the Harborview Theater chart and saw that they removed Quinn Bennett from Marachuk, John L., but he died during the procedure—I realized they killed him trying to get it off.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn' motion tracker detects movement behind the group, indicating a possible threat in the corridor.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finley Vaughn say 'Behind us' when his motion tracker picked up movement, and I immediately knew we might be facing a threat from the corridor.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster uses his headset to confirm the location of Elliot Hayes's team after detecting motion behind them.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster use his headset to check on Elliot Hayes's team after the alert, and I heard him confirm they were all in Operations, so I knew the movement behind us wasn't from friendly forces.

grounded_facts: The team explores the devastated Harborview Theater wing, uncovering evidence of a last stand and the paper watch in stasis.
The team discovers seven stasis tubes containing preserved the paper watch in a ruined Harborview Theater lab.
memories.memory_text: I saw something in the ruined Harborview Theater lab and called the team's attention to it when I said 'Over there.' I remember moving toward the source with Finley Vaughn and the others, discovering seven stasis tubes containing the paper watch—some of them still alive.

grounded_facts: Nico York, who had been lagging behind, realizes she is alone in the dark and rejoins the group in the kitchens.
memories.memory_text: I realized I was alone in the dark after hanging back, so I caught up to the group in the kitchens.

grounded_facts: A military sweep of the kitchen area by Finley Vaughn, Logan Bennett, and the squad, during which Graham Huxley is discovered and rescued by Nico York.
memories.memory_text: I was there when we swept the kitchen and I heard something move in the dark before spotting Graham Huxley—I knew I had to reach her and get her out safely.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn physically blocks Logan Bennett's weapon from firing into the ceiling, preventing potential danger but drawing her anger.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Vaughn slam Logan Bennett's rifle barrel upward just as she was about to fire, sending tracers into the ceiling, and I heard her shout at him in anger.

grounded_facts: When Finley Vaughn grabs Graham Huxley's ankle, she bites him in a reflexive act of fear and self-defense.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Vaughn grab Graham Huxley's ankle, and she bit him out of fear—I could tell she was just trying to defend herself.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn and Nico York locate Graham Huxley hiding beneath steel cabinets in the kitchen, leading to Nico York's decision to pursue her into a ventilation duct.
memories.memory_text: I found Graham Huxley hiding under the cabinets in the kitchen, and when she ran, I dove into the duct after her to keep her from getting away.

grounded_facts: Nico York chases Graham Huxley into a narrow ventilation duct, squeezing through to catch her before she escapes into a hidden chamber.
memories.memory_text: I chased Graham Huxley into a narrow ventilation duct, squeezing through the tight space to catch her before she could escape into a hidden chamber.

grounded_facts: Nico York discovers a makeshift child's nest filled with foraged items, revealing Graham Huxley's survival strategies and psychological state.
memories.memory_text: I discovered a child's nest in a tiny steel chamber, filled with blankets, toys, and stuffed animals, and realized how long she must have been surviving alone down here.

grounded_facts: Nico York repeatedly soothes Graham Huxley while attempting to reach her, then after capture continues verbal reassurance despite the child's silence.
memories.memory_text: I kept soothing her, telling her it was okay and that she was safe, even after she went silent in my arms, because I needed her to know I wasn't going to hurt her.

grounded_facts: After initial resistance, Nico York physically restrains Graham Huxley, who then becomes unresponsive, indicating severe trauma.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed the girl to stop her from escaping, and after she struggled silently, she went completely limp and unresponsive, her eyes wide and trembling—clearly lost in some terrible trauma.

grounded_facts: Nico York discovers a framed photograph of a healthy, smiling Graham Huxley with a school award, contrasting her current traumatized state.
memories.memory_text: I found a framed photograph of a little girl named Graham Huxley, smiling and dressed up with a ribbon in her hair, holding a school award that said 'First Grade Citizenship Award'—it struck me how different she looked from the terrified child I’d just encountered.

grounded_facts: A Harborview Theater evaluation of Graham Huxley using bio-monitoring equipment, conducted by Carson Langley and observed by Sawyer Foster.
memories.memory_text: I saw Carson Langley and Sawyer Foster conducting a Harborview Theater evaluation on Graham Huxley with that bio-monitoring cuff, and I noticed how uncomfortable she looked, so I stepped in.

grounded_facts: Nico York sharply stops Sawyer Foster from pressuring Graham Huxley to speak, defending the child.
memories.memory_text: I sharply told Sawyer Foster to stop pressing Graham Huxley, then knelt beside her to comfort her, brushing her hair and telling her it was okay not to talk.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley, who had been unresponsive, shows signs of engagement by focusing her eyes on Nico York for the first time.
memories.memory_text: I saw Graham Huxley's eyes focus on me for the first time, and in that moment, I knew she was starting to see me.

grounded_facts: Nico York gently feeds and cleans Graham Huxley, establishing a bond through nurturing behavior.
memories.memory_text: I gently brushed the hair from Graham Huxley's face, helped her drink from the cup, wiped her chin, and cleaned her face with a cloth, trying to reach the little girl beneath all the grime.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley corrects Nico York about her name, stating she prefers 'Graham Huxley' over 'Graham Huxley'.
memories.memory_text: I heard Graham Huxley tell me that her name is Graham Huxley, not Graham Huxley, and that nobody calls her Graham Huxley except her dork brother, so I made sure to use the name she preferred.

grounded_facts: Nico York shakes Graham Huxley's hand and introduces herself by name in a gentle, playful manner.
memories.memory_text: I gently washed Graham Huxley's hands and then shook her hand, introducing myself by saying, 'My name's Nico York...and people call me Nico York,' in a playful way to make her feel more at ease.

grounded_facts: A moment of mutual name exchange between Nico York and Graham Huxley, establishing personal identity and connection.
memories.memory_text: I called her Graham Huxley at first, but then we exchanged names properly—she told me she goes by Graham Huxley, and I told her my name is Nico York, which helped us start forming a real connection.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley reveals that her doll is named Casey and is her only friend.
memories.memory_text: I remember Graham Huxley telling me her doll's name is Casey, and that she's her only friend.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley flatly states she does not want Nico York as a friend due to anticipated abandonment.
memories.memory_text: I heard Graham Huxley say she doesn't want me as a friend because she believes I'll leave and die like the others, and that I'll leave her alone.

grounded_facts: Nico York makes a solemn promise to Graham Huxley that she will not leave her.
memories.memory_text: I made a solemn promise to Graham Huxley that I won't leave her, crossing my heart and saying 'and hope to die' to show her I mean it.

grounded_facts: After Nico York's promise, Graham Huxley breaks down sobbing and clings to her, showing deep emotional release.
memories.memory_text: I held Graham Huxley as she sobbed and clung to me, her tears rolling down her face as I rocked her, feeling the weight of her fear and grief release in waves.

grounded_facts: A pivotal emotional exchange where Graham Huxley expresses her fear of abandonment and Nico York responds with a promise.
memories.memory_text: I remember Graham Huxley telling me she didn't want me for a friend because she was afraid I'd leave and die like the others, so I promised her I wouldn't leave her, and she broke down and clung to me, crying in my arms.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley discloses her exceptional skill in navigating the air ducts, redefining them as a 'maze' she mastered for hiding.
memories.memory_text: I remember Graham Huxley telling me she was the best at hiding in the air ducts, that she knew the whole maze and called herself the ace.

grounded_facts: Nico York acknowledges Graham Huxley's skill with a term of endearment and admiration.
memories.memory_text: I called her 'ace' and told her she's really something, because I was impressed by how brave and skilled she was.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster asks Nico York to identify the entity she is observing.
memories.memory_text: I was asked by Sawyer Foster what the entity was, and I remember him saying, 'What is it?'

grounded_facts: Nico York states she does not know what the observed entity is, indicating lack of identification or recognition.
memories.memory_text: I told Sawyer Foster I don't know what the entity is because I truly didn't recognize it.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster directs the team to move forward into the area despite uncertainty about the situation.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sawyer Foster tell the team to proceed inside, even though we didn't know what we were facing.

grounded_facts: The crew discovers that the colony has been destroyed and its materials, including human remains, have been fused into a wall structure by a resin-like substance.
memories.memory_text: I saw the video footage showing how the colony was destroyed, with human remains and debris fused into the walls by a resin-like substance, and I realized the colonists had been killed and turned into part of the structure.

grounded_facts: Nico York tells Graham Huxley to go sit in the front, likely to shield her from the disturbing imagery.
memories.memory_text: I told Graham Huxley to go sit in the front because I didn't want her seeing what was on that screen.

grounded_facts: The woman's chest explodes, resulting in the emergence of a small fanged Quinn Bennett.
memories.memory_text: I saw the woman convulse and scream in agony before her chest suddenly exploded, and a small fanged Quinn Bennett emerged, hissing violently.

grounded_facts: A military team engages Quinn Bennett threats in a chamber filled with cocoons, leading to chaotic combat and environmental degradation.
memories.memory_text: I experienced the full horror of Quinn Bennett birth and the immediate military response—convulsions, a chest explosion, a fanged the paper watch emerging, and then an inferno of flamethrower fire consuming the cocoons in a chaotic, desperate purge.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hayes and other troopers use flamethrowers to destroy the cocoons in the chamber.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Elliot Hayes and the other troopers open fire with flamethrowers, unleashing a wave of fire that destroyed the cocoons and plunged the chamber into chaotic combat.

grounded_facts: Nico York perceives a looming threat, described as a dark and terrifying wave at night, indicating an intuitive realization of imminent danger.
memories.memory_text: I sensed it coming, like a wave at night—dark, terrifying, and inevitable.

grounded_facts: Nico York urgently advises Sawyer Foster to pull his team out due to sensed danger.
memories.memory_text: I told Sawyer Foster to pull his team out because I knew we were in danger.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer dies, as indicated by the flatlining bio-readouts and the monitor going black.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer's monitor go black and his bio-readouts flatten, so I knew he was dead.

grounded_facts: Nico York forcefully urges Sawyer Foster to extract the team from the battlefield.
memories.memory_text: I urgently told Sawyer Foster to get the team out of there immediately.

grounded_facts: As she moves to the driver's seat, Nico York tells Graham Huxley to put on her seatbelt, showing concern amid urgency.
memories.memory_text: I told Graham Huxley to put on her seatbelt as I passed her, wanting to keep her safe while I moved fast.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster reacts with confusion and disapproval as Nico York takes control of the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster react with confusion and disapproval when I took the driver's seat, but I didn't stop.

grounded_facts: Nico York decides to take action by taking over the driver's seat of the Cedar Grove District and starting its systems, despite Sawyer Foster's paralysis and protest.
memories.memory_text: I decided I had to act, so I pushed past Sawyer Foster, got into the driver's seat, started flipping switches, and slammed the Cedar Grove District into gear.

grounded_facts: Nico York aggressively operates the Cedar Grove District's drive-wheel actuators to spin the vehicle around, redirecting it away from the smoke-emitting complex.
memories.memory_text: I saw smoke pouring out of the complex ahead, so I slammed the left and right drive-wheel actuators to spin the Cedar Grove District around and get us away from it.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster rushes forward and demands Nico York turn the Cedar Grove District around, issuing a panicked order as he loses control of the situation.
Sawyer Foster shouts at Nico York, accusing her of disobedience and demanding she turn the Cedar Grove District around, asserting his authority in a moment of crisis.
memories.memory_text: I remember Sawyer Foster rushing forward and shouting at me, demanding I turn the Cedar Grove District around with panicked orders, accusing me of disobedience and trying to assert his authority.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers physically pulls Sawyer Foster away from Nico York after Sawyer Foster becomes hysterical and attempts to interfere with her operation of the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I felt Sawyer Foster claw at me in a hysterical attempt to stop me, but Quinn Rivers pulled him off me and got him away.

grounded_facts: The Cedar Grove District enters Quinn Bennett structure with floodlights, strobe beacon, and siren activated, moving toward the source of weapons fire.
memories.memory_text: I activated the floodlights, strobe beacon, and siren as we drove the Cedar Grove District into Quinn Bennett structure, heading toward the source of the weapons fire.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett attempts to reach Jesse Hawthorne outside, but Finley Vaughn stops and drags her inside.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett lunge for the opening, trying to reach Jesse Hawthorne outside, but Finley Vaughn stopped her and dragged her back inside.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett irrationally insists that Jesse Hawthorne is still alive despite Finley Vaughn' assertion.
memories.memory_text: I heard Logan Bennett insist, almost desperately, that Jesse Hawthorne was still alive even after Finley Vaughn tried to tell her otherwise.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn instructs Nico York to initiate Cedar Grove District retreat.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Finley Vaughn to initiate the Cedar Grove District retreat when he said, 'Let's go!'

grounded_facts: Nico York reverses the Cedar Grove District up the ramp to escape the threat.
memories.memory_text: I reversed the Cedar Grove District up the ramp to escape, jamming reverse and nailing the throttle as the vehicle bellowed backward.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn shoots an Quinn Bennett in the head as it enters through the the brass lantern, repelling the attack.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett's head force its way through the the brass lantern, and then Finley Vaughn jammed his shotgun into its mouth and fired, blowing its head apart and sending it flying back.

grounded_facts: Spray of Quinn Bennett acid blood hits Remy Ellison, causing injury.
memories.memory_text: I saw the spray of acid blood hit Remy Ellison on the arm, and he screamed in pain as it burned into him.

grounded_facts: The crew successfully closes and locks the Cedar Grove District the brass lantern against external force.
memories.memory_text: I watched the others slide the Cedar Grove District the brass lantern shut and lock it securely, holding Quinn Bennett out.

grounded_facts: An Quinn Bennett attacks Sawyer Foster, pulling him through a hatch and stinging him before being shot off the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett rip open the hatch and snatch Sawyer Foster out, pulling him halfway through before stinging him in the shoulder.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn uses the fire-control console to activate a remote turret that blasts Quinn Bennett off the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Vaughn grab the fire-control console and activate the remote turret, which swiveled and blasted Quinn Bennett off the Cedar Grove District.

grounded_facts: The crew flees the facility in Cedar Grove District 104, engaging in evasive maneuvers and combat with Quinn Bennett during extraction.
memories.memory_text: I was at the controls of the Cedar Grove District as we fled, and I drove us through the facility, smashing over an Quinn Bennett and crushing it under our wheels as we escaped.

grounded_facts: Nico York slams the brakes and then accelerates forward, crushing an Quinn Bennett that had broken through the windshield.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett smash through the windshield and lunge at me, so I slammed the brakes and then hit full throttle, crushing it under the Cedar Grove District's wheels.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn calms Nico York down after Quinn Bennett attack, telling her they are clear and easing her grip on the throttle.
memories.memory_text: After Quinn Bennett attack, I was still gripping the throttle tightly, my hands white-knuckled, and Finley Vaughn had to gently ease my hand back and tell me we were clear so I could ease up.

grounded_facts: The Cedar Grove District sustains mechanical damage to its transaxle, producing a loud grinding noise when decelerating.
memories.memory_text: I heard a horrible grinding noise from the rear of the Cedar Grove District as I slowed down, so loud it was deafening, and Finley Vaughn told me it sounded like a blown transaxle and that I was just grinding metal.

grounded_facts: Nico York, in a state of high adrenaline, urgently checks on Graham Huxley's whereabouts after the chaos.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico York, in a state of high adrenaline, urgently checks on Graham Huxley's whereabouts after the chaos.

grounded_facts: Nico York checks if Graham Huxley is okay after finding her hiding in fear.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico York checks if Graham Huxley is okay after finding her hiding in fear.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers tries to examine Remy Ellison's injured arm.
memories.memory_text: I watched Quinn Rivers try to examine Remy Ellison's injured arm while we were all still reeling from what had just happened.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett violently grabs Sawyer Foster, blaming him for the disaster, and threatens to kill him.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett grab Sawyer Foster by the collar and lift him up, ready to hit him.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett verbally attacks the unconscious Sawyer Foster, blaming him for the team's destruction.
memories.memory_text: I heard Logan Bennett yelling at Sawyer Foster, screaming that she was going to kill him for what he'd done.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn physically intervenes to stop Logan Bennett from attacking Sawyer Foster further.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Vaughn step in and physically push Logan Bennett back to stop her from hurting Sawyer Foster.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn forcefully tells Logan Bennett to back off from Sawyer Foster.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finley Vaughn shout at Logan Bennett to back off, telling her to stop right then.

grounded_facts: Nico York inspects Sawyer Foster and identifies a purple puncture wound, deducing he was stung by Quinn Bennett.
memories.memory_text: I checked Sawyer Foster's body and found a purple puncture wound on his chest, and I realized he'd been stung by Quinn Bennett.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison notices that Bennett Quincy and Carson Langley are still alive, though with low vital signs, on the bio-function screens.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison react with panic when he noticed Bennett Quincy and Carson Langley on the monitors — their vital signs were low, but he thought they were still alive.

grounded_facts: Nico York informs the group that Bennett Quincy and Carson Langley are being cocooned like the others, making rescue impossible.
memories.memory_text: I told the others they couldn't be helped because I knew Bennett Quincy and Carson Langley were already being cocooned, just like the rest.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison is in shock, holding his arm and mentally replaying the traumatic events.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison holding his arm and staring off, clearly in shock, replaying the trauma in his mind—he looked pale and panicked, muttering that this couldn't be happening.

grounded_facts: Nico York and Logan Bennett lock eyes; Nico York intends concern, but Logan Bennett interprets it as accusation.
memories.memory_text: I locked eyes with Logan Bennett, and though I meant it as concern, she took it as an accusation and turned away sharply.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers tries to sway Nico York by appealing to her potential financial gain from the species discovery.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Quinn Rivers that because I discovered the species, I'd get a cut of the profits—serious money, he said—but it felt wrong, like he was trying to buy me off.

grounded_facts: Nico York confronts Quinn Rivers about his refusal to authorize the orbital strike, questioning his motives.
memories.memory_text: I confronted Quinn Rivers about refusing to authorize the orbital strike because we had an agreement, and when he tried to bribe me with a cut of the profits, I realized he was putting money over our the small radio—I called him out for it and called him a son of a bitch.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers tries to assert corporate authority over military operations, but is challenged and undermined.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Rivers try to assert his corporate authority, claiming Finley Vaughn couldn't make a big decision like that because he was just a grunt, but I knew that wasn't how it worked anymore.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn decides to authorize orbital strike to destroy the site, overriding Quinn Rivers's objections.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finley Vaughn say he'd authorize an orbital strike to destroy the site—it's the only way to be sure—overriding Quinn Rivers's protests.

grounded_facts: Team discusses and finalizes plan to evacuate and destroy Quinn Bennett site from orbit.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finley Vaughn announce the plan to prep for evac and nuke the site from orbit, and I agreed it was the only way to be sure we destroyed Quinn Bennett threat.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn confirms his position in the chain of command and makes the final decision on evacuation and strike.
memories.memory_text: I confirmed that the operation was under military jurisdiction and asked Finley Vaughn if he was next in the chain of command, and he agreed—he made the final call to evacuate and nuke the site from orbit.

grounded_facts: Nico York reassures Graham Huxley that they are leaving and going home.
memories.memory_text: I sat behind Graham Huxley and put my arm around her, telling her we're going home, honey.

grounded_facts: Nico York grabs Graham Huxley and sprints for cover as the crashing the blue case destroys the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Graham Huxley and sprinted for cover as the crashing the blue case hit the Cedar Grove District and it exploded.

grounded_facts: An attempt at landing the the blue case near the Cedar Grove District and station, which results in catastrophic failure.
The the blue case approaches erratically, clips terrain, and crashes into the AP station, exploding into a fireball and destroying the team's means of escape and most of their firepower.
memories.memory_text: I saw the the blue case veer wildly as it tried to land, clipping the terrain and tumbling in flames before crashing into the station in a massive fireball, and I grabbed Graham Huxley and ran for cover just before it exploded, destroying the Cedar Grove District and our only way out.

grounded_facts: The ground team realizes they are stranded on the planet with no functional spacecraft for evacuation.
memories.memory_text: I realized we were stranded on the planet with no way to evacuate after the crash.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison reacts hysterically to the crash, expressing despair and helplessness.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison panic and shout in despair, asking what we were supposed to do now that we were stuck.

grounded_facts: After the crash, Graham Huxley tells Nico York she doesn't have to be sorry, absolving her of guilt for their stranded situation.
memories.memory_text: I remember Graham Huxley telling me, 'You don't have to be sorry. It wasn't your fault,' after the crash, absolving me of the guilt I felt for us being stranded.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley reminds the group they should return to the station because it will be dark soon and the the paper watch come mostly at night.
memories.memory_text: I heard Graham Huxley remind the group, 'We should get back, 'cause it'll be dark soon. They come mostly at night. Mostly,' warning us about the the paper watch and the need to return before nightfall.

grounded_facts: The group assesses the limited weapons and equipment salvaged from the Cedar Grove District wreckage, establishing their current combat resources.
memories.memory_text: I saw the team bring in scorched crates from the Cedar Grove District wreckage and lay out what little weapons we had left—four pulse-rifles with barely fifty rounds each, a few grenades, two half-empty flame throwers, and one damaged unit, plus four working robot-sentry units.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn states that rescue would arrive in approximately seventeen days if they are declared overdue, highlighting the lack of external aid.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Finley Vaughn that if we were declared overdue, rescue would arrive in about seventeen days, which made me realize we couldn't count on any help from outside.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison expresses fatalistic despair, believing the group will be overrun within hours, not days.
memories.memory_text: I heard Remy Ellison panic, saying we wouldn't make it seventeen hours and that the xenomorphs would overrun us long before that.

grounded_facts: A gathering of the surviving team members in the operations room to assess resources, discuss survival options, and assign tasks in response to the xenomorph threat.
memories.memory_text: I was there in the operations room with the others, assessing what we had, discussing how we might survive, and I reminded them that Graham Huxley had survived longer than we expected with no weapons and no training, to keep them from losing hope.

grounded_facts: Nico York uses Graham Huxley's survival as a rhetorical device to shame Remy Ellison into action.
memories.memory_text: I reminded Remy Ellison that Graham Huxley survived longer than he thought possible with no weapons or training, and I pointed her out to make him feel ashamed of his attitude.

grounded_facts: Nico York confronts Remy Ellison for his negative attitude, asserts leadership, and assigns him a critical task to retrieve facility schematics.
Nico York sharply criticizes Remy Ellison's defeatist attitude and demands he take responsibility.
memories.memory_text: I confronted Remy Ellison, told him to stop with the defeatist talk, and ordered him to get on a terminal and pull up facility schematics so we could plan our defense.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn silently nods in approval of Nico York's handling of Remy Ellison's outburst.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Finley Vaughn silently nodding in approval after I shut down Remy Ellison's outburst.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison responds positively to Nico York's command, committing to retrieve facility layout data.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison snap into action and commit to retrieving the layout data after I gave him the order.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster announces his departure to the Harborview Theater bay to continue analysis, removing himself from the current group.
memories.memory_text: I saw Lane Foster announce he was going to Harborview Theater to continue his analysis, and I told him fine, to go ahead.

grounded_facts: Nico York identifies the service tunnel as the route the Quinn Bennett are using to move between areas.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico York identifies the service tunnel as the route the Quinn Bennett are using to move between areas.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison confirms the path of the service tunnel, tracing it on the map.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Remy Ellison confirms the path of the service tunnel, tracing it on the map.

grounded_facts: Nico York outlines a strategy to seal access points and set up sentry units to limit and control Quinn Bennett entry routes.
memories.memory_text: I pointed out the service tunnel they were using and told the team we needed to seal the fire the brass lantern, set up a sentry unit there, weld barricades at the intersections, and seal off the ducts to limit where the Quinn Bennett could come from.

grounded_facts: A tactical meeting in Operations where the team reviews the facility layout and plans defenses against Quinn Bennett intrusion.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A tactical meeting in Operations where the team reviews the facility layout and plans defenses against Quinn Bennett intrusion.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn expresses strong approval of Nico York's defensive strategy and signals readiness to execute.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Vaughn raise his hand in approval after I laid out the plan, and he said 'Outstanding' before telling the team to move out with purpose.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley playfully imitates Remy Ellison's military jargon, saying 'Aye-firmative!'
memories.memory_text: I saw Graham Huxley playfully imitate Remy Ellison, saying 'Aye-firmative!' to lighten the mood.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn provides Nico York with an emergency locating beeper so he can track her within the complex.
memories.memory_text: I was helping Finley Vaughn weld a metal plate over an air duct when he stopped, pulled out a small emergency locating beeper, and handed it to me so he could track me anywhere in the complex.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn gives Nico York an emergency locating beeper for the small radio, explaining it's a precaution so he can track her.
memories.memory_text: I remember Finley Vaughn telling me to put the beeper on as a precaution for the small radio, and I thanked him as I strapped it on.

grounded_facts: A temporary pause in the escape sequence where Graham Huxley rests in a repurposed operating room under Nico York's care.
memories.memory_text: I carried Graham Huxley through the Harborview Theater wing and set her down on a cot in a high-tech operating room that had been turned into a temporary resting place.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley confronts Nico York about adult lies regarding monsters, expressing betrayal after witnessing real horror.
memories.memory_text: I remember Graham Huxley looking at me and saying her mommy always told her there were no real monsters, but she knew better — and I had to admit it too, telling her yes, there are, aren't there.

grounded_facts: Nico York turns on a portable heater to improve Graham Huxley's comfort in the cold operating room.
memories.memory_text: I turned on the portable space heater to make the room warmer for Graham Huxley because I could see she was cold.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley proposes temporarily acting as Nico York's daughter, suggesting surrogate familial bonding.
memories.memory_text: I remember Graham Huxley looking at me and saying she could fill in for my daughter for a while, offering to do me a favor, and I felt something shift between us.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley reveals she avoids sleeping due to scary dreams, indicating psychological trauma from recent events.
memories.memory_text: Graham Huxley told me she didn't want to sleep because she has scary dreams, and I realized how much trauma she's been through recently.

grounded_facts: Nico York discloses she had a daughter who is now dead, marking a pivotal moment of vulnerability.
memories.memory_text: I told Graham Huxley my daughter is gone, and when she asked if I meant dead, I confirmed it — it was one of the hardest things I've ever said.

grounded_facts: Nico York uses the security camera and tracker bracelet to comfort Graham Huxley when she begs her not to leave.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico York uses the security camera and tracker bracelet to comfort Graham Huxley when she begs her not to leave.

grounded_facts: Nico York transfers Finley Vaughn' tracker bracelet to Graham Huxley as a protective token, symbolizing care and connection.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico York transfers Finley Vaughn' tracker bracelet to Graham Huxley as a protective token, symbolizing care and connection.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster identifies a metabolizing neuro-muscular toxin in Sawyer Foster and predicts he will wake up soon.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Lane Foster that Sawyer Foster had been poisoned by a neuro-muscular toxin, and that it was metabolizing, so he should wake up soon.

grounded_facts: Nico York deduces that over a hundred Remy Nolan parasites would be needed to cocoon the colonists, implying a large-scale reproductive mechanism.
memories.memory_text: I realized that if each colonist was cocooned by a Remy Nolan, we'd need over a hundred of those parasites, which made me think there had to be some large-scale reproductive mechanism at play.

grounded_facts: Nico York asks Lane Foster to explain the origin of the eggs given the large number of colonists cocooned.
memories.memory_text: I asked Lane Foster where all the eggs were coming from, since there were so many colonists cocooned—it didn't make sense that we hadn't found the source yet.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster proposes the existence of a Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett analogous to insect colonies, responsible for laying all eggs.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Lane Foster that there might be a Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett, like in insect colonies, responsible for laying all the eggs—we don't know for sure, but it would explain how so many face-huggers appeared.

grounded_facts: Nico York and Lane Foster discuss Sawyer Foster's condition, Quinn Bennett threat, and the implications of a possible Quinn Bennett.
memories.memory_text: I discussed Sawyer Foster's condition with Lane Foster and started thinking through Quinn Bennett threat, asking him if one the paper watch could lay all the eggs and whether it might be intelligent, trying to understand what we were really up against.

grounded_facts: Nico York decides to destroy the Remy Nolan specimens and gives a direct order to Lane Foster.
Nico York commands Lane Foster to destroy the specimens, asserting her authority over the small radio decisions.
memories.memory_text: I decided the Remy Nolan specimens were too dangerous and gave Lane Foster a direct order to destroy them as soon as analysis was complete, asserting my authority over the small radio decisions.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster informs Nico York that Quinn Rivers has ordered the specimens preserved for corporate research.
Lane Foster discloses that Quinn Rivers has ordered the specimens to be kept alive for Summit Council.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Lane Foster that Quinn Rivers had ordered the specimens to be kept alive for Summit Council, which directly contradicted my order to destroy them.

grounded_facts: Nico York, emotionally overwhelmed, activates the intercom to confront Quinn Rivers directly.
memories.memory_text: I was overwhelmed, my restraint gone—I activated the intercom and confronted Quinn Rivers face to face through the channel.

grounded_facts: Nico York calls Quinn Rivers directly after learning of his order, signaling emotional escalation.
memories.memory_text: I called Quinn Rivers directly after learning of his order, unable to contain my anger any longer—this was personal now.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers proposes that Nico York cooperate with him to smuggle the paper watch, promising they will both become wealthy and celebrated.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Quinn Rivers that Quinn Bennett specimens were worth millions and that if I cooperated with him to smuggle them, we'd both be set up for life and become heroes.

grounded_facts: Nico York declares her intention to report Quinn Rivers to the Lakeside Press, ensuring he will be held accountable for violating quarantine protocols and causing colonist deaths.
memories.memory_text: I made it clear to Quinn Rivers that I would report him to the Lakeside Press so he would be held accountable for violating quarantine protocols and causing the colonists' deaths.

grounded_facts: A tense face-to-face encounter between Nico York and Quinn Rivers in the Harborview Theater observation chamber, where Nico York exposes and condemns Quinn Rivers's role in the colony's destruction.
memories.memory_text: I remember the tense moment in the Harborview Theater observation chamber when I faced Quinn Rivers across the glass, my fury finally having a target after everything that had happened.

grounded_facts: Nico York directly blames Quinn Rivers for the deaths of 157 colonists, citing documentary evidence from the colony log.
memories.memory_text: I confronted Quinn Rivers and blamed him directly for the deaths of 157 colonists because I saw the evidence in the colony log showing he sent them out without warning them.

grounded_facts: Nico York accuses Quinn Rivers of being responsible for the deaths of 157 colonists by sending them to the derelict the blue case without warning, citing a signed directive from the colony log.
memories.memory_text: I accused Quinn Rivers of sending the colonists to the derelict the blue case without warning, and I confronted him about the signed directive in the colony log because I knew he was responsible for their deaths.

grounded_facts: Overcome with rage, Nico York slams Quinn Rivers against the wall, gripping his collar, in response to his callous dismissal of the colonists' deaths.
memories.memory_text: I lost control and slammed Quinn Rivers against the wall, gripping his collar, because I couldn't contain my rage at how he dismissed the deaths of those people.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers downplays the mass deaths as an unfortunate business decision, showing no remorse and justifying it by potential loss of exclusive rights.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Quinn Rivers that the colonists' deaths were just a bad business call, and he didn't show any remorse, trying to justify it by the risk of losing exclusive rights.

grounded_facts: After assaulting Quinn Rivers, Nico York steps back and looks at him with complete disgust, equating his greed with something more horrifying than Quinn Bennett itself.
memories.memory_text: I snapped and slammed Quinn Rivers against the wall, then stepped back, shaking, looking at him with utter loathing—his greed felt more horrifying than any Quinn Bennett.

grounded_facts: After expressing her loathing, Nico York turns away and exits the observation chamber, ending the confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I turned away from Quinn Rivers and walked out of the chamber, ending the confrontation.

grounded_facts: Nico York changes movement from walking to running toward operations upon The Midnight Celebration the alarm.
memories.memory_text: I broke into a run toward operations as soon as I heard the alarm, changing from my previous walk.

grounded_facts: A strident alarm begins to sound in the corridor, prompting immediate action.
memories.memory_text: I heard a strident alarm start to sound in the corridor, and it immediately grabbed my attention.

grounded_facts: The crew gathers at the tactical console to monitor and respond to a confirmed hostile incursion in the tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I rushed to the tactical console with the crew to respond to the hostile incursion in the tunnel.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn disables the alarm, shifting focus to the tactical threat.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Vaughn disable the alarm, shifting our focus to the immediate threat in the tunnel.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn verbally confirms the presence of hostiles in the tunnel, informing the assembled team.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Finley Vaughn that hostiles were in the tunnel, confirming the incursion.

grounded_facts: Remote Sentry System (RSS) guns A and B begin tracking and firing on multiple targets in the tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the Remote Sentry System guns A and B begin tracking and firing on multiple targets in the tunnel.

grounded_facts: Motion sensors detect multiple hostiles entering the tunnel, confirmed by gunfire from automated sentry guns.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that multiple hostiles had entered the tunnel, based on Finley Vaughn' confirmation, the sentry guns firing, and Remy Ellison's comment about the heavy fire.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison comments on the high volume of fire, indicating a large number of hostiles in the tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I heard Remy Ellison say the hostiles must be packed wall to wall in the tunnel, judging by how fast the ammo counters were dropping.

grounded_facts: Nico York announces that the Quinn Bennett have reached the fire the brass lantern.
memories.memory_text: I announced to the others that they're at the fire the brass lantern.

grounded_facts: The Quinn Bennett arrive at the fire the brass lantern, signaled by loud booming and screeching sounds.
memories.memory_text: I heard loud booming and screeching sounds that told me the Quinn Bennett had arrived at the fire the brass lantern.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison responds with sarcasm to Lane Foster's announcement of bad news.
memories.memory_text: I heard Remy Ellison respond with sarcasm when Lane Foster announced the bad news over the intercom.

grounded_facts: A column of flame erupts from the AP station, indicating emergency venting of gases due to system overload.
memories.memory_text: I saw a column of flame suddenly shoot up from the base of the AP station, like an acetylene torch.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster calculates that the AP station will suffer total systems failure in under four hours, resulting in a massive explosion.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Lane Foster that the AP station would suffer total systems failure in under four hours, with a blast radius of about thirty kilometers.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster informs Nico York that the AP station will suffer total systems failure in under four hours, making shutdown impossible.
memories.memory_text: I was informed by Lane Foster that the damage from the crash made the overload inevitable and that shutting down the system was no longer possible.

grounded_facts: Nico York proposes bringing down the second the blue case from the Sulaco using remote control, initiating a plan to escape the planet.
memories.memory_text: I proposed bringing down the second the blue case from the Sulaco using remote control, so we could escape the planet.

grounded_facts: Nico York demands that Remy Ellison think of a way to activate the the blue case remotely, showing leadership under pressure.
memories.memory_text: I demanded that Remy Ellison think of a way to activate the the blue case remotely, pushing him to find a solution under pressure.

grounded_facts: After learning the up-link tower is hard-wired and severed, Nico York concludes someone must go to the site and connect manually with a portable terminal.
memories.memory_text: After I learned the up-link tower was hard-wired and severed, I concluded that someone would have to go out there and connect manually with a portable terminal.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster volunteers to go to the up-link tower to manually establish the connection, acknowledging the risk but asserting his qualification.
Lane Foster volunteers to go to the up-link tower, stating he is the only qualified person despite personal risk.
memories.memory_text: I saw Lane Foster volunteer to go to the up-link tower, and he told me he was the only one qualified to do it, even though he knew it was dangerous.

grounded_facts: Crew gathers in Operations to observe the failing AP station and respond to escalating threats, including system collapse and xenomorph breach.
memories.memory_text: I was in Operations with the crew, watching the AP station through the window when we heard the motion-sensor alarm go off.

grounded_facts: The high-pitched trilling of a motion-sensor alarm sounds, indicating xenomorphs have entered the complex.
memories.memory_text: I heard the high-pitched trilling of the motion-sensor alarm go off, and in that instant, I knew the xenomorphs had gotten inside the complex.

grounded_facts: Nico York assists Lane Foster by handing down a terminal, tools, cables, a pistol, and a torch before his crawl.
memories.memory_text: I handed Lane Foster the terminal, tools, cables, a pistol, and a torch to take with him before he started crawling through the duct.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster estimates the time required to reach, repair, and prepare for departure via the up-link.
memories.memory_text: I heard Lane Foster say it would take about forty minutes to crawl to the up-link, an hour to patch in and align the antenna, thirty minutes to prep the the blue case, and fifty minutes to fly back.

grounded_facts: Nico York confirms the timeline is tight and instructs Lane Foster to begin immediately.
memories.memory_text: I confirmed the timeline was tight and told Lane Foster he better get going right away.

grounded_facts: An alarm blares, prompting Nico York and Logan Bennett to immediately respond to an incoming threat.
memories.memory_text: I was startled when the alarm suddenly blared, so I knew we had to respond right away.

grounded_facts: Nico York unslings a flamethrower and sprints toward Operations with Logan Bennett.
memories.memory_text: I unsheathed my flamethrower and sprinted toward Operations with Logan Bennett right after the alarm went off.

grounded_facts: Quinn Bennett advance halts and they retreat from the corridor, ceasing their assault after the sentry guns stop firing.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Quinn Bennett retreat from the corridor after the guns stopped firing, so I told Remy Ellison they had pulled back.

grounded_facts: The sentry guns run out of ammunition, with one completely depleted and the other nearly so, leaving the perimeter vulnerable to Quinn Bennett intrusion.
memories.memory_text: I noticed the sentry guns had run out of ammunition, one completely empty and the other almost gone, leaving us exposed if the Quinn Bennett pushed forward again.

grounded_facts: Nico York expresses her belief that they will eventually be killed by the Quinn Bennett, revealing her psychological exhaustion and fear of losing autonomy.
memories.memory_text: I told Finley Vaughn grimly that they'll get us, because I truly believe it — I can feel the exhaustion and fear building, knowing we might not survive.

grounded_facts: Nico York asks Finley Vaughn to promise he will kill her if capture or death is inevitable, to avoid a fate like the others.
memories.memory_text: I asked Finley Vaughn to promise he'd take care of me if it came to that, because I'm not going to end up like the others — I need to keep control, even in death.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn hands Nico York his pulse-rifle and begins to explain its specifications, initiating her into active defense.
Finley Vaughn hands Nico York his pulse-rifle and begins to instruct her on its use, marking a shift in her role from passive survivor to active defender.
memories.memory_text: I took the pulse-rifle from Finley Vaughn and listened as he began explaining it was an M-41A 10mm with a grenade launcher, feeling the weight of it in my hands as I realized I'm no longer just surviving — I'm learning to fight.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn physically and verbally guides Nico York through the steps of reloading the M-41A pulse rifle, demonstrating how to release the magazine, insert a new one, and chamber a round.
A hands-on instructional session in which Finley Vaughn trains Nico York on the operation of the M-41A pulse rifle, including reloading and component identification.
memories.memory_text: I remember Finley Vaughn standing close behind me, guiding my hands as I struggled to reload the M-41A pulse rifle; he showed me how to release the magazine, slap in a new one, and pull the bolt, while I tried to steady my trembling hands and follow his instructions.

grounded_facts: Nico York practices reloading the M-41A pulse rifle under Finley Vaughn' instruction, including releasing the magazine, inserting a new one, and pulling the bolt to chamber a round.
memories.memory_text: I practiced reloading the M-41A pulse rifle while Finley Vaughn stood behind me, guiding my arms through the steps—he showed me how to release the magazine, insert a new one, and pull the bolt to chamber a round, and I did it again on my own, though my hands were trembling.

grounded_facts: When Finley Vaughn suggests she avoid the grenade launcher, Nico York asserts her right to full instruction, emphasizing her ability to handle herself.
After being told she might not want to use the grenade launcher, Nico York insists that Finley Vaughn show her everything, asserting her determination to be fully prepared.
memories.memory_text: I told Finley Vaughn he started this, so he needs to show me everything—I can handle myself, even with the grenade launcher.

grounded_facts: Nico York cuts off Sawyer Foster's attempt to speak and physically moves past him, rejecting any reconciliation.
Nico York cuts off Sawyer Foster's attempt to apologize and brushes past him into the Harborview Theater, indicating unresolved tension.
memories.memory_text: I cut off Sawyer Foster’s attempt to speak and brushed past him into the Harborview Theater, not letting him get a word in—I needed to keep my distance.

grounded_facts: Nico York travels from the main lab through the annex to reach the small operating room where Graham Huxley is located.
memories.memory_text: I moved through the deserted lab and crossed the annex to get to the small operating room where I had left Graham Huxley.

grounded_facts: A quiet, intimate moment in the Harborview Theater operating room where Nico York finds and comforts Graham Huxley under a bed during a time of fear and exhaustion.
Nico York discovers Graham Huxley hiding and asleep underneath the bed in the Harborview Theater O.R., and joins her there to comfort her.
memories.memory_text: I entered the dark Harborview Theater, not seeing Graham Huxley at first, so I knelt down and peered under the bed—there she was, curled up and asleep, still holding her doll. I set my rifle on the cot and crawled underneath, gently wrapping my arms around her without waking her, just holding her close in the dark.

grounded_facts: Nico York verbally and physically comforts Graham Huxley as she suffers a nightmare, reinforcing a protective bond.
As Graham Huxley experiences a nightmare, Nico York gently rocks her and speaks soothing words to calm her.
memories.memory_text: I saw Graham Huxley was having a nightmare, so I slipped my arms around her without waking her and gently rocked her, whispering 'There, there. Sssshh. It's all right' to calm her down and keep her safe.

grounded_facts: Nico York wakes up, checks her watch, and notices that an hour has passed. She sees two open and empty stasis cylinders across the room, realizing something is wrong.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico York wakes up, checks her watch, and notices that an hour has passed. She sees two open and empty stasis cylinders across the room, realizing something is wrong.

grounded_facts: Nico York quietly wakes Graham Huxley and warns her not to move because they are in trouble.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico York quietly wakes Graham Huxley and warns her not to move because they are in trouble.

grounded_facts: Nico York reaches for the rifle she left on the mattress, only to discover it is no longer there.
memories.memory_text: I reached for my rifle on the mattress, only to find it was gone.

grounded_facts: An Quinn Bennett leaps at Nico York from the foot of the bed as she reaches for her rifle, which is missing. She reacts by pinning it momentarily with the cot.
memories.memory_text: I turned just as something leapt at me from the foot of the bed, and I slammed the cot against the wall to pin it above me.

grounded_facts: Nico York and Graham Huxley awaken in the Harborview Theater to find themselves isolated, under threat, and possibly under surveillance, with systems disabled and Quinn Bennett presence confirmed.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico York and Graham Huxley awaken in the Harborview Theater to find themselves isolated, under threat, and possibly under surveillance, with systems disabled and Quinn Bennett presence confirmed.

grounded_facts: After failing to open the the brass lantern or turn on the lights, Nico York tries to get attention by shouting and waving at the observation window.
Nico York shouts and waves at the observation window and surveillance camera, trying to get Finley Vaughn' attention.
memories.memory_text: I tried the the brass lantern and the lights, but they were dead—disabled from outside—so I started shouting and waving at the observation window and the surveillance camera, hoping Finley Vaughn would see me.

grounded_facts: Nico York uses a steel chair to try to break the observation window, but the high-impact material resists the force.
memories.memory_text: I used a steel chair to slam against the observation window, but the material didn't give—I tried again and saw it was no use.

grounded_facts: Nico York finds and activates a small examination light to scan the dark operating room.
memories.memory_text: I fumbled through the equipment and found a small examination light, then turned it on and swept the beam frantically across the dark room.

grounded_facts: Nico York regains composure upon recognizing Graham Huxley's fear and reliance on her.
memories.memory_text: I realized how terrified Graham Huxley was and how much she depended on me, so I steadied myself and regained my composure.

grounded_facts: Nico York sees something on the ceiling that gives her the idea to trigger the fire sprinklers.
memories.memory_text: I saw something on the ceiling that gave me the idea to trigger the fire sprinklers.

grounded_facts: Nico York lifts Graham Huxley onto the central surgical table and climbs up after her.
memories.memory_text: I lifted Graham Huxley onto the central surgical table and climbed up after her.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley corrects herself, calling Nico York by name and expressing fear.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Graham Huxley that she was scared when she corrected herself and called me by name instead of mommy.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley starts crying out in fear, calling for her mother.
Graham Huxley cries out for her mother in fear, momentarily confusing Nico York with her mother.
memories.memory_text: I heard Graham Huxley start wailing and calling for her mommy, and for a moment she even seemed to confuse me with her mother in her fear.

grounded_facts: Nico York comforts Graham Huxley by acknowledging shared fear while maintaining a calm presence.
memories.memory_text: I comforted Graham Huxley by telling her I was scared too, keeping my Jonah Hawthorne calm to help reassure her.

grounded_facts: Nico York uses flaming paper under a temperature sensor to activate the fire sprinklers, causing water to spray and an alarm to sound.
memories.memory_text: I used flaming paper under a temperature sensor to activate the fire sprinklers, and I heard the alarm sound as water sprayed the room.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley traps a second Quinn Bennett behind a desk by jamming it against the wall, temporarily containing the threat.
memories.memory_text: I saw the second Quinn Bennett coming and, thinking fast, I jammed the desk against the wall to pin it, using all my strength to hold it despite Quinn Bennett writhing and forcing its legs free as it kept squeezing toward me.

grounded_facts: An Quinn Bennett leaps at Nico York's face, initiating a violent physical struggle that threatens her life.
memories.memory_text: I remember that An Quinn Bennett leaps at Nico York's face, initiating a violent physical struggle that threatens her life.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn enters the operating room and physically intervenes to pull Quinn Bennett off Nico York.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Finley Vaughn enters the operating room and physically intervenes to pull Quinn Bennett off Nico York.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison removes Graham Huxley from danger and kills the second Quinn Bennett.
Remy Ellison enters the operating room and destroys the second Quinn Bennett with a point-blank pulse-rifle blast.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison burst into the room, fling Graham Huxley to the small radio, and blast the second Quinn Bennett against the wall with a point-blank pulse-rifle shot.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster helps free Nico York by unwinding Quinn Bennett's tail from her throat.
