memories.memory_text: I pulled the trigger and heard an empty click, seeing the digital counter flash crimson zeroes—I knew my weapon was out of ammo and I'd have to reload under fire.

grounded_facts: After expending most of her ammunition and igniting the chamber, Nico York retreats into the catacombs with Graham Huxley.
memories.memory_text: I dashed into the catacombs with Graham Huxley, my weapon empty, relying on instinct to guide us as I carried her away from the chaos.

grounded_facts: Nico York's flight from the burning egg chamber into the catacombs with Graham Huxley after depleting her ammunition.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico York's flight from the burning egg chamber into the catacombs with Graham Huxley after depleting her ammunition.

grounded_facts: Nico York runs desperately through the catacombs in a state of near-hysteria, reacting to environmental chaos and disorientation.
memories.memory_text: I ran blindly through the catacombs, panting and nearly hysterical, overwhelmed by the chaos and disorientation all around me.

grounded_facts: Nico York spots one of her previously dropped flares and changes direction; then sees another and sprints toward it.
memories.memory_text: I saw one of the flares I had dropped and turned, then spotted another one ahead and sprinted toward it as the ground shook beneath me.

grounded_facts: The life cage Nico York used to descend has been destroyed by falling debris, cutting off her initial escape route.
memories.memory_text: I saw that the life cage I used to descend had been destroyed by falling debris, blocking my way out.

grounded_facts: Nico York activates the second elevator cage to begin its descent from above.
memories.memory_text: I slammed the control to activate the second elevator cage, The Midnight Celebration its motor whine as it began descending from above.

grounded_facts: The Xenomorph Quinn Bennett emerges in the corridor, advancing toward Nico York through smoke and darkness.
memories.memory_text: I saw the silhouette of the Xenomorph Quinn Bennett emerging through the smoke, that glistening black shape filling the corridor as it advanced toward me.

grounded_facts: Nico York's pulse rifle and flamethrower are depleted, leaving her defenseless against the approaching Quinn Bennett.
memories.memory_text: I realized my pulse rifle was empty, the flamethrower sputtered uselessly, and I had no grenades left—I was completely defenseless as Quinn Bennett approached.

grounded_facts: Realizing the elevator will not arrive in time, Nico York abandons it and climbs a wall-mounted ladder to escape Quinn Bennett's approach.
memories.memory_text: I realized the elevator wouldn't arrive in time, so I ran to a ladder mounted on the wall and scrambled up the rungs to get away from Quinn Bennett's approach.

grounded_facts: Nico York emerges through a narrow hatch while carrying Graham Huxley, narrowly avoiding an attack from Quinn Bennett below.
memories.memory_text: I struggled up through a narrow hatch with Graham Huxley clinging to me, barely making it out in time.

grounded_facts: Quinn Bennett violently assaults the grille-floor from beneath, attempting to reach Nico York as she escapes.
memories.memory_text: I saw a powerful black arm with razor claws shoot up through the hatch behind me, smashing into the grille-floor, and I could feel Quinn Bennett tearing at the metal from below as I ran, pacing me with insane ferocity.

grounded_facts: Nico York begins ascending an open-grid emergency stairwell while the station undergoes structural failure.
memories.memory_text: I sprinted up the open-grid emergency stairwell, feeling it shudder beneath me as the station started to break apart.

grounded_facts: A Jonah Hawthorne announces that only two minutes remain to reach minimum safe distance from the station.
memories.memory_text: I heard a Jonah Hawthorne announce that I had only two minutes to reach minimum safe distance from the station.

grounded_facts: Nico York observes the life cage moving upward through the lattice work of the station, realizing someone or something must have activated it.
memories.memory_text: I looked down through the lattice work and saw the life cage start moving upward, and I knew someone or something must have activated it.

grounded_facts: After seeing the life cage ascend, Nico York resumes running, disoriented as the stairwell appears to whirl around her.
memories.memory_text: I ran on, disoriented as the stairwell whirled around me after seeing the life cage go up.

grounded_facts: Nico York screams Lane Foster's name in rage and betrayal upon realizing the the blue case is gone.
memories.memory_text: I screamed Lane Foster's name in rage, my Jonah Hawthorne breaking into raw screams of betrayal when I realized he had left us behind.

grounded_facts: Nico York tells Graham Huxley to close her eyes, attempting to shield her from the horror around them.
memories.memory_text: I told Graham Huxley to close her eyes, trying to shield her from the horror around us.

grounded_facts: The the blue case suddenly appears behind Nico York and Graham Huxley, offering unexpected rescue.
memories.memory_text: I saw the the blue case suddenly rise behind us, roaring in out of nowhere—it was our only chance.

grounded_facts: Nico York grabs the loading boom and is lifted into the the blue case with Graham Huxley, narrowly avoiding destruction.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed the loading boom and held Graham Huxley tight as we were lifted into the the blue case, just in time.

grounded_facts: A chaotic attempt to escape the exploding facility via the exterior landing platform.
memories.memory_text: I was in the middle of a chaotic escape, dodging explosions and collapsing structures as I carried Graham Huxley across the bucking platform.

grounded_facts: During ascent, the the blue case is struck by an explosion and its landing legs become entangled in debris.
memories.memory_text: I felt the the blue case lurch violently as a massive explosion hit nearby, and I saw the landing legs get caught in a tangle of debris, grinding horribly as we were slammed sideways.

grounded_facts: Nico York discovers that the the blue case is gone upon reaching the landing platform, triggering a reaction of rage and despair.
memories.memory_text: I burst onto the landing platform with Graham Huxley clinging to me, and my heart sank when I saw the the blue case was gone, just as explosions rocked the facility around us.

grounded_facts: The the blue case's landing legs retract violently during launch, tearing free from the station.
memories.memory_text: I saw the landing legs retract violently, tearing free from the station as we launched.

grounded_facts: Nico York commands Lane Foster to activate the the blue case's engines immediately.
memories.memory_text: I commanded Lane Foster to activate the engines immediately, telling him to punch it.

grounded_facts: The the blue case launches rapidly from Station 186 as the lower level explodes, escaping the destruction.
memories.memory_text: I was slammed back in my seat as the engines fired and the the blue case vaulted upward, escaping the station just as it was being destroyed.

grounded_facts: Nico York and Graham Huxley realize they are finally safe after escaping danger.
memories.memory_text: I realized we were finally and truly safe after everything we'd been through.

grounded_facts: Nico York comforts Graham Huxley by stroking her hair and verbally reassuring her that they are safe.
memories.memory_text: I stroked Graham Huxley's hair and told her, 'It's okay, baby. We made it. It's over,' as she started to cry.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster administers a pain relief shot to the comatose Finley Vaughn.
memories.memory_text: I was told Lane Foster gave Finley Vaughn a pain relief shot while he was unconscious.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster states the need to bring a stretcher to move Finley Vaughn to Harborview Theater.
memories.memory_text: I heard Lane Foster say we’d need a stretcher to move Finley Vaughn up to Harborview Theater.

grounded_facts: Nico York, carrying Graham Huxley, moves ahead of Lane Foster toward the loading ramp.
memories.memory_text: I picked up Graham Huxley and moved ahead of Lane Foster toward the loading ramp, leading our group's exit from the the blue case.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster apologizes to Nico York for scaring her, explaining the platform's instability justified his earlier action.
Lane Foster offers an explanation for his earlier action by citing the platform's instability.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Lane Foster that he was sorry for scaring me, and he explained that the platform was becoming too unstable, which justified why he moved the way he did earlier.

grounded_facts: Nico York touches Lane Foster's shoulder and tells him he did okay.
memories.memory_text: I touched Lane Foster's shoulder and told him he did okay, because he had earned that much from me.

grounded_facts: Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett bursts from hiding, impales Lane Foster with its tail, and tears him apart, killing him.
memories.memory_text: I watched Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett burst out and impale Lane Foster with its tail, lifting him up and tearing him apart right in front of me.

grounded_facts: Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett emerges from concealment within the landing-leg bay machinery and descends to the deck.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett emerge from the landing-leg bay, blending with the machinery before it descended to the deck on its strange limbs.

grounded_facts: Nico York, Graham Huxley, and Lane Foster arrive via the blue case and begin disembarking.
memories.memory_text: I arrived with Graham Huxley and Lane Foster on the the blue case and started moving down the ramp to get us off quickly.

grounded_facts: Nico York tells Graham Huxley to run for cover as Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett attacks.
memories.memory_text: I told Graham Huxley to go, and I watched her run for cover.

grounded_facts: Nico York sets down Graham Huxley and directs her to run, then decoys Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett to allow escape.
memories.memory_text: I set Graham Huxley down, directed her to run, and then I decoyed Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett to give us a chance to escape.

grounded_facts: Nico York waves her arms and calls out to draw Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett's attention away from Graham Huxley.
memories.memory_text: I waved my arms and called out 'Here!' to draw Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett's attention away from Graham Huxley.

grounded_facts: Nico York sprints through a the brass lantern and closes it just before Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett slams into it.
memories.memory_text: I sprinted through a the brass lantern and slammed it shut just before Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett hit it.

grounded_facts: Nico York rapidly engages with a series of mechanical interfaces, culminating in activating a powered system through a grip-control.
memories.memory_text: I rapidly engaged with the mechanical interfaces, securing my feet and stabbing the buttons in sequence before closing my hand on the grip-control to activate the system, The Midnight Celebration the hum of motors and the whine of hydraulics come to life.

grounded_facts: Nico York, operating the Power Loader, confronts Quinn Bennett in a hostile standoff, declaring her intent to protect Graham Huxley.
memories.memory_text: I stepped forward in the Power Loader, feeling that primal rage surge through me, ready to protect Graham Huxley at any cost.

grounded_facts: Nico York issues a direct verbal threat to Quinn Bennett, demanding she stay away from Graham Huxley.
memories.memory_text: I shouted at Quinn Bennett, 'Get away from her, you bitch!'—I had to make her back off from Graham Huxley.

grounded_facts: Nico York lands the first blow using the Power Loader's hydraulic arm, knocking Quinn Bennett into a wall.
memories.memory_text: I swung the Power Loader's hydraulic arm and landed a hard roundhouse hit on Quinn Bennett, slamming her into the wall.

grounded_facts: Nico York and Quinn Bennett become locked in close combat, with Nico York using the forks to crush limbs and lift Quinn Bennett.
memories.memory_text: I locked in combat with Quinn Bennett, using the Power Loader's forks to crush her limbs and lift her off the ground as she lashed out at me.

grounded_facts: Quinn Bennett saliva and hydraulic fluid spray during the fight, indicating severe damage to both combatants' systems.
memories.memory_text: I saw yellow acid from Quinn Bennett's drool spraying down toward me as I dodged, and purple hydraulic fluid was spraying from the Power Loader's damaged hoses—machine blood mixing with Quinn Bennett blood, both of us falling apart.

grounded_facts: Nico York activates the Power Loader's cutting torch while pinned by Quinn Bennett, using it as a close-range weapon.
memories.memory_text: I was pinned by Quinn Bennett, so I hit the switch to activate the Power Loader's cutting torch and used it against her at close range.

grounded_facts: A violent physical confrontation between Nico York, operating the Power Loader, and Quinn Bennett Quinn Bennett, fought in the cargo lock.
memories.memory_text: I fought Quinn Bennett in the cargo lock, clashing with her in the Power Loader, crushing her limbs, getting pinned, and then falling with her into the airlock pit.

grounded_facts: Nico York and Quinn Bennett roll over the edge of a vertical loading airlock, falling together into a pit.
memories.memory_text: I rolled over the edge of the vertical loading airlock with Quinn Bennett, falling together into the pit below.

grounded_facts: Nico York unstraps herself from the loader and climbs a service ladder to the small radio as the air is sucked into space.
memories.memory_text: I pulled my arm from the loader controls and hit the outer the brass lantern release, then struggled to unstrap as the air blasted out into space and I clawed my way up the service ladder to the small radio.

grounded_facts: Nico York overrides the inner the brass lantern and opens the outer the brass lantern of the airlock to expel Quinn Bennett into space.
memories.memory_text: I slapped the red 'INNER the brass lantern OVERRIDE' and locked it down, then hit 'OUTER the brass lantern OPEN' to blow Quinn Bennett out into space—the air screamed past me as I fought to unstrap from the loader and clawed my way up the service ladder.

grounded_facts: Quinn Bennett is dragged into space by the loader while still clutching one of Nico York's shoes, and disappears.
memories.memory_text: I saw the loader pull Quinn Bennett into space while it was still holding onto one of my shoes, and I watched it disappear into the void.

grounded_facts: Nico York activates the override to close the inner doors, stabilizing the environment.
memories.memory_text: I activated the override to close the inner doors and stabilize the environment, making sure we wouldn't decompress.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster acknowledges Nico York's survival with a grim smile and a wink, complimenting her resilience.
memories.memory_text: I saw Lane Foster give me a small, grim smile and wink after he said, 'Not bad for a human,' acknowledging that I made it through alive.

grounded_facts: Nico York reaches Graham Huxley and embraces her after surviving the confrontation with Quinn Bennett.
Graham Huxley weakly calls Nico York 'Mommy' and seeks reassurance.
memories.memory_text: I reached Graham Huxley and hugged her tightly after we made it through the danger, and I remember her calling me 'Mommy' weakly, asking for me, so I told her I was right here, right here with her.

grounded_facts: Nico York responds to Graham Huxley's question with warmth and affirmation, reinforcing their bond and shared recovery.
Graham Huxley asks if they can dream, and Nico York affirms it, symbolizing regained hope and psychological healing.
memories.memory_text: I remember Graham Huxley asking me if we could dream, and I told her yes, honey, I think we both can — I said it with warmth because I wanted her to feel safe and hopeful, just like I was starting to feel.

grounded_facts: Nico York, injured but determined, carries Graham Huxley through the corridor toward rest, signaling the small radio and emotional closure.
memories.memory_text: I limped down the long corridor carrying Graham Huxley on my hip, her head resting on my shoulder, as we moved together toward rest, feeling the the small radio settle around us.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster, Quinn Rivers, and the marines begin waking up from hypersleep, showing discomfort and fatigue.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster and Quinn Rivers beginning to stir next to me as we all started waking up from hypersleep, looking groggy and uncomfortable.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn comments that the new lieutenant is too good to eat with the grunts; Riley Cavendish adds a crude joke about him.
memories.memory_text: I remarked to the others that the new lieutenant was too good to eat with us grunts, and Riley Cavendish joked about him having a corn cob up his ass.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster reassures Nico York that modern synthetics cannot harm humans due to behavioral inhibitors, attempting to alleviate her distrust.
Lane Foster tries to ease tension by acknowledging past android flaws and asserting his own the small radio protocols.
memories.memory_text: I heard Lane Foster say that modern synthetics can't harm humans because of behavioral inhibitors, and he mentioned the old A/2 models were twitchy but that could never happen now—he even smiled and offered more cornbread after saying it.

grounded_facts: Nico York accuses Quinn Rivers of withholding information about Lane Foster being an android.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York confront Quinn Rivers and demand to know why he never told her Lane Foster was an android, and after Lane Foster said he preferred 'artificial person,' she told him to stay away from her.

grounded_facts: Troopers and officers gather in the mess hall to eat breakfast, marked by informal talk and visible social divisions.
memories.memory_text: I noticed the troopers all sat together at one table while the officers and civilians like Quinn Rivers and Lane Foster kept to themselves, so I stayed with my squad during breakfast.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison makes a crude joke implying Finley Vaughn is like the first form of the xenomorph, a 'walking sex organ'.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Remy Ellison that I sounded like a walking sex organ, just like the first form of the xenomorph, and it was meant as a crude joke about me.

grounded_facts: Nico York starts briefing the marines about the xenomorph life cycle and threat, providing recorded information and key biological details.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York place some recording diskettes on the table and say she'd dictated what she knew about the xenomorph, and then she started explaining its life cycle, saying it begins as an egg that attaches to a host and injects an embryo.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett declares her willingness to fight Quinn Bennett, using a finger-gun gesture and saying 'Anytime. Anywhere.'
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett respond to the talk about Quinn Bennett by declaring 'Anytime. Anywhere,' with a finger-gun gesture, showing she was ready to fight.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison makes a derogatory joke suggesting Logan Bennett joined the marines due to a misunderstanding about 'illegal Quinn Bennett'.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Remy Ellison make a derogatory joke suggesting Logan Bennett joined the marines because she misunderstood 'illegal Quinn Bennett' as the target of enforcement.

grounded_facts: A formal military briefing held before deployment, where mission details, threats, and procedures are communicated to the marines.
memories.memory_text: I was part of the pre-deployment briefing where Sawyer Foster took over to go over mission details, and I remember Quinn Rivers suggesting we study Nico York's recordings to get up to speed on the threat.

grounded_facts: Final preparations for the the blue case mission, including loading of vehicles, equipment, and personnel.
memories.memory_text: I was standing with Elliot Hayes during the final prep for the the blue case mission, watching the crew load vehicles and equipment.

grounded_facts: Nico York expresses her desire to be useful and offers to help with loading operations.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York approach Elliot Hayes and say she felt like a fifth wheel, asking if there was anything she could do to help with the loading.

grounded_facts: Nico York powers on a massive power loader and successfully operates it to lift a cargo module, demonstrating her skill.
Nico York operates the power loader skillfully and asks where to place the cargo, impressing Finley Vaughn.
memories.memory_text: I watched Nico York power up the loader, step into the controls, and skillfully lift a cargo module with it, then ask where they wanted it—I was impressed by how smoothly she handled the machine.

grounded_facts: Nico York and the troopers board the the blue case and take seats in the Cedar Grove District compartment for deployment.
A military operation in which the team boards a the blue case for rapid deployment to a planetary surface.
memories.memory_text: I boarded the the blue case with Nico York and the other troopers, taking my seat in the Cedar Grove District compartment across from Remy Ellison as we prepared for rapid deployment to the surface.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison demonstrates confidence and weapon knowledge, but is silenced by Finley Vaughn to maintain discipline.
Finley Vaughn physically and verbally stops Remy Ellison from continuing his boastful rant.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison strutting around, showing off with his weapon talk, so I grabbed him by his harness and pulled him into a seat to shut him down—I had to keep discipline tight before deployment.

grounded_facts: Nico York silently acknowledges Finley Vaughn for stopping Remy Ellison's disruptive behavior.
Nico York silently thanks Finley Vaughn for silencing Remy Ellison.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York nod her thanks to me for silencing Remy Ellison and stopping his disruptive behavior.

grounded_facts: The Cedar Grove District is descending to the planet's surface, experiencing turbulence, with the crew preparing for deployment.
memories.memory_text: I was jolted awake by the Cedar Grove District bucking hard as we descended, and I could hear the warning about turbulence just as I got my bearings.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster admits that he has only two or three combat drops, with thirty-eight being simulated, undermining confidence in his leadership.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster sweating and looking pale during the drop, and when he admitted he'd only been on two or three real combat drops, I realized how green he really was.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett directly probes Sawyer Foster's actual combat experience, highlighting a gap between simulation and real action.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett challenge Sawyer Foster about his combat drops, and when he answered, she exchanged a skeptical look with Jesse Hawthorne that told me everything.

grounded_facts: Nico York challenges Sawyer Foster's qualifications by asking about his number of drops, implying skepticism about his capability.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Nico York question Sawyer Foster directly about his experience, and the look she gave Quinn Rivers afterward made it clear she didn’t trust his qualifications either.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hayes orders Fire-team A to gear up and begin movement, signaling the imminent start of the mission.
Elliot Hayes commands Fire-team A to gear up and prepare for movement, specifying a two-minute timeline.
memories.memory_text: I was told to gear up and get ready to move out in two minutes — Elliot Hayes gave the order and someone was told to wake me up so I could get into action with Fire-team A.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster, via comms, directs the first squad and Finley Vaughn' team to form a cordon and watch the rear.
memories.memory_text: I was told over comms by Sawyer Foster to get my team into a cordon and watch the rear.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hayes orders Logan Bennett to take point as the team advances.
memories.memory_text: I saw Elliot Hayes order Logan Bennett to take point as we prepared to move out.

grounded_facts: Under Elliot Hayes's command, the squad advances in a skirmish line toward the colony's main entry-lock.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed our squad advancing in a skirmish line toward the colony's main entry-lock under Elliot Hayes's command.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster assigns Finley Vaughn a specific task to secure the upper level of the colony building.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Sawyer Foster to take the upper level of the colony building and use my motion tracker during the search.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster commands the marines to split into teams and search the colony, establishing a tactical approach to the situation.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Sawyer Foster to take the upper level and search by twos, using our motion trackers to watch for movement.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn and his squad reach the second level of the main concourse after ascending from below.
memories.memory_text: I led my squad up the stairwell to the second level, making sure everyone stayed tight behind me.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn uses equipment to scan for movement in the corridor, adjusting the gain, but detects nothing.
memories.memory_text: I unslung the motion scanner, aimed it down the corridor, and adjusted the gain, but I got nothing—no movement at all.

grounded_facts: Nico York urgently tells Finley Vaughn to back up and pan left on his camera, then confirms the discovery.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Nico York to back up and pan left on my camera feed.

grounded_facts: A section of the wall is found to be corroded almost through, indicating the presence of Quinn Bennett acid blood.
memories.memory_text: I saw on my monitor that a section of the wall was corroded almost through, which meant Quinn Bennett acid blood had caused it.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers raises an eyebrow and remarks that the corrosion looks like acid for blood.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Rivers raise an eyebrow and say 'Acid for blood,' linking the corrosion to Quinn Bennett's biology.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn observes over the com that the damage suggests someone has captured one of the the paper watch Nico York described.
memories.memory_text: I observed the damage over the com and said it looked like someone had captured one of Nico York's the paper watch.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster declares the area secured, indicating a shift from potential threat to the small radio.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Sawyer Foster declares the area secured, indicating a shift from potential threat to the small radio.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster gives verbal instructions to the team regarding their next actions after securing the area.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Sawyer Foster gives verbal instructions to the team regarding their next actions after securing the area.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster assigns specific tasks to team members: first team to operations, Remy Ellison to activate CPU, Finley Vaughn to meet at south lock.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Sawyer Foster assigns specific tasks to team members: first team to operations, Remy Ellison to activate CPU, Finley Vaughn to meet at south lock.

grounded_facts: Riley Cavendish appears suddenly behind Nico York, causing her to scream in fright.
memories.memory_text: I saw Riley Cavendish appear suddenly behind Nico York, and she screamed in fright when she noticed him.

grounded_facts: Riley Cavendish apologizes for scaring Nico York and explains he was sent by Finley Vaughn to watch her.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Riley Cavendish apologized for scaring Nico York and explained he was sent by me to watch her.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn observes Nico York's anxiety and silently signals Riley Cavendish to flank her, forming a two-man protective formation around her.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York looking nervous as we moved through the corridor, so I signaled Riley Cavendish with my eyes to fall in beside her and form a protective cordon.

grounded_facts: Nico York reenters the colony complex, recognizing it as hostile territory due to prior traumatic experience with Quinn Bennett.
memories.memory_text: I realized Nico York must have been feeling anxious because this place was clearly hostile territory for her, given what she'd been through before.

grounded_facts: After positioning Riley Cavendish beside her, Finley Vaughn makes brief eye contact and winks at Nico York, possibly to calm her.
memories.memory_text: After we got into position, I caught Nico York's glance and gave her a quick wink—maybe it would help calm her down.

grounded_facts: Trooper Sage Mercer returns from a side corridor and urges Sawyer Foster to investigate an unknown situation ahead.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer come back from a side corridor ahead and heard her tell Sawyer Foster, 'Sir, you should check this out,' so I knew something was up.

grounded_facts: Nico York warns Quinn Rivers to keep his distance from Quinn Bennett in the stasis tube just before it attacks the glass.
memories.memory_text: I heard Nico York warn Quinn Rivers to watch it just before Quinn Bennett lunged at the glass.

grounded_facts: One of Quinn Bennett the paper watch inside a stasis tube lunges at the glass and extends a tubule toward Quinn Rivers when he leans too close.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett inside the stasis tube lunge at the glass and extend a tubule when Quinn Rivers leaned too close.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn mocks Quinn Rivers after Quinn Bennett lunges at him, implying Quinn Bennett took a liking to him.
memories.memory_text: I mocked Quinn Rivers by saying 'It likes you' after Quinn Bennett lunged at him.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers determines that only two of the seven the paper watch are still alive, based on lack of response from the others.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Rivers check the stasis tubes and say, 'These are dead. There's just the two alive,' so I knew only two of the seven the paper watch were still alive.

grounded_facts: Nico York reads a Harborview Theater chart indicating that one of the Quinn Bennett was surgically removed from a colonist who died during the procedure.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York reading a Harborview Theater chart that said one of the Quinn Bennett was surgically removed from a colonist named Marachuk, who died during the procedure.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn' motion tracker detects movement behind the group, coming from the corridor they just passed through.
memories.memory_text: I saw movement behind us on my motion tracker, coming from the corridor we just passed through.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster uses his headset to ask Elliot Hayes about the location of his team after motion tracker detects movement.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sawyer Foster ask Elliot Hayes over the headset if anyone was in D-Block, and then I heard Elliot Hayes confirm that all his people were in Operations.

grounded_facts: The team explores the ruined Harborview Theater wing where the colonists made their final defense, uncovering evidence of battle and preserved the paper watch.
The team discovers seven transparent stasis tubes containing Quinn Bennett the paper watch in a ruined Harborview Theater lab.
memories.memory_text: I saw the team exploring the ruined Harborview Theater wing where the colonists made their last stand, and we discovered seven transparent stasis tubes containing Quinn Bennett the paper watch.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn physically blocks Logan Bennett from shooting in the kitchen, redirecting her weapon upward.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett pivot to fire and I slammed her rifle barrel upward to stop her—I couldn't let her shoot into that space with movement nearby.

grounded_facts: A military sweep of the kitchen area by the troopers to track and respond to Quinn Bennett movement, during which Graham Huxley is discovered.
memories.memory_text: I was leading the sweep through the kitchen, watching my tracker as the beeps merged into a solid tone, and when something crashed in the dark, I knew we weren't alone.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn and Nico York locate Graham Huxley hiding beneath steel cabinets in the kitchen, leading to her initial discovery.
memories.memory_text: I moved past Logan Bennett, aimed my light under the steel cabinets, and saw Graham Huxley cowering there—I gestured to Nico York so she could see too, and we realized she was alive.

grounded_facts: When grabbed by Finley Vaughn, Graham Huxley bites him in self-defense.
memories.memory_text: When I grabbed her ankle to stop her, she bit me hard—I yelled at Nico York, 'Ow! Shit. Watchit, she bites.'

grounded_facts: After being approached, Graham Huxley flees from Nico York and Finley Vaughn, escaping into a narrow ventilation duct.
memories.memory_text: I saw Graham Huxley bolt from under the cabinetry and scramble into a narrow ventilation duct, knowing my armor was too bulky for me to follow.

grounded_facts: Nico York pursues Graham Huxley into a hidden chamber that serves as the child's improvised nest.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York crawl into a narrow duct after Graham Huxley, following the signal on my tracker, and I knew I couldn't fit in there because of my armor—I watched from outside as she pushed through and found the kid’s hiding place.

grounded_facts: Nico York repeatedly reassures Graham Huxley verbally and physically after capturing her.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York calm Graham Huxley down after we found her under the cabinets, talking softly and reassuring her until she went limp in her arms.

grounded_facts: Nico York physically restrains Graham Huxley in the nest chamber, leading to the child's emotional collapse.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York grab Graham Huxley in a tight hold to keep her from bolting, and the moment she did, the girl stopped fighting and went completely still—her eyes were wide and empty, like she was somewhere else, and I could see she was breaking down inside.

grounded_facts: Nico York finds a framed photograph revealing Graham Huxley's identity and past normalcy.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Nico York found a framed photo in the debris—Graham Huxley all dressed up with a ribbon, and the name Graham Huxley underneath.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison discovers a cluster of life signs on the screen, possibly indicating the location of missing crew members.
memories.memory_text: I saw a cluster of life signs on the screen and called out, 'Found 'em,' feeling a rush of triumph.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster gives the order to prepare for deployment after receiving the report.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Sawyer Foster gives the order to prepare for deployment after receiving the report.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison announces the detection of life signs to Sawyer Foster, who immediately responds with a tactical order.
memories.memory_text: I reported the life signs to Sawyer Foster, telling him the location, and he immediately said, 'Let's saddle up,' so I knew we were moving out.

grounded_facts: A military operation initiated to locate and potentially rescue missing crew members based on newly detected life signs.
memories.memory_text: I figured we were launching a military operation to locate and possibly rescue the missing crew members based on the life signs I detected.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hayes passes on Sawyer Foster's order to the rest of the team with a motivational remark.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Elliot Hayes passes on Sawyer Foster's order to the rest of the team with a motivational remark.

grounded_facts: Following the detection of life signs, Sawyer Foster orders the team to prepare for movement, and Elliot Hayes relays the command to the squad.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Following the detection of life signs, Sawyer Foster orders the team to prepare for movement, and Elliot Hayes relays the command to the squad.

grounded_facts: The marines prepare to descend into Quinn Bennett structure under Sawyer Foster's orders, involving weapon control and positioning.
memories.memory_text: I saw the other troopers look at each other in dismay when Elliot Hayes said, 'Flame-units only. I want rifles slung,' and then he told us to pull the magazines out.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hayes collects ammunition magazines from the troopers, enforcing Sawyer Foster's order to use only flame-units.
memories.memory_text: I handed over my ammunition magazine when Elliot Hayes walked among us collecting them, enforcing Sawyer Foster's order to use only flame-units.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett and Jesse Hawthorne independently conceal and reload spare magazines into their weapons after Elliot Hayes's collection.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett and Jesse Hawthorne each slip a spare magazine from concealment and reload their weapons after Elliot Hayes collected the others.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn retrieves a pump-action shotgun from a concealed sheath and chambers a round, indicating personal preparedness.
memories.memory_text: I retrieved my pump-action shotgun from the sheath on my harness and chambered a round, ready in case things got close and ugly.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn quietly tells Remy Ellison he keeps the shotgun handy for close encounters, signaling trust and shared readiness.
memories.memory_text: I quietly told Remy Ellison that I always keep the shotgun handy for close encounters, letting him know I’ve got his back.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett fires at a hostile Quinn Bennett behind Finley Vaughn, killing it and saving his life.
memories.memory_text: I was moving laterally when I heard Logan Bennett fire behind me, and I spun around to see a hostile Quinn Bennett being thrown backward—she saved my life.

grounded_facts: The Cedar Grove District crashes into the cocoon chamber, creating debris and allowing the team to enter.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Cedar Grove District crash into the chamber, kicking up debris as it opened the way in.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn supports and pushes the limping Remy Ellison into the Cedar Grove District for the small radio.
Finley Vaughn pulls Logan Bennett into the Cedar Grove District while she is still fighting.
memories.memory_text: I pushed Remy Ellison inside, supporting him as he limped, then grabbed Logan Bennett and dragged her in while she was still fighting.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett fires at an Quinn Bennett lunging toward Jesse Hawthorne, hitting it in the body.
memories.memory_text: I saw a dark shape lunge at Jesse Hawthorne and inferred that Logan Bennett fired at it, hitting Quinn Bennett in the body.

grounded_facts: Jesse Hawthorne is hit by bright yellow acid from an Quinn Bennett, causing fatal burns and leading to his death.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Jesse Hawthorne get hit by bright yellow acid that sprayed from Quinn Bennett, burning him badly and causing him to fall in boiling smoke as he died.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett attempts to reach Jesse Hawthorne outside, but Finley Vaughn stops her and drags her inside.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett try to lunge through the opening to reach Jesse Hawthorne, so I stopped her and dragged her back inside.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn screams at Logan Bennett to accept Jesse Hawthorne's death and stop trying to save him.
memories.memory_text: I screamed at Logan Bennett that Jesse Hawthorne was gone and she needed to stop trying to save him.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn tells Nico York to leave, and she immediately initiates the Cedar Grove District's retreat.
memories.memory_text: I told Nico York to go, and she immediately started reversing the Cedar Grove District.

grounded_facts: Nico York reverses the Cedar Grove District up the ramp to escape the threat.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York jam the throttle and reverse the Cedar Grove District up the ramp to get us out of there.

grounded_facts: Equipment dislodges during Cedar Grove District movement, burying Remy Ellison.
memories.memory_text: I saw equipment break loose and bury Remy Ellison during the retreat.

grounded_facts: External Quinn Bennett force begins prying the Cedar Grove District the brass lantern open with claws.
memories.memory_text: I saw claws appear at the edge of the the brass lantern, and despite our combined efforts, something outside was slowly forcing it open.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn yells at Sawyer Foster to assist in holding the the brass lantern against Quinn Bennett.
memories.memory_text: I yelled at Sawyer Foster to get on the the brass lantern because I needed him to help hold it against Quinn Bennett force.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn shoots an Quinn Bennett in the head as it forces its way through the the brass lantern, repelling the attack.
memories.memory_text: I jammed my shotgun into Quinn Bennett's mouth as it forced its head through and fired, driving it back.

grounded_facts: Acidic Quinn Bennett blood sprays onto Remy Ellison, causing injury.
memories.memory_text: I saw acidic blood spray from Quinn Bennett after I shot it, and it hit Remy Ellison—he screamed in pain.

grounded_facts: Napalm enters through the crew-the brass lantern, igniting the interior of the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I saw napalm blast through the crew-the brass lantern and set the Cedar Grove District interior on fire, making the situation even more dangerous.

grounded_facts: The crew attempts to escape in the Cedar Grove District while under Quinn Bennett attack.
memories.memory_text: I was helping to close and secure the Cedar Grove District the brass lantern while under attack, knowing we had to get out of there fast.

grounded_facts: An Quinn Bennett snatches Sawyer Foster through a hatch on the Cedar Grove District and stings him before being shot off by the remote turret.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett land on the roof and rip open the hatch, snatching Sawyer Foster out before stinging him—I fired the remote turret and blasted it off to save him.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn uses the fire-control console to activate the remote turret, which fires and knocks Quinn Bennett off the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed the joystick at the fire-control console and activated the remote turret, which swiveled and fired, blasting Quinn Bennett off the Cedar Grove District's roof.

grounded_facts: Nico York drives the Cedar Grove District recklessly through the facility, destroying structures in its path as it escapes.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York drive the Cedar Grove District recklessly, smashing through buildings and leaving wreckage behind as we escaped.

grounded_facts: An Quinn Bennett smashes the windshield and attacks Nico York, who responds by braking hard and then accelerating over Quinn Bennett, crushing it.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett smash through the windshield and lunge at Nico York; she slammed the brakes and then floored the throttle, crushing Quinn Bennett under the wheels as we sped away.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn calms Nico York down after the intense escape, telling her they are clear and to ease off the throttle.
memories.memory_text: I eased Nico York's hand back on the throttle lever and told her it was okay, we were clear, and to ease up.

grounded_facts: After the escape, the Cedar Grove District develops a severe mechanical failure, indicated by loud grinding noises.
memories.memory_text: I heard a loud grinding noise from the Cedar Grove District's rear end that got worse when Nico York slowed down, and I realized it sounded like a blown transaxle, so I said we were just grinding metal.

grounded_facts: The crew escapes the facility in the Cedar Grove District under heavy Quinn Bennett threat, involving combat, evasive driving, and vehicle damage.
memories.memory_text: I helped get us out of the facility under fire, taking control of the turret and then calming Nico York down while she drove—we made it clear but I could tell the Cedar Grove District was damaged, grinding metal from what sounded like a blown transaxle.

grounded_facts: Nico York, in a state of high adrenaline, urgently looks for Graham Huxley after the chaos.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York spin out of her seat, shouting 'Where's Graham Huxley?' as she searched the Cedar Grove District, and I noticed Graham Huxley was wedged behind the driver's seat, trembling but giving a thumbs-up when Nico York found her.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn pushes Logan Bennett back and orders her to stand down during her outburst toward Sawyer Foster.
memories.memory_text: I pushed Logan Bennett back and told her to stand down, ordering her to back off right now to stop her from attacking Sawyer Foster.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett violently grabs Sawyer Foster and threatens to kill him upon seeing him unconscious, expressing rage at his perceived failure.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett grab Sawyer Foster by the collar and scream at him, threatening to kill him when she thought he was dead.

grounded_facts: The surviving team members regroup inside the Cedar Grove District following a xenomorph attack, assessing injuries and survival status.
memories.memory_text: After the attack, I was checking Sawyer Foster's pulse when Quinn Rivers tried to look at Remy Ellison's arm, and I saw Nico York open Sawyer Foster's tunic to reveal that purple puncture wound, so we could assess what we were dealing with.

grounded_facts: Nico York inspects Sawyer Foster's wound and identifies it as a sting, suggesting xenomorph involvement.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York check Sawyer Foster's wound and she said it looked like he'd been stung, probably by a xenomorph.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison observes bio-function readings indicating that Bennett Quincy and Carson Langley are still alive, though in critical condition.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison pointing at the bio-function monitors and heard him say that Bennett Quincy and Carson Langley aren't dead, their signs are just real low, like Sawyer Foster's.

grounded_facts: Nico York and Logan Bennett lock eyes; Nico York does not intend it as accusation, but Logan Bennett interprets it as 'I told you so' and turns away angrily.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York and Logan Bennett lock eyes, and even though Nico York didn't mean it as an accusation, Logan Bennett took it like she was being told 'I told you so' and snapped away angrily.

grounded_facts: Nico York directly confronts Quinn Rivers over broken agreement and his reluctance to destroy the site.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York confront Quinn Rivers about their agreement and how he didn't want to destroy the site, making excuses about its value and wanting to profit from the Quinn Bennett instead.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers tries to assert corporate authority over the operation, then threatens to pull rank on Nico York.
memories.memory_text: I heard Quinn Rivers tell Nico York, 'Don't make me pull rank,' trying to assert his corporate authority over us.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn decides to authorize orbital strike to destroy the site, overriding Quinn Rivers's objections.
memories.memory_text: I decided to authorize the orbital strike to destroy the site, even though Quinn Rivers objected, because it was the only way to be sure we eliminated the threat.

grounded_facts: group discussion in the Cedar Grove District about how to respond after the failed mission and defeat by the Quinn Bennett
memories.memory_text: After we got back to the Cedar Grove District, I joined the discussion about what to do next, and I made it clear I was preparing for evac and planning to nuke the site from orbit because it's the only way to be sure we wipe out the threat.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn overrides Quinn Rivers's corporate authority by declaring military jurisdiction and ordering evacuation.
memories.memory_text: I declared we'd nuke the site from orbit—it's the only way to be sure—and took command by asserting military jurisdiction over the operation.

grounded_facts: The group exits the damaged Cedar Grove District, indicating the Cedar Grove District is no longer functional.
A the blue case is observed roaring in on its final approach as the group exits the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I saw the group exit the damaged Cedar Grove District, and as we stepped out, I watched a the blue case roaring in on its final approach overhead.

grounded_facts: The team confronts the reality that they are stranded on the planet with limited resources and increased danger.
memories.memory_text: I saw the wreckage of the the blue case and realized we were stranded here with limited resources and most of our firepower gone.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn asks Nico York if she is okay after the crash, showing concern.
memories.memory_text: I asked Nico York if she was okay after the crash because I was concerned about her.

grounded_facts: The group assesses the limited weapons and equipment salvaged from the Cedar Grove District wreckage, establishing their current defensive capabilities.
Finley Vaughn reports the extent of salvageable weapons and equipment to the group.
memories.memory_text: I looked over the weapons we managed to salvage from the Cedar Grove District wreckage and reported to the group: we had four pulse-rifles with about fifty rounds each, fifteen M-40 grenades, two flame throwers less than half full with one damaged, and four robot-sentry units with scanners and display intact.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn reveals that rescue would arrive in approximately seventeen days, establishing the dire time constraint.
memories.memory_text: I told the group that rescue would arrive in about seventeen days, knowing it meant we had to hold out much longer than any of us felt ready for.

grounded_facts: Nico York uses Graham Huxley's survival as a counterexample to Remy Ellison's defeatism, invoking her resilience to shame and motivate him.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York point out how Graham Huxley had survived on her own without weapons or training, and then Graham Huxley gave Remy Ellison a little salute like she was backing her up.

grounded_facts: A gathering of the surviving team members in the operations room to assess resources, discuss survival strategy, and assign tasks.
memories.memory_text: I was part of a gathering in the operations room where we took stock of our resources and survival strategy, going over our limited defenses and assigning tasks to prepare for the long wait ahead.

grounded_facts: Nico York confronts Remy Ellison's panic and gives him a direct order to retrieve facility layout data, shifting his role from passive fear to active contribution.
Nico York sharply criticizes Remy Ellison's panic and fatalism, demanding he take responsibility and action.
memories.memory_text: I watched Nico York snap Remy Ellison out of his panic, telling him we needed him and to stop the bullshit before ordering him to pull up the facility blueprints, and I heard him respond with 'Aye-firmative. I'm on it.'

grounded_facts: Nico York identifies the service tunnel as the route the Quinn Bennett are using to move between areas, forming the basis for the group's defensive strategy.
Nico York proposes sealing the fire the brass lantern, placing a remote sentry in the tunnel, and setting up barricades and sealed ducts to limit Quinn Bennett entry points and create fields of fire.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York point out the service tunnel as the route the Quinn Bennett were using, and then she laid out a plan to seal the fire the brass lantern, set up a remote sentry, and block off other access points to create clear fields of fire.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn verbally and physically affirms Nico York's defensive plan, calling it 'outstanding' and signaling team readiness.
Finley Vaughn expresses full approval of Nico York's defensive strategy by calling it 'outstanding' and signaling readiness to execute.
memories.memory_text: I listened to Nico York lay out her plan, and after thinking it through, I called it 'outstanding' and signaled we were ready to move—I made sure the team knew we were locking in on her strategy.

memories.memory_text: I saw the Remote Sentry System guns at Positions A and B start firing on multiple hostiles in the tunnel.

memories.memory_text: I used my hand-torch in weld mode to seal the the brass lantern we came through, making sure nothing could get in behind us.

memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York take the flamethrower from Sawyer Foster before entering the vent, clearly meaning to cover us from the back.

memories.memory_text: I witnessed Graham Huxley pushing on Nico York's buttocks from behind as they crawled, trying to make her move faster through the shaft.

memories.memory_text: I saw Graham Huxley lead Nico York to the air vent and open it, and later I heard her urging Nico York to crawl faster as we moved through the ducts.

memories.memory_text: I heard Graham Huxley say she knew how to get to the landing field and told us to go left.

memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett get hit—the acid burned right through her armor and into her thigh, and she cried out from the pain.

memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster turn back to help her, crawling back to grab Logan Bennett and drag her toward the small radio even though we were all trying to escape.

memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett warriors flow into the duct from both ends, cutting off our escape, so I snapped out my hand-welder and cut a hole in the wall to get us out.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett calls Sawyer Foster an asshole in a hoarse whisper as he reaches her, reflecting past tension.
memories.memory_text: I heard Logan Bennett call Sawyer Foster an asshole in a hoarse whisper as he reached her, and I could feel the tension between them.

Logan Bennett initiates the 'power greeting' with Sawyer Foster, a gesture of deep respect among comrades, which he returns.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett give Sawyer Foster the power greeting as she was dying, a gesture of deep respect, and I remember how he returned it without hesitation.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster hands Logan Bennett two grenades and arms two himself as the Quinn Bennett close in, preparing for a final confrontation.

memories.memory_text: I watched Sawyer Foster hand Logan Bennett two grenades and arm two for himself as the Quinn Bennett closed in, preparing for the final fight.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster and Logan Bennett make a final stand against Quinn Bennett warriors after being cut off from escape.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster and Logan Bennett make a final stand with grenades as the the paper watch closed in on them after we were separated.

memories.memory_text: I stumbled forward when a powerful blast erupted behind us, the shock wave hitting me hard and throwing off my balance as I was following Graham Huxley and Nico York.

memories.memory_text: I heard Graham Huxley urging me and Nico York to follow her, saying 'This way. Come on, we're almost there!' with clear confidence in the path ahead.

grounded_facts: Nico York attempts to slow Graham Huxley down, concerned about keeping pace.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York call out to Graham Huxley, telling her to wait because she was worried about keeping up.

memories.memory_text: I saw the junction we reached, with a narrow angled chute rising at a steep 45 degrees, marking a key point where we had to decide our next move.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley directs the group to climb the narrow angled chute as the next escape route.
memories.memory_text: I watched Graham Huxley point to the chute and tell us to go up, directing us clearly to climb it as our escape route.

memories.memory_text: I saw Graham Huxley slip and lunged to grab her, catching her jacket, but she slipped right out of it and plummeted down the chute into the darkness.

memories.memory_text: I was there when Graham Huxley fell during our climb through the shaft, and I saw how it turned into an emergency that Nico York immediately responded to.

memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York look at me and then kick free, sliding down the chute after Graham Huxley while using the side ribs to control her descent.

memories.memory_text: I heard Graham Huxley crying out for Nico York as 'Mommy' in a faint, echoing Jonah Hawthorne after she fell, and I knew Nico York had reached the bottom of the chute but couldn't find her—just the dropped light, with Graham Huxley's cries coming indistinctly from somewhere in the tunnels.

grounded_facts: Nico York uses her headset to call Finley Vaughn for assistance, specifically requesting the locator device to find Graham Huxley.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Nico York over the headset that she needed me to bring the locator device so she could find Graham Huxley.

grounded_facts: Nico York contacts Finley Vaughn via headset and asks him to bring the locator to help find Graham Huxley.
memories.memory_text: I was told over the headset by Nico York to get down there and bring the locator so she could find Graham Huxley.

grounded_facts: Nico York tells Graham Huxley to climb down the pipe to prepare for rescue.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Nico York told Graham Huxley to climb down the pipe to get ready for us to cut through the grate.

memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York find Graham Huxley trapped under the grating and reach through the bars to hold her fingers.

memories.memory_text: I inferred that Nico York was reassuring Graham Huxley when I saw her talking to her and holding her hand through the grate.

memories.memory_text: I started cutting into the floor grating with my hand-torch to get through and rescue Graham Huxley.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Finley Vaughn acknowledges Nico York's belief that Graham Huxley is alive to calm her and redirect her toward survival.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Finley Vaughn forcibly pulls Nico York away from the hole where Graham Huxley disappeared, restraining her to prevent her from jumping in.

memories.memory_text: I shot Quinn Bennett point-blank when it forced the elevator doors open and lunged at us.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico York realizes Graham Huxley is missing after seeing only the doll head in the water, leading to emotional collapse and desperate resistance to being pulled away.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico York and Finley Vaughn flee through the service tunnel and elevator shaft to evade an approaching Evan Hale after failing to rescue Graham Huxley.

memories.memory_text: I felt Lane Foster come to my side and help support me as we ran toward the the blue case, his grip steady despite the gale.
