grounded_facts: Nico York confronts Lane Foster with the knowledge that Graham Huxley is alive and was brought to the facility, implying betrayal or concealment.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Nico York that Graham Huxley is alive and that they brought her here, and she accused Lane Foster of knowing about it.

grounded_facts: Nico York instructs Finley Vaughn to ensure Lane Foster does not leave, indicating distrust or strategic necessity.
memories.memory_text: I was instructed by Nico York to make sure Lane Foster didn't leave, so I knew I had to stop him if he tried.

grounded_facts: Nico York and Finley Vaughn share a brief, respectful moment before her departure, using first names to affirm mutual trust and camaraderie.
memories.memory_text: I told Nico York my name is Finley Vaughn, and she told me hers was Nico York—we shared a brief moment of connection, a handshake full of mutual respect, before she left. I said, 'Don't be long, Nico York,' hoping she'd come back.

grounded_facts: Nico York exits the the blue case via the ramp, heading toward the freight elevator to continue her mission.
memories.memory_text: I watched Nico York run down the ramp and head across the platform to the freight elevator; the doors closed behind her as she continued her mission.

grounded_facts: Nico York wakes up in the hypersleep vault, sits up, and begins to rub her arms briskly as the capsule canopy is raised.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York wake up and sit up in her capsule, rubbing her arms briskly as the canopy opened.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison complains about the cold floor, prompting Elliot Hayes to mock him for being overly sensitive.
memories.memory_text: I heard Remy Ellison complain about the cold floor, and I saw Elliot Hayes mock him for it, calling him an old woman and offering to fetch his slippers.

grounded_facts: As Nico York steps back, Logan Bennett eyes her coldly, signaling distrust or antagonism toward her as an outsider.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Logan Bennett give Nico York a cold look as she passed by, showing she didn't trust her or resented her being there.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett slaps Jesse Hawthorne's open palm, leading to a painful, competitive clenching before she cuffs him hard; both laugh viciously, indicating a bond forged through shared harsh training.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett slap Jesse Hawthorne's palm and turn it into a painful grip contest before cuffing him hard, and then they both broke into vicious laughter.

grounded_facts: Emery Bennett voices frustration about being sent out immediately without rest, emphasizing the need for 'slack' beyond frozen hypersleep.
memories.memory_text: I saw Emery Bennett express frustration about being sent out right away without rest, saying he needed some slack after waking up from hypersleep.

grounded_facts: Troopers and command staff gather in the mess hall for coffee and food while awaiting mission details.
memories.memory_text: I was in the mess hall with the other troopers, grabbing coffee and food while we waited for mission details, and I noticed the new Lieutenant wasn't eating with us grunts.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn observes that the new Lieutenant (Sawyer Foster) is too proud to eat with the regular troopers.
memories.memory_text: I noticed the new Lieutenant is too proud to eat with us grunts.

grounded_facts: Nico York accuses Quinn Rivers of withholding information about Lane Foster being an android.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York confront Quinn Rivers and demand to know why he never told her about Lane Foster being an android, saying it didn't occur to him even though synthetics are standard now.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster explains that modern synthetics cannot harm humans due to behavioral inhibitors.
memories.memory_text: I heard Lane Foster explain that modern synthetics can't harm humans because of behavioral inhibitors, saying it's impossible for him to hurt anyone.

grounded_facts: Nico York physically rejects Lane Foster's attempt to offer cornbread after learning he is an android, expressing distrust and demanding he stay away.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York physically reject Lane Foster when he offered her more cornbread after she learned he was an android, yelling at him to stay away.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison points out that Sawyer Foster mistakenly called him Finley Vaughn, asserting his correct identity.
memories.memory_text: I was present when Remy Ellison corrected Sawyer Foster, pointing out that I was Finley Vaughn and he was Remy Ellison, making it clear who was who right at the start of the briefing.

grounded_facts: A formal military briefing held before deployment to the colony, covering mission status, potential threats, and operational timelines.
memories.memory_text: I attended the pre-drop briefing where Sawyer Foster explained that we had no contact with the colony and that a xenomorph might be involved, setting the stakes for the mission.

grounded_facts: Nico York starts briefing the marines about the xenomorph life cycle and threat, providing recorded information and key biological details.
memories.memory_text: I listened to Nico York explain the xenomorph's life cycle, how it's two the paper watch and the first one implants an embryo before dying.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett signals her readiness to fight by miming shooting an Quinn Bennett, declaring 'Anytime. Anywhere.'
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett mime shooting and say 'Anytime. Anywhere,' showing she was ready to fight Quinn Bennett.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison makes a joke implying Logan Bennett misunderstood 'Quinn Bennett' as 'illegal Quinn Bennett' when enlisting.
memories.memory_text: I heard Remy Ellison joke that Logan Bennett thought 'Quinn Bennett' meant 'illegal Quinn Bennett' when she enlisted.

grounded_facts: Nico York coldly interrupts Remy Ellison's banter to reassert the seriousness of her briefing.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York interrupt Remy Ellison's joke, coldly shutting down the banter to keep the briefing on track.

grounded_facts: Nico York expresses her desire to contribute during the loading process and offers to operate the loader.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Nico York approached Elliot Hayes and said she felt left out, offering to operate the power loader because she had a Class Two rating.

grounded_facts: Final preparations for the the blue case's mission, including loading equipment and vehicles.
memories.memory_text: I saw the final preparations for the the blue case mission happening around me, with equipment and vehicles being loaded up.

grounded_facts: Nico York powers up a power loader and successfully operates it to lift a cargo module, demonstrating her skill.
memories.memory_text: I watched Nico York power up the loader and skillfully lift a cargo module with it, moving the controls smoothly and confidently.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn silently shows approval of Nico York's skill with the power loader by raising an eyebrow at Elliot Hayes.
memories.memory_text: I raised my eyebrow at Elliot Hayes to silently show I was impressed with Nico York's skill on the loader.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison attempts to reassure Nico York by boasting about his squad's combat readiness.
memories.memory_text: I tried to reassure Nico York by telling her me and my squad of ultimate badasses would protect her.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison demonstrates confidence and weapon knowledge by showcasing the the blue case's armaments, escalating tension.
memories.memory_text: I prowled the aisle and showed off the the blue case's weapons, talking about the particle-beam phalanx and all the gear we had, to let everyone know I was ready and confident.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn physically interrupts Remy Ellison's rant by pulling him into a seat, reasserting discipline.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Remy Ellison by his harness and pulled him into a seat to shut him down, then told him to save it.

grounded_facts: Nico York silently thanks Finley Vaughn for stopping Remy Ellison's disruptive behavior.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York nod her thanks to me after I stopped Remy Ellison.

grounded_facts: The Cedar Grove District is descending to the surface of LV-426, marking the beginning of the mission deployment under shaky conditions.
memories.memory_text: I was asleep in my harness when the Cedar Grove District began to buck during descent to LV-426, and I remember the shaky start of our mission.

grounded_facts: Nico York challenges Sawyer Foster's qualifications by asking how many drops he has had, implying skepticism about his competence.
memories.memory_text: I heard Nico York ask Sawyer Foster how many drops he'd had, and I noticed her skepticism when he only mentioned simulations.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett presses Sawyer Foster to clarify how many of his drops were actual combat situations, highlighting the gap between simulation and real warfare.
Sawyer Foster admits that he has only two actual combat drops, with the current one being potentially his third, exposing his lack of real combat experience despite his rank and responsibility.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett press Sawyer Foster about combat drops, and when he admitted only two real ones before this, I realized how little actual experience he had.

grounded_facts: After learning of Sawyer Foster's inexperience, Nico York gives Quinn Rivers an accusing look, holding him responsible for the questionable military leadership.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York give Quinn Rivers an accusing look after learning about Sawyer Foster's inexperience, as if holding him responsible for the situation.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hayes orders Fire-team A to gear up and move out in two minutes.
Elliot Hayes commands Fire-team A to gear up and prepare for deployment within two minutes.
memories.memory_text: I was told to gear up and prepare for deployment within two minutes as part of Fire-team A, and someone was told to wake me up.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster, via Jonah Hawthorne over, directs the first squad to advance and Finley Vaughn to establish a cordon while watching the rear.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Sawyer Foster over the comms to get my squad into a cordon and watch the rear while the first squad moved up.

grounded_facts: After exiting the Cedar Grove District, the troopers immediately assume tactical positions, spreading out and taking cover near the colony complex.
memories.memory_text: After we exited the Cedar Grove District, I saw the troopers spreading out and taking cover near the colony complex as we set up our positions.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster commands the team to split into pairs and search the colony building, assigning Finley Vaughn to take the upper level with motion trackers.
Sawyer Foster directly assigns Finley Vaughn to take the upper level of the colony building and use motion trackers during the search.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Sawyer Foster to take the upper level of the colony building and use my motion trackers while searching in pairs.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn and his squad reach the second level of the main concourse and emerge cautiously into a dim corridor.
memories.memory_text: I led my squad up the stairwell and we emerged cautiously into a dim corridor on the second level.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn uses equipment to scan for movement down the corridor; detects nothing.
memories.memory_text: I unslung my motion scanner, aimed it down the hall, adjusted the gain, and saw there was nothing—no movement detected.

grounded_facts: A section of the wall is found to be corroded almost through, indicating the presence of Quinn Bennett acid blood.
memories.memory_text: I saw a section of the wall on my monitor that was corroded almost through, which made me realize Quinn Bennett acid blood had likely caused the damage.

grounded_facts: Nico York urgently tells Finley Vaughn to back up and pan left on his camera, then plugs in her headset to communicate directly.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Nico York to back up and pan left on my camera, then she plugged in her headset to talk to me directly.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers raises an eyebrow and remarks on the corrosive damage, referencing the known trait of xenomorphs having acidic blood.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Rivers raise an eyebrow and say, 'Hmm. Acid for blood,' when he noticed the damage.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn observes the melted appearance and suggests that one of Nico York's 'bad guys'—an Quinn Bennett—has been captured or killed here.
memories.memory_text: I looked at the melted area and thought one of Nico York's bad guys must've been captured or killed there, so I said it out loud.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn communicates over radio that his squad has completed their search and found no one present.
memories.memory_text: I reported over the radio that my squad had just finished sweeping the area and found nobody home.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hayes informs Sawyer Foster that the area is empty and they have arrived after whatever event occurred, concluding the site is inactive.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elliot Hayes tell Sawyer Foster the place was dead and that whatever happened, we missed it.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster declares the area secured, indicating a shift from potential threat to the small radio.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sawyer Foster declare the area secured, which meant we were no longer under immediate threat.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster gives orders to the team regarding their next actions after securing the area.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sawyer Foster give orders to the team after securing the area, including sending the first team to operations, telling Remy Ellison to activate the CPU, and instructing me to meet him at the south lock by the up-link tower.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster assigns specific tasks to team members: first team to operations, Remy Ellison to activate CPU, Finley Vaughn to meet at south lock.
memories.memory_text: I was directly assigned by Sawyer Foster to meet him at the south lock by the up-link tower, while he sent the first team to operations and ordered Remy Ellison to get the CPU online.

grounded_facts: The Cedar Grove District arrives at the entrance of the colony complex, positioning itself close to the south lock.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Cedar Grove District roll up close to the colony entrance, positioning itself near the south lock as we arrived.

grounded_facts: The military and scientific team disembarks from the Cedar Grove District to begin operations at the colony entrance.
memories.memory_text: I watched the team, including Sawyer Foster, Quinn Rivers, Lane Foster, and Riley Cavendish, disembark from the Cedar Grove District to begin operations at the colony entrance.

grounded_facts: Riley Cavendish appears suddenly behind Nico York, causing her to scream in fright.
memories.memory_text: I saw Riley Cavendish suddenly appear behind Nico York, and she screamed in fright when she noticed him.

grounded_facts: Riley Cavendish apologizes for scaring Nico York and explains he was sent by Finley Vaughn to watch her.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Riley Cavendish apologized for scaring Nico York and explained he was sent by me to watch her.

grounded_facts: Riley Cavendish gestures for Nico York to go inside first.
memories.memory_text: I learned that Riley Cavendish gestured for Nico York to go inside first after he joined her outside.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn notices Nico York's nervousness and signals Riley Cavendish to flank her, forming a two-man protective cordon.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Nico York was nervous, so I signaled Riley Cavendish with my eyes to flank her, and we formed a two-man protective cordon around her.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn gives Nico York a quick wink, possibly to reassure her, though it is subtle enough to be ambiguous.
memories.memory_text: I gave Nico York a quick wink, maybe to reassure her, though it was so fast she might not have noticed or could've thought it was just something in my eye.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer emerges from a side corridor and alerts Sawyer Foster that something requires immediate attention.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer emerge from a side corridor ahead and alert Sawyer Foster that something required immediate attention.

grounded_facts: Nico York warns Quinn Rivers to keep his distance from the stasis tube as he leans too close.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico York warns Quinn Rivers to keep his distance from the stasis tube as he leans too close.

grounded_facts: One of Quinn Bennett specimens in stasis lunges at the glass and extends a tubule toward Quinn Rivers when he leans too close.
memories.memory_text: I remember that One of Quinn Bennett specimens in stasis lunges at the glass and extends a tubule toward Quinn Rivers when he leans too close.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn makes a sarcastic remark implying Quinn Bennett specimen is attracted to Quinn Rivers after it reacts to him.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Finley Vaughn makes a sarcastic remark implying Quinn Bennett specimen is attracted to Quinn Rivers after it reacts to him.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers determines that only two of the seven the paper watch are still alive.
memories.memory_text: I heard Quinn Rivers say only two of the seven the paper watch are still alive, the rest are dead.

grounded_facts: Nico York reads a Harborview Theater chart revealing that one specimen was surgically removed from a colonist who died during the procedure.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York read from a Harborview Theater chart that they removed an Quinn Bennett from Marachuk, John L. during surgery, and he died in the process — they killed him getting it off.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn' motion tracker detects movement behind the group, indicating a possible threat in the corridor.
memories.memory_text: I saw movement behind us on my motion tracker and immediately warned the team.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster uses his headset to confirm the location of Elliot Hayes's team after detecting motion behind them.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster use his headset to check on Elliot Hayes's team after we detected motion behind us, and I heard Elliot Hayes confirm they were all in Operations.

grounded_facts: The team explores the devastated Harborview Theater wing, uncovering evidence of a last stand and the paper watch in stasis.
The team discovers seven stasis tubes containing preserved the paper watch in a ruined Harborview Theater lab.
memories.memory_text: I followed Nico York and the team into the ruined Harborview Theater lab, where we discovered seven stasis tubes containing preserved the paper watch—some of them still alive.

grounded_facts: A military sweep of the kitchen area by Finley Vaughn, Logan Bennett, and the squad, during which Graham Huxley is discovered and rescued by Nico York.
memories.memory_text: I was part of the sweep through the kitchen with the squad, moving carefully through the equipment while my tracker signaled something close, and then we heard a crash as something shifted in the dark.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn physically blocks Logan Bennett's weapon from firing into the ceiling, preventing potential danger but drawing her anger.
memories.memory_text: I slammed Logan Bennett's rifle barrel upward to stop her from firing when she pivoted, redirecting the tracers into the ceiling, and she snapped at me with 'You fuck!' right after.

grounded_facts: When Finley Vaughn grabs Graham Huxley's ankle, she bites him in a reflexive act of fear and self-defense.
memories.memory_text: When I grabbed Graham Huxley's ankle to stop her, she bit me—I yelled out 'Ow! Shit. Watch it, she bites'—it was just a reflex from fear, I reckon.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn and Nico York locate Graham Huxley hiding beneath steel cabinets in the kitchen, leading to Nico York's decision to pursue her into a ventilation duct.
memories.memory_text: I saw Graham Huxley hiding under the steel cabinets in the kitchen with Nico York, and when she took off, I knew I couldn't fit into that tight duct in my armor, so Nico York went after her.

grounded_facts: Nico York chases Graham Huxley into a narrow ventilation duct, squeezing through to catch her before she escapes into a hidden chamber.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York chase Graham Huxley into the narrow ventilation duct and crawl in after her, but I knew my armor was too bulky for me to fit inside.

grounded_facts: Nico York discovers a makeshift child's nest filled with foraged items, revealing Graham Huxley's survival strategies and psychological state.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York crawl into the duct after the kid and emerge in a small chamber that looked like a nest—blankets, toys, all kinds of things the child had gathered—and I realized how alone and scared she must have been to make a hiding place like that.

grounded_facts: Nico York repeatedly soothes Graham Huxley while attempting to reach her, then after capture continues verbal reassurance despite the child's silence.
memories.memory_text: I heard Nico York talking softly to the kid the whole time, saying 'it's okay' and 'you're safe,' even after she was caught and just lying there silent, like she was trying to reach her through the shock.

grounded_facts: After initial resistance, Nico York physically restrains Graham Huxley, who then becomes unresponsive, indicating severe trauma.
memories.memory_text: I reached out and grabbed the kid's ankle to stop her, but she broke free and I couldn't follow in my armor; later I saw Nico York wrestle her down and hold her tight as she thrashed, then go completely still and unresponsive in her arms.

grounded_facts: Nico York discovers a framed photograph of a healthy, smiling Graham Huxley with a school award, contrasting her current traumatized state.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York find a framed photo of Graham Huxley when we were searching the colony—she looked so different, happy and dressed up with a ribbon, holding a school award, nothing like the scared kid we just found.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hayes collects magazines from troopers' weapons, enforcing Sawyer Foster's order to use only flame-units.
A brief operational pause in which Sawyer Foster's order to use only flame-units is enforced by Elliot Hayes collecting magazines.
memories.memory_text: I saw Elliot Hayes enforce Sawyer Foster's order by collecting our magazines, telling us to sling our rifles and use only flame-units, so I pulled mine out when he came around.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett and Jesse Hawthorne secretly reload their weapons after magazine collection.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett and Jesse Hawthorne secretly reload their weapons after Elliot Hayes collected the magazines and moved on.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn reveals and arms a concealed pump-action shotgun for close combat.
memories.memory_text: I retrieved my pump-action shotgun from its sheath and chambered a round, ready in case we had to fight up close.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn quietly tells Remy Ellison he keeps a shotgun ready for close encounters.
memories.memory_text: I told Remy Ellison that I always keep the shotgun handy for close encounters.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett fires at a hostile Quinn Bennett about to attack Finley Vaughn, killing it and saving his life.
Logan Bennett fires near Finley Vaughn, alerting him to a threat behind him.
memories.memory_text: I heard Logan Bennett fire near me and spun around to see a nightmarish Quinn Bennett right behind me, already being thrown backward by her shot—she saved my life.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn supports and pushes the limping Remy Ellison into the Cedar Grove District for the small radio.
Finley Vaughn helps Remy Ellison into the Cedar Grove District and then drags Logan Bennett inside under fire.
Finley Vaughn physically pulls Logan Bennett into the Cedar Grove District while she is still fighting.
memories.memory_text: I pushed Remy Ellison into the Cedar Grove District and then grabbed Logan Bennett, dragging her inside even though she was still fighting and her gear was slowing me down.

grounded_facts: A chaotic combat retreat into the Cedar Grove District within the cocoon chamber under Quinn Bennett attack.
memories.memory_text: I was pulling Remy Ellison into the Cedar Grove District and then dragged Logan Bennett in too, even with all her gear slowing her down—we were under fire and falling back hard.

grounded_facts: The Cedar Grove District crashes into the cocoon chamber, creating chaos and debris.
memories.memory_text: I remember the Cedar Grove District crashing into the chamber, debris flying everywhere as I helped Remy Ellison through the smoke.

grounded_facts: An Quinn Bennett lunges at Jesse Hawthorne and is shot by Logan Bennett, but sprays acid on Jesse Hawthorne before dying.
Logan Bennett fires at Quinn Bennett lunging toward Jesse Hawthorne, killing it but failing to prevent acid splash.
memories.memory_text: I saw an Quinn Bennett lunge at Jesse Hawthorne, and Logan Bennett fired immediately, killing it—but acid still sprayed across his face and chest before he went down.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett attempts to reach Jesse Hawthorne outside, but Finley Vaughn stops and drags her inside.
memories.memory_text: I stopped Logan Bennett from going outside and dragged her back inside to secure the the brass lantern.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett irrationally insists that Jesse Hawthorne is still alive despite Finley Vaughn' assertion.
memories.memory_text: I heard Logan Bennett insist that Jesse Hawthorne was still alive, even though I knew it wasn't possible.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn instructs Nico York to initiate Cedar Grove District retreat.
memories.memory_text: I told Nico York to get us out of there by reversing the Cedar Grove District up the ramp.

grounded_facts: Nico York reverses the Cedar Grove District up the ramp to escape the threat.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York jam the throttle and reverse the Cedar Grove District up the ramp to escape the threat.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn yells at Sawyer Foster to assist in holding the the brass lantern, but Sawyer Foster freezes in fear.
memories.memory_text: I yelled at Sawyer Foster to get on the damn the brass lantern and help us hold it, but he just froze and backed away, staring wide-eyed instead of doing his job.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn shoots an Quinn Bennett in the head as it enters through the the brass lantern, repelling the attack.
memories.memory_text: I jammed my shotgun into Quinn Bennett's mouth and pulled the trigger to stop it from getting in.

grounded_facts: Spray of Quinn Bennett acid blood hits Remy Ellison, causing injury.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett's acid blood spray out and hit Remy Ellison on the arm, making him scream.

grounded_facts: Napalm enters through the crew-the brass lantern, igniting the interior of the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I saw napalm blast through the crew-the brass lantern and set the Cedar Grove District interior on fire while I was shouting at someone to get on the the brass lantern.

grounded_facts: External force from an Quinn Bennett begins to wrench the Cedar Grove District the brass lantern open.
memories.memory_text: I saw claws appear at the edge of the the brass lantern just as I was closing it, and I could feel the the brass lantern being slowly wrenched open by something powerful outside, so I threw my weight against it with Quinn Rivers and Logan Bennett to force it shut and lock it tight.

grounded_facts: The crew successfully closes and locks the Cedar Grove District the brass lantern against external force.
memories.memory_text: I helped the others slide the Cedar Grove District the brass lantern shut and dog it tight to keep the Quinn Bennett out.

grounded_facts: An Quinn Bennett attacks Sawyer Foster, pulling him through a hatch and stinging him before being shot off the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett rip Sawyer Foster halfway out through the hatch and sting him while he was dangling.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn uses the fire-control console to activate a remote turret that blasts Quinn Bennett off the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I used the fire-control console to activate the remote turret and blasted Quinn Bennett off the Cedar Grove District.

grounded_facts: The crew flees the facility in Cedar Grove District 104, engaging in evasive maneuvers and combat with Quinn Bennett during extraction.
memories.memory_text: I was part of the crew fleeing the facility in Cedar Grove District 104, and I remember us swerving and crushing an Quinn Bennett during the escape.

grounded_facts: Nico York slams the brakes and then accelerates forward, crushing an Quinn Bennett that had broken through the windshield.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett smash through the windshield and lunge at Nico York, so I helped her keep control of the Cedar Grove District after she slammed the brakes and then accelerated forward, crushing Quinn Bennett under the wheels.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn calms Nico York down after Quinn Bennett attack, telling her they are clear and easing her grip on the throttle.
memories.memory_text: I eased Nico York's hand back on the throttle and told her it was okay, we were clear, and she needed to ease up.

grounded_facts: The Cedar Grove District sustains mechanical damage to its transaxle, producing a loud grinding noise when decelerating.
memories.memory_text: I heard a grinding noise from the rear of the Cedar Grove District when we slowed down, and I realized it sounded like a blown transaxle, just grinding metal.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers tries to examine Remy Ellison's injured arm.
memories.memory_text: I watched Quinn Rivers try to examine Remy Ellison's injured arm, but Remy Ellison was too out of it to respond.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett verbally attacks the unconscious Sawyer Foster, blaming him for the team's destruction.
Logan Bennett violently grabs Sawyer Foster, blaming him for the disaster, and threatens to kill him.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett grab Sawyer Foster by the collar and scream at him, calling him a useless fuck and threatening to kill him while he was still unconscious.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn physically intervenes to stop Logan Bennett from attacking Sawyer Foster further.
memories.memory_text: I pushed Logan Bennett back, getting right in her face to stop her from hurting Sawyer Foster any further.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn forcefully tells Logan Bennett to back off from Sawyer Foster.
memories.memory_text: I told Logan Bennett to hold it and back off right now, making sure she knew I meant it.

grounded_facts: Nico York inspects Sawyer Foster and identifies a purple puncture wound, deducing he was stung by Quinn Bennett.
memories.memory_text: I was checking Sawyer Foster's pulse when Nico York came over, opened his tunic, and found a purple puncture wound—I heard her say it looked like Quinn Bennett stung him.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison notices that Bennett Quincy and Carson Langley are still alive, though with low vital signs, on the bio-function screens.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison pointing at the bio-function screens and heard him say that Bennett Quincy and Carson Langley weren't dead, just like Sawyer Foster, with really low vital signs.

grounded_facts: Nico York informs the group that Bennett Quincy and Carson Langley are being cocooned like the others, making rescue impossible.
memories.memory_text: I remember Nico York telling us that we couldn't help Bennett Quincy and Carson Langley because they were being cocooned just like the others.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison is in shock, holding his arm and mentally replaying the traumatic events.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison holding his arm and staring off, clearly shaken—he looked pale and panicked, muttering to himself like he couldn't believe what was happening.

grounded_facts: Nico York confronts Quinn Rivers about his refusal to authorize the orbital strike, questioning his motives.
memories.memory_text: I heard Nico York confront Quinn Rivers about refusing to authorize the orbital strike, and when Quinn Rivers tried to justify it with profit talk, I realized how far he was willing to go.

grounded_facts: Quinn Rivers tries to assert corporate authority over military operations, but is challenged and undermined.
memories.memory_text: I heard Quinn Rivers try to undermine my authority, saying I was just a grunt and couldn't make big decisions, though he added 'no offense' like that made it better.

grounded_facts: Team discusses and finalizes plan to evacuate and destroy Quinn Bennett site from orbit.
memories.memory_text: I decided we needed to prep for immediate evac and nuke the site from orbit—I said it myself, it's the only way to be sure we wipe out the threat.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn confirms his position in the chain of command and makes the final decision on evacuation and strike.
memories.memory_text: I confirmed that I was next in the chain of command and decided we'd take off and nuke the site from orbit—it was the only way to be sure.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn decides to authorize orbital strike to destroy the site, overriding Quinn Rivers's objections.
memories.memory_text: I decided we had to nuke the site from orbit and ordered immediate evac prep, even though Quinn Rivers objected.

grounded_facts: The group exits the Cedar Grove District, which is damaged beyond use.
memories.memory_text: I helped Remy Ellison carry Sawyer Foster as we got out of the Cedar Grove District, which was wrecked and useless now.

grounded_facts: The ground team realizes they are stranded on the planet with no functional spacecraft for evacuation.
memories.memory_text: I realized we were stranded on the planet with no working the blue case to get us out.

grounded_facts: After the crash, Graham Huxley tells Nico York she doesn't have to be sorry, absolving her of guilt for their stranded situation.
memories.memory_text: I heard Graham Huxley tell Nico York she didn't have to be sorry, that it wasn't her fault.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison reacts hysterically to the crash, expressing despair and helplessness.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison freak out after the crash, yelling about how we were screwed and didn't know what to do.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley reminds the group they should return to the station because it will be dark soon and the the paper watch come mostly at night.
memories.memory_text: I was reminded by Graham Huxley that we should get back to the station because it'll be dark soon and the the paper watch come mostly at night.

grounded_facts: A gathering of the surviving team members in the operations room to assess resources, discuss survival options, and assign tasks in response to the xenomorph threat.
memories.memory_text: I was there in the operations room when the team gathered to go over our resources and survival options after the Cedar Grove District wreckage was searched; I saw Logan Bennett and Remy Ellison bring in the damaged packing cases and set them down as we prepared to take stock.

grounded_facts: The group assesses the limited weapons and equipment salvaged from the Cedar Grove District wreckage, establishing their current combat resources.
memories.memory_text: I assessed our salvaged weapons and told the team what we had: four pulse-rifles with about fifty rounds each, fifteen M-40 grenades, two flame throwers less than half full—one damaged—and four robot-sentry units still working. It wasn't much, but it was all we could use to defend ourselves.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn states that rescue would arrive in approximately seventeen days if they are declared overdue, highlighting the lack of external aid.
memories.memory_text: I stated that if we're declared overdue, rescue would come in about seventeen days, emphasizing how isolated we are without immediate help.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison expresses fatalistic despair, believing the group will be overrun within hours, not days.
memories.memory_text: I heard Remy Ellison panic, saying we wouldn't last seventeen hours because the xenomorphs would overrun us long before that.

grounded_facts: Nico York uses Graham Huxley's survival as a rhetorical device to shame Remy Ellison into action.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York use Graham Huxley's survival to shame Remy Ellison, pointing out she lasted longer without weapons or training, and then Graham Huxley saluted him.

grounded_facts: Nico York confronts Remy Ellison for his negative attitude, asserts leadership, and assigns him a critical task to retrieve facility schematics.
Nico York sharply criticizes Remy Ellison's defeatist attitude and demands he take responsibility.
memories.memory_text: I watched Nico York confront Remy Ellison, sharply telling him to stop with the defeatist attitude and ordering him to get on a terminal to pull up facility schematics.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn silently nods in approval of Nico York's handling of Remy Ellison's outburst.
memories.memory_text: I silently nodded in approval of how Nico York handled Remy Ellison's outburst, bringing order back when we needed it most.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison responds positively to Nico York's command, committing to retrieve facility layout data.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison snap back into focus, saying 'Aye-firmative. I'm on it,' clearly grateful for the clear task Nico York gave him.

grounded_facts: Nico York identifies the service tunnel as the route the Quinn Bennett are using to move between areas.
memories.memory_text: I heard Nico York say that the service tunnel is how the Quinn Bennett are moving back and forth, and I saw everyone take that in during the briefing.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison confirms the path of the service tunnel, tracing it on the map.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison trace the service tunnel on the map, confirming it runs from the processing station into the sublevel.

grounded_facts: A tactical meeting in Operations where the team reviews the facility layout and plans defenses against Quinn Bennett intrusion.
memories.memory_text: I was in the tactical meeting where we reviewed the facility layout and planned our defense, and I remember Nico York pointing out how we could seal off sections to create a free field of fire for the sentry units.

grounded_facts: Nico York outlines a strategy to seal access points and set up sentry units to limit and control Quinn Bennett entry routes.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York outline the plan to seal access points and set up sentry units, pointing out how we could control Quinn Bennett entry routes by blocking the service tunnel and ducts.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn expresses strong approval of Nico York's defensive strategy and signals readiness to execute.
memories.memory_text: I gave my full approval to Nico York's strategy and told the team to move out with purpose, showing I was ready to execute the plan.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley playfully imitates Remy Ellison's military jargon, saying 'Aye-firmative!'
memories.memory_text: I heard Graham Huxley say 'Aye-firmative!' in a playful way, imitating Remy Ellison's military talk.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn provides Nico York with an emergency locating beeper so he can track her within the complex.
Finley Vaughn gives Nico York an emergency locating beeper for the small radio, explaining it's a precaution so he can track her.
memories.memory_text: I set down my welder, took out the emergency locating beeper from my belt, and gave it to Nico York so I could track her anywhere in the complex with my tracker — I told her it was just a precaution.

grounded_facts: Nico York transfers Finley Vaughn' tracker bracelet to Graham Huxley as a protective token, symbolizing care and connection.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Nico York gave my tracker bracelet to Graham Huxley as a protective token, symbolizing care and connection.

grounded_facts: Nico York uses the security camera and tracker bracelet to comfort Graham Huxley when she begs her not to leave.
memories.memory_text: I heard that Graham Huxley begged Nico York not to leave, and she used the security camera and my tracker bracelet to comfort her, though I'm not sure how much it really helped.

grounded_facts: The crew gathers at the tactical console to monitor and respond to a confirmed hostile incursion in the tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I saw the crew gather around the tactical console when the alarm went off.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn disables the alarm, shifting focus to the tactical threat.
memories.memory_text: I disabled the alarm so we could focus on the tactical display.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn verbally confirms the presence of hostiles in the tunnel, informing the assembled team.
memories.memory_text: I confirmed to the team that hostiles were in the tunnel after seeing the sensor data.

grounded_facts: Remote Sentry System (RSS) guns A and B begin tracking and firing on multiple targets in the tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I reported that the sentry guns were tracking and firing on multiple targets in the tunnel.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison comments on the high volume of fire, indicating a large number of hostiles in the tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I heard Remy Ellison say the hostiles must be packed wall to wall because of how fast the ammo counters were dropping.

grounded_facts: Motion sensors detect multiple hostiles entering the tunnel, confirmed by gunfire from automated sentry guns.
memories.memory_text: I figured there were a lot of hostiles in the tunnel because the guns were firing constantly and Remy Ellison mentioned the ammo counters moving fast.

grounded_facts: The ammunition counter on B gun reaches zero, indicating it is no longer functional.
memories.memory_text: I saw the digital counter on B gun hit zero, so I knew it was out of ammo.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn reports the ammunition levels of the guns, noting B gun is out and A gun has limited rounds left.
memories.memory_text: I reported to the team that B gun's dry and A gun's down to just five rounds.

grounded_facts: A column of flame erupts from the AP station, indicating emergency venting of gases due to system overload.
memories.memory_text: I saw a column of flame erupt from the AP station while I was watching with the crew through the window, confirming the emergency venting was happening.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster informs Nico York that the AP station will suffer total systems failure in under four hours, making shutdown impossible.
Lane Foster calculates that the AP station will suffer total systems failure in under four hours, resulting in a massive explosion.
memories.memory_text: I heard Lane Foster tell Nico York that the AP station would suffer total systems failure in under four hours, making shutdown impossible and leading to a massive explosion.

grounded_facts: Nico York proposes bringing down the second the blue case from the Sulaco using remote control, initiating a plan to escape the planet.
memories.memory_text: I remember Nico York telling me we needed to bring down the other the blue case from the Sulaco using remote control so we could escape the planet.

grounded_facts: Nico York demands that Remy Ellison think of a way to activate the the blue case remotely, showing leadership under pressure.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York demand that we find a way to activate the the blue case remotely, pushing Remy Ellison and the rest of us to think under pressure.

grounded_facts: After learning the up-link tower is hard-wired and severed, Nico York concludes someone must go to the site and connect manually with a portable terminal.
memories.memory_text: After we learned the up-link tower was hard-wired and severed, I heard Nico York conclude that someone would have to go out there and connect manually with a portable terminal.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster volunteers to go to the up-link tower to manually establish the connection, acknowledging the risk but asserting his qualification.
Lane Foster volunteers to go to the up-link tower, stating he is the only qualified person despite personal risk.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Lane Foster volunteer to go to the up-link tower, saying he was the only one qualified to remote-pilot the the blue case despite the risk, and that he wasn't stupid even if he was Lane Foster.

grounded_facts: The high-pitched trilling of a motion-sensor alarm sounds, indicating xenomorphs have entered the complex.
memories.memory_text: I heard the high-pitched trilling of the motion-sensor alarm and knew xenomorphs had entered the complex.

grounded_facts: Crew gathers in Operations to observe the failing AP station and respond to escalating threats, including system collapse and xenomorph breach.
memories.memory_text: I was in Operations with the crew, watching the AP station fail and then The Midnight Celebration the motion-sensor alarm go off, so I checked the tactical board right away.

grounded_facts: The sentry guns run out of ammunition, with one completely depleted and the other nearly so, leaving the perimeter vulnerable to Quinn Bennett intrusion.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that the sentry guns must have run out of ammo, with one completely dry and the other almost gone, leaving us exposed if the Quinn Bennett push again.

grounded_facts: Quinn Bennett advance halts and they retreat from the corridor, ceasing their assault after the sentry guns stop firing.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Quinn Bennett halt their advance and retreat down the corridor after the guns stopped firing, just like Nico York said.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn orders Logan Bennett and Remy Ellison to walk the perimeter despite their fatigue, emphasizing vigilance.
memories.memory_text: I ordered Logan Bennett and Remy Ellison to walk the perimeter even though I know we're all exhausted, because we need to stay alert and catch any threats before they get out of hand.

grounded_facts: Nico York expresses her belief that they will eventually be killed by the Quinn Bennett, revealing her psychological exhaustion and fear of losing autonomy.
memories.memory_text: I heard Nico York say grimly that they'd get us, and I could tell she was worn down, scared of what might happen.

grounded_facts: Nico York asks Finley Vaughn to promise he will kill her if capture or death is inevitable, to avoid a fate like the others.
memories.memory_text: Nico York asked me to promise I'd take care of her if it came to that, so she wouldn't end up like the others.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn hands Nico York his pulse-rifle and begins to explain its specifications, initiating her into active defense.
Finley Vaughn hands Nico York his pulse-rifle and begins to instruct her on its use, marking a shift in her role from passive survivor to active defender.
memories.memory_text: I handed her my pulse-rifle and started showing her how it works—M-41A 10mm, over and under with a 30mm grenade launcher—so she could defend herself if we had to.

grounded_facts: Nico York practices reloading the M-41A pulse rifle under Finley Vaughn' instruction, including releasing the magazine, inserting a new one, and pulling the bolt to chamber a round.
memories.memory_text: I was standing close behind Nico York, guiding her arms as she practiced reloading the M-41A pulse rifle, making sure she released the magazine, inserted a new one, and pulled the bolt to chamber a round.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn physically and verbally guides Nico York through the steps of reloading the M-41A pulse rifle, demonstrating how to release the magazine, insert a new one, and chamber a round.
A hands-on instructional session in which Finley Vaughn trains Nico York on the operation of the M-41A pulse rifle, including reloading and component identification.
memories.memory_text: I physically guided Nico York through reloading the M-41A pulse rifle, showing her how to release the magazine, insert a new one, and chamber a round while standing close behind her to position her arms and give step-by-step instructions.

grounded_facts: When Finley Vaughn suggests she avoid the grenade launcher, Nico York asserts her right to full instruction, emphasizing her ability to handle herself.
After being told she might not want to use the grenade launcher, Nico York insists that Finley Vaughn show her everything, asserting her determination to be fully prepared.
memories.memory_text: I told Nico York she might want to skip the grenade launcher, but she insisted I show her everything, saying she could handle herself.

grounded_facts: Nico York shouts and waves at the observation window and surveillance camera, trying to get Finley Vaughn' attention.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York step in front of the surveillance camera and wave her arms in a circle while shouting 'Finley Vaughn! Finley Vaughn!' to get my attention.

grounded_facts: After failing to open the the brass lantern or turn on the lights, Nico York tries to get attention by shouting and waving at the observation window.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Nico York tried to get my attention after she couldn't open the the brass lantern or turn on the lights, shouting and waving at the observation window.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn identifies the source of the alarm among the flashing lights on his board.
memories.memory_text: I saw the alarm light flashing on my board and realized where the alert was coming from.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn yells into his headset, summoning Logan Bennett and Remy Ellison to Harborview Theater due to a fire.
Finley Vaughn urgently instructs Logan Bennett and Remy Ellison to meet him in Harborview Theater due to a fire.
memories.memory_text: I yelled into my headset to call Logan Bennett and Remy Ellison, telling them to meet me in Harborview Theater because we had a fire.

grounded_facts: An Quinn Bennett leaps at Nico York's face, initiating a violent physical struggle that threatens her life.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett latched onto Nico York's face and immediately dove in, sliding to her side and helping force Quinn Bennett away while its tail tightened sickeningly around her throat.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison removes Graham Huxley from danger and kills the second Quinn Bennett.
Remy Ellison enters the operating room and destroys the second Quinn Bennett with a point-blank pulse-rifle blast.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison burst into the room, fling Graham Huxley to the small radio, and blast the second Quinn Bennett against the wall with his pulse rifle at point-blank range.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster helps free Nico York by unwinding Quinn Bennett's tail from her throat.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster grab Quinn Bennett's tail and unwind it from Nico York's throat while we all held Quinn Bennett down—I remember the way it writhed as he pulled the coil free so she could breathe.

grounded_facts: A coordinated assault by two Quinn Bennett the paper watch on Nico York and Graham Huxley in the operating room, culminating in a rescue by the marines.
memories.memory_text: I dove through the shattered window, slid across the room to Nico York, and helped pry Quinn Bennett off her face while the tail constricted her throat. I then joined Remy Ellison, Logan Bennett, and Sawyer Foster to blast the second the paper watch and finally grab the shrieking Quinn Bennett together to subdue it.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn enters the operating room and physically intervenes to pull Quinn Bennett off Nico York.
memories.memory_text: I dove into the room, slid across to Nico York, got my fingers around Quinn Bennett's legs, and pulled with all my strength—Sawyer Foster was helping, and together we forced it away from her face even as its tail tightened around her throat; I finally hurled the thing into the corner to stop the threat.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn enters the operating room and, with Sawyer Foster's help, forcibly removes Quinn Bennett the paper watch from Nico York.
memories.memory_text: I burst into the operating room, slid to Nico York's side, and grabbed Quinn Bennett's legs while Sawyer Foster unwound its tail from her throat—between us we forced it away from her face, all of us gripping the shrieking the paper watch before I hurled it into the corner to save her life.

grounded_facts: The surviving Quinn Bennett is killed, and the emergency systems shut down.
memories.memory_text: I dove through the window, shouted to Remy Ellison to get ready, and threw Quinn Bennett into the corner—he nailed it with his pulse rifle, and right after, the alarms and sprinklers shut off.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison threatens to kill Quinn Rivers after learning of his plan.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Ellison get furious and threaten to kill Quinn Rivers after we realized what he'd done.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn suggests killing Quinn Rivers as a solution to the threat he poses.
memories.memory_text: I suggested we waste Quinn Rivers to stop the threat he posed, and I meant it—no offense to him, but it had to be said.

grounded_facts: Nico York directly accuses Quinn Rivers of planning to smuggle Quinn Bennett embryos by having the crew impregnated and then killing them before quarantine.
memories.memory_text: I heard Nico York say that Quinn Rivers planned to have us impregnated with Quinn Bennett embryos and then killed during the trip back so he could smuggle them through quarantine without anyone knowing.

grounded_facts: The group confronts Quinn Rivers about his plan to smuggle Quinn Bennett embryos by sabotaging quarantine procedures and killing the crew.
memories.memory_text: I saw the group confront Quinn Rivers when Nico York exposed his plan to sabotage quarantine and kill us to cover up Quinn Bennett embryos, and I remember thinking we'd know about it unless he jettisoned our bodies.

grounded_facts: The Quinn Bennett disable the facility's power, causing all systems including lights, doors, and video screens to go offline.
memories.memory_text: I saw the lights go out suddenly, and when I looked at the control board, everything was dead—doors, video screens, all of it offline.

grounded_facts: Nico York commands Finley Vaughn and another person to fall back to Operations.
Nico York orders Finley Vaughn and another person to retreat to the Operations area.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Nico York to fall back to Operations with another person.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison detects a strong movement signal approaching from outside the operations room, with the tracker indicating decreasing range.
memories.memory_text: I heard Remy Ellison call out that there was movement and the signal was clean, then he said the range was down to twenty meters, so I knew whatever was coming was close.

grounded_facts: Nico York instructs Logan Bennett to weld the the brass lantern shut to prevent Quinn Bennett entry.
memories.memory_text: I heard Nico York order Logan Bennett to seal the the brass lantern, so I knew we were preparing for Quinn Bennett to break through.

grounded_facts: A coordinated Quinn Bennett assault on the operations room, exploiting a hidden entry point through the ceiling, leading to sudden combat and team evacuation.
memories.memory_text: I climbed up and pulled back a ceiling panel to check inside, and I saw Quinn Bennett crawling above us on the structural beams—then I fell back into the room just as they dropped down in a swarm.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn visually confirms the presence of Quinn Bennett in the ceiling, prompting immediate reaction from the team.
Finley Vaughn discovers a large number of Quinn Bennett crawling on the structural ceiling above the acoustic tiles, leading to immediate attack.
memories.memory_text: I climbed onto the file cabinet and lifted the ceiling panel, shining my light up there—I saw them immediately, a huge number of Quinn Bennett crawling on the structural ceiling like bats, clinging to the beams and pipes above the tiles. I barely had time to react before one lunged at me and the whole ceiling seemed to explode as they dropped down.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett welds the the brass lantern shut to prevent Quinn Bennett entry, despite imminent danger and intense conditions.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett welding the the brass lantern shut despite the molten metal spraying around her, and she even pulled me up when I fell, keeping one hand on the welder while firing her flamethrower.

grounded_facts: Quinn Bennett drop from the ceiling in mass, attacking the team and causing immediate chaos and combat.
memories.memory_text: I fell into the room just as the ceiling exploded and those the paper watch dropped down all at once—I barely had time to react before Remy Ellison opened fire and Logan Bennett grabbed me, pulling me up while she fired her flamethrower.

grounded_facts: Nico York shouts an order for the team to fall back to the Harborview Theater lab.
memories.memory_text: I heard Nico York shout 'Harborview Theater! Get to Harborview Theater!' so I knew we were falling back to the lab.

grounded_facts: Nico York directs and leads the team's movement toward the Harborview Theater lab as the only viable escape route during Quinn Bennett assault.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York lead the way toward the corridor, dashing ahead, so I followed her as we moved to the Harborview Theater lab as the only escape.

grounded_facts: Remy Ellison shouts in hysteria, urging immediate evacuation.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Remy Ellison shouts in hysteria, urging immediate evacuation.

grounded_facts: The fire-control system activates, triggering sprinklers and a siren, causing chaos in the operations room.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The fire-control system activates, triggering sprinklers and a siren, causing chaos in the operations room.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn responds with a terse affirmation while engaging the enemy.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Finley Vaughn responds with a terse affirmation while engaging the enemy.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn, Logan Bennett, and Sawyer Foster retreat from the operations room to the Harborview Theater access corridor.
memories.memory_text: I retreated with Logan Bennett and Sawyer Foster from the operations room and made it to the Harborview Theater access corridor.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn shouts for Nico York to stop firing, likely to prevent further danger or conserve ammunition.
memories.memory_text: I shouted 'Hold your fire!' to stop Nico York from shooting, needing to regain control of the situation.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn uses a torch from his belt to cut through the the brass lantern lock, enabling entry.
memories.memory_text: I used my belt torch to cut through the lock on the the brass lantern so we could get inside.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn shouts at Logan Bennett, blaming her for the disorienting effects of the grenade blast.
memories.memory_text: I shouted at Logan Bennett that I couldn't hear anything after the blast, blaming her for the mess.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett shouts back 'What?' in apparent response to Finley Vaughn' complaint, possibly feigning or genuinely suffering The Midnight Celebration loss.
memories.memory_text: I heard Logan Bennett shout back 'What?' right after I yelled at her, and I wasn't sure if she was serious or just messing around.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn uses his hand-torch in weld mode to seal the the brass lantern they just came through.
memories.memory_text: I switched my hand-torch to weld mode and started sealing the the brass lantern we just came through to secure the room.

grounded_facts: Nico York stops Graham Huxley from entering the vent first and insists on going ahead.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York pull Graham Huxley back when she tried to go into the vent first, and then Nico York went ahead instead.

grounded_facts: Nico York takes the flamethrower from Sawyer Foster before entering the vent.
memories.memory_text: I watched Nico York take the flamethrower from Sawyer Foster before she entered the air shaft.

grounded_facts: A group evacuation through the air ducts to escape a breach at the Harborview Theater.
The group begins escaping through an air vent to avoid a threat at the lab annex the brass lantern.
memories.memory_text: I was part of the group that crawled into the air vent to escape the threat at the Harborview Theater, following Graham Huxley in right after Nico York.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley pushes Nico York to urge her to crawl faster through the shaft.
memories.memory_text: I remember seeing Graham Huxley push on Nico York’s back to make her crawl faster through the shaft.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley provides directional guidance through the duct system toward the landing field.
Graham Huxley confidently tells Nico York which way to go in the duct system.
memories.memory_text: I followed Graham Huxley's directions through the ducts as she confidently told Nico York which way to go, like when she said 'Go left,' guiding us toward the landing field.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn reestablishes radio contact with Lane Foster amid heavy interference.
memories.memory_text: I tried hailing Lane Foster over the radio and after a long pause, I heard his Jonah Hawthorne come through with heavy interference, so I knew I'd reestablished limited contact.

grounded_facts: A desperate attempt by the team to escape through an air duct while being pursued by Quinn Bennett warriors from both directions.
memories.memory_text: I saw Quinn Bennett warrior bursting through the grating behind us, and I knew we were trapped with no way out but forward.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn uses his hand-welder to cut through the duct wall, creating an opening into a service way, enabling partial escape.
memories.memory_text: I used my hand-welder to cut through the duct wall, and when it ran out of power, I kicked through the hot metal to open a way into a service passage, then pulled Graham Huxley through to the small radio as Nico York handed her over.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett is wounded when acid from an Quinn Bennett's attack burns through her armor and into her thigh, causing severe pain and incapacitation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett get hit by Quinn Bennett acid—it burned right through her armor and into her thigh, and she cried out in pain, unable to move.

grounded_facts: Despite being at risk, Sawyer Foster abandons escape to return and attempt to drag Logan Bennett to the small radio after she is injured.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sawyer Foster turn back to help Logan Bennett, dragging her toward the small radio even though we were all trying to escape.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett, mortally wounded, calls Sawyer Foster an asshole, reflecting past tension and disdain.
memories.memory_text: I heard Logan Bennett call Sawyer Foster an asshole just before she died, a final word that carried all their past tension.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett initiates the 'power greeting' with Sawyer Foster, a symbolic gesture of respect and camaraderie previously seen with Jesse Hawthorne.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett give Sawyer Foster the power greeting, a gesture I recognized from when she shared it with Jesse Hawthorne—it meant something deep between them.

grounded_facts: Logan Bennett and Sawyer Foster prepare to face overwhelming Quinn Bennett forces with grenades, accepting likely death.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Bennett and Sawyer Foster prepare to fight the oncoming Quinn Bennett with grenades, knowing they probably wouldn't make it out alive.

grounded_facts: Sawyer Foster hands two grenades to Logan Bennett as they prepare to face the Quinn Bennett together.
memories.memory_text: I watched Sawyer Foster hand two grenades to Logan Bennett as they got ready to face the Quinn Bennett together.

grounded_facts: A powerful blast occurs behind Nico York, Graham Huxley, and Finley Vaughn, causing a shock wave that makes them stumble.
memories.memory_text: I stumbled when a powerful blast went off behind us, the shock wave hitting me hard as I ran with Nico York and Graham Huxley.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley urges Nico York and Finley Vaughn to follow her, asserting confidence in the path ahead.
memories.memory_text: I heard Graham Huxley urging me and Nico York to follow her, saying 'This way. Come on, we're almost there!' with confidence in her Jonah Hawthorne.

grounded_facts: Nico York attempts to slow Graham Huxley down by calling for her to wait.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Nico York calling out 'Graham Huxley, wait!' as we moved through the corridor, trying to slow her down.

grounded_facts: The group reaches a junction featuring a narrow angled chute ascending at a steep 45 degrees, marking a navigational decision point.
memories.memory_text: I saw the junction we reached, with a narrow angled chute rising up at a steep 45 degrees—it was a tight fit and a clear decision point.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley directs the group to climb the narrow angled chute as the next route.
memories.memory_text: I remember Graham Huxley directing us to climb the chute, pointing and saying 'Here! Go up,' so I followed her lead.

grounded_facts: Nico York reaches for Graham Huxley as she slips, but their hands miss by inches, failing to prevent the fall.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York reach for Graham Huxley as she slipped, but their hands missed by just inches and she couldn't stop the fall.

grounded_facts: Graham Huxley slips as a rusted rib collapses under her foot, slides down the chute, and plummets into darkness after slipping out of her jacket.
memories.memory_text: I watched Graham Huxley lose her footing when a rusted rib gave way, and she slid down the chute, plunging into darkness after slipping out of her jacket.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn lunges and grabs Graham Huxley's oversized jacket, but she slips out of it, rendering the attempt ineffective.
memories.memory_text: I lunged and grabbed Graham Huxley's oversized jacket to stop her, but she slipped right out of it and kept falling.

grounded_facts: After witnessing Graham Huxley's fall, Nico York kicks free and slides down the chute in pursuit, navigating a fork and choosing the left shaft where her light is visible.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York look at me right before she kicked free and slid down the chute after Graham Huxley, bracing herself as she disappeared into the left shaft.

grounded_facts: A high-risk climb through a narrow, deteriorating vertical shaft with multiple characters involved, turning into a rescue scenario after Graham Huxley's fall.
memories.memory_text: I was climbing through a narrow, deteriorating shaft with Nico York and Graham Huxley when she fell, turning everything into a desperate rescue situation.

grounded_facts: Nico York calls out 'Graham Huxley!' at the bottom of the chute, attempting to establish verbal contact.
memories.memory_text: I figured Nico York must have called out for Graham Huxley at the bottom of the chute, since she was searching the tunnel and responding to faint echoes, though I couldn't hear her Jonah Hawthorne from where I was.

grounded_facts: Nico York uses her headset to instruct Finley Vaughn to bring the locator device.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Nico York over the headset to get down there and bring the locator device.

grounded_facts: At the bottom of the chute, unable to locate Graham Huxley despite The Midnight Celebration her cries, Nico York contacts Finley Vaughn via headset to bring the locator.
memories.memory_text: I heard Nico York calling me over the headset, and from her Jonah Hawthorne I could tell she was panicking, spinning around down in the tunnel, trying to find Graham Huxley by the sound of her cries but not knowing where she was.

grounded_facts: Nico York instructs Graham Huxley to climb down and prepares her for the grate being cut, offering emotional support.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York tell Graham Huxley to climb down while she got her ready for the grate being cut.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn starts cutting through the floor grating with a hand-torch to enable Graham Huxley's rescue.
memories.memory_text: I started cutting through the floor grating with my hand-torch to get Graham Huxley out.

grounded_facts: Nico York finds Graham Huxley trapped beneath a floor grating in a lighted service tunnel, establishing visual and physical contact through the grate.
Graham Huxley calls out repeatedly from beneath the grating to alert Nico York and Finley Vaughn of her presence.
memories.memory_text: I followed Nico York using the locator signal and heard Graham Huxley calling out from under the grating; I saw Nico York reach through and squeeze her fingers when we found her trapped below.

grounded_facts: A coordinated effort by Nico York and Finley Vaughn to locate and extract Graham Huxley from a confined space using a locator signal and cutting tools.
memories.memory_text: I joined Nico York in cutting through the grating with my hand-torch to help get Graham Huxley out of that confined space.

grounded_facts: An Quinn Bennett emerges from the water behind Graham Huxley and engulfs her in shadow, causing her to scream in terror.
memories.memory_text: I saw an Quinn Bennett rise silently from the water behind Graham Huxley and engulf her in shadow, and I heard her scream in terror.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn acknowledges Nico York's belief that Graham Huxley is alive to calm her and get her to move.
memories.memory_text: I told Nico York I believed Graham Huxley was alive because she was hysterical and I needed her to move with me.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn forcibly pulls Nico York away from the hole to prevent her from jumping in after Graham Huxley.
memories.memory_text: I pulled Nico York away from the hole and dragged her back when she tried to jump in after Graham Huxley, fighting to get her under control.

grounded_facts: Nico York regains composure and assists Finley Vaughn after seeing him injured by acid.
memories.memory_text: Nico York regained her composure and began helping me remove my burning armor after seeing me injured by the acid.

grounded_facts: Nico York helps Finley Vaughn remove his acid-damaged combat armor in the elevator.
memories.memory_text: I was desperately trying to unclasp my armor as the acid ate through it, and Nico York snapped out of her panic and started clawing at my armor to help me get it off.

grounded_facts: Nico York realizes Graham Huxley is missing after seeing only the doll head in the water, leading to emotional collapse.
memories.memory_text: I saw the doll head sink and realized Nico York knew Graham Huxley was gone, and that's when she broke down.

grounded_facts: Acid from Quinn Bennett's blood burns through Finley Vaughn' armor and contacts his skin during elevator escape.
memories.memory_text: I felt the acid from Quinn Bennett's blood burn through my armor and make contact with my skin while I was shielding Nico York with my body in the elevator.

grounded_facts: Nico York and Finley Vaughn flee through the service tunnel and elevator while being pursued by an Evan Hale.
memories.memory_text: I remember fleeing through the tunnel and elevator with Nico York while that warrior was chasing us, barely making it out.

grounded_facts: Lane Foster helps support Finley Vaughn as they move toward the the blue case.
memories.memory_text: I felt Lane Foster grab me to help me stay upright as we ran toward the the blue case, the wind pushing us hard the whole way.

grounded_facts: the blue case successfully lands on the landing grid despite harsh weather conditions.
The arrival and landing of the blue case at the colony's landing field under severe weather conditions.
memories.memory_text: I saw the the blue case land hard and slide sideways on the grid in this terrible wind, but it finally stopped and we knew it was down safely.

grounded_facts: Nico York accuses Lane Foster of knowing that Graham Huxley is still alive and being held at the facility.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Nico York that Graham Huxley is still alive and being held at the facility, and that Lane Foster knows about it.

grounded_facts: Nico York instructs Finley Vaughn to prevent Lane Foster from leaving, implying distrust of Lane Foster's intentions.
memories.memory_text: Nico York told me not to let Lane Foster leave, so I told her we ain't going anywhere, even though I was in pain.

grounded_facts: Finley Vaughn corrects Nico York by stating his first name, and Nico York reciprocates by using her first name, establishing mutual respect.
memories.memory_text: I told Nico York my name is Finley Vaughn, and she gave me hers—Nico York. I saw the respect in her eyes, and when she took my hand, I knew we had a bond forged in this hell. I told her, 'Don't be long, Nico York,' because I meant it.

grounded_facts: Nico York exits the the blue case via the ramp, heading toward the freight elevator to leave the immediate area.
memories.memory_text: I watched her run down the ramp and cross the platform to the freight elevator, and I saw the doors close behind her. I couldn't move to follow—pain kept me here—but I saw her go.
